title: Skip the Line: Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill Guided Tour
description: The ancient glory of Rome is reborn! Skip the Line at three of the most significant surviving remnants of the Eternal City: the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum. Your English-speaking expert historian tour guide will share anecdotes and history throughout the 3-hour tour, rebuilding the impressive ruins with tales of Ancient Rome’s heyday.

reviews.usertext: We were so lucky to have the knowledgeable and very personable Christina as our guide. Her enthusiasm for her city was infectious, and her passion for her academic subject of art history (PhD no less) really brought the Colosseum and Forum to life. There were 12 of us, a small enough group to make it feel personal and fun. It is expensive, but you get what you pay for and so much more - we sailed past queues, and were treated to interesting titbits of information that can’t be found on Google or in a guidebook. If you are new to the city I can’t recommend a personal guide highly enough. Handy hint - make sure you have water, a cap and sun cream as the sun above the Colosseum is strong even in Spring!

Took the basic (not small group) Colosseum tour as part of the full day combo package with the Best of Rome walking tour and found that it's better to just go for the colosseum tour and skip the city walk.

Lady archaelogist guide for the Colosseum tour was knowledgeable, engaging and made every effort to connect with and tailor her content to different members of her group - from young children to the older adults. She even supplemented her commentary with hard copy pictures she carried in her bag.

This was in contrast to the city walk guide who kept shoving mainly art history facts to participants even though not everyone seemed interested in what's being said. There was also no mention of the large number of eateries and gelato spots along the way until a participant asked for food recommendations at the end of the tour. Note also that the guide will not be entering the Pantheon to explain things inside. So before you pay for this city tour, maybe check out other free walking tours first that also cover the city centre - some of these other agencies have very creative itineraries that reflect their guides' efforts to offer something different to tourists.

Wonderful tour in every way. Our tour guide, Flavia [? spelling] was exceptionally knowledgeable, very thorough, personable, and entertaining. In our group of 7 we had 3 grandsons, age 10 and 12. She engaged them throughout the tour and made them feel a part of it and allowed them to experience the full perspective of how unique the history is of that time in Roman history. We started at the Colosseum, and after a thorough tour of it we moved on to the Palatine Hill and then to the Forum. It's a lengthy tour but time seemed to fly by due to her way of conducting the tour. We could not even remotely been able to obtain the information she provided for us on our own; and it would have taken much longer. This tour is well worth the money paid and my entire family highly recommend it.

Due to circumstances beyond our control (cruise ship transportation), we were running late for the start of this tour. 10 minutes prior to tour we phoned to let the tour operator know we were running 5 minutes late and asked if we could meet the tour at a different starting point. The answer was no. We arrived at the meeting point five minutes late after calling them again to try to get help finding their tour guide (it’s very crowded at the meeting point). The tour left without us and they offered only to let us tour after our bus back to the ship would already have departed. There were no individual tickets available to the coliseum - we traveled halfway around the world and were denied help. We witnessed other tour operators with the same issue rushing late arrivals to meet their tour guides and being very understanding and accommodating. The opposite was true of this tour company. We were denied a requested refund. Don’t book with them!!!!

Our guide Amille arrived early and was extremely personable. She did her best to make sure a few latecomers had the chance to tour but ultimately we left without them. While waiting briefly for our entry time slot to come around Amille was able to give an interesting account of her life as well as the early life of the Colosseum. She was very knowledgeable and did not want to be drawn into giving false facts or any dubious time frames of when things may occurred. Amille was able to juggle a fellow tourer’s fall (mind your step people) with ensuring they were safe and we were all taking something interesting in. Amille was good with the larger crowds making sure we were all comfortable, safe and enjoying ourselves throughout. There is an option to end the tour after the Colosseum or continue onto the Roman Forum, I would highly recommend continuing on to the Forum and viewing the entirety of the grounds (this could take an additional 2-3 hours) but very worth.

I booked a Skip the Line: Colosseum Small Group Tour with Roman Forum & Palatine Hill. We met with our guide at 10am. We booked a English speaking guide, but he had a very strong Italian accent and did not speak very good English so us and many others struggled to understand him. The Colosseum part or the tour was supposed to be an hour and a half, but this included time walking from the meeting point to the Colosseum and queing up which took around half an hour. We were then out of the Colosseum by 11:05am, meaning we only had 35 minutes inside viewing . The Colosseum tour was extremely rushed, the guide did not check whether anyone could keep up and was rushing ahead, meaning we could not enjoy our surroundings as we spent too much time trying to find him and make sure we weren't left behind. We walked past so many things without being given an opportunity to stop even for a quick photo.
We booked this tour see the Colosseum whilst also learning about its history, but did not feel as though we learnt anything and would have been better off walking around on our own.
We ended up leaving part way through the Palatine Hill and Roman Forum as the guide was continuing to rush and skip past bits and we found it to be much more enjoyable to walk around without the guide.
We did a different tour the previous day with the same company and that tour was so much better than this one as she kept the group together, kept the group informed of where we were going, and made sure everyone was OK.

Matteo was a fantastic guide. He provided a great commentary that painted a picture of how the colosseum was in its heyday. Highly recommend. Only one sticking point of the tour was that it didn't include the Roman Forum, and if you do the 3pm tour you don't have much time for a self-guided tour after the guide leaves. We spent too much time enjoying the view from Palatine Hill not realizing the Forum was closing at 7:15pm. Highly recommend this tour but pick an early tour time so you have the full day to enjoy the Forum at your leisure.

Well organised tour from the meeting point directly opposite the colosseum. Headphones were supplied which worked very well so we were able to hear our very informative guide Alexandra. She brought to life through her narrative of historical and architectural knowledge how the Romans lived and life as a gladiator. The tour finished inside the Forum. After a brief introduction to the history of the area we were left to explore and take advantage of the many photographic opportunities.

Would highly recommend this tour as you do jump queues and avoid the crowds.

Colosseum tour with our guide Emanuela was more than fantastic!
She was really nice, funny, she explained everything so well, she counted us in group making sure we were all together.
She gave us toilet brake,she was asking us questions making this tour interactive and fun.
I her energy was fasntastic, she was finding shades everywhere for (us not to stand in the sun )and then she had a speech and explained everything.

If it is possible to ask and choose your guide I highly recommend you to ask for Emanuela to be your guide.

This was an excellent tour *of the Colosseum* which includes, at the end, getting you into the Forum/Palatine Hill archeological site. It *does not* include any tour of the Forum/Palatine Hill site, so if you want to do that - and I highly recommend you do - you will need to allow a couple more hours than is advertised here, and bring your lunch with you because once the tour guide takes you into the archeological site you can't leave and re-enter.
Having said that, the Colosseum is a fascinating place, our tour guide was very knowledgeable and helpful, and *as a tour of the Colosseum* I would recommend this experience.

its a magnificent ruin and the story and history from the guide puts it into perspective. As well as letting you know where to stop and take photos, what to do if you have time to come back or some of the history that you can't get from placards.

It was crowded but the place is so huge you don't feel like its really crowded.

I wouldn't recommend for kids under 13 ish. There were a few kids and they seemed bored and tired. Its about a 3 hour tour.

I also recommend bringing a snack as you'll be hungry but will want to keep seeing the signs and ruins so plan on water (lots of water) and a snack to keep up.

We booked this tour for six guests from all age groups – two people in their 50's, three in their 20's, and one in their 70's – and it was an absolutely wonderful, interesting, informative, fun day for all of us. The tour, with a total group of about 15 people, launched from the Colosseo metro stop, where we met our tour guide, Matteo. Matteo was amazing – knowledgeable and funny – but most of all he brought imagination and emotion to the historical scenes he was painting. For every fact, he tried to have us imagine the actual people – their motivations and daily lives. Matteo had such a wide-ranging intelligence and imagination – tying details about the construction and decor of the various sections of the Colosseum to social constructs, societal trends, and politics together in an organic way. He was also very practical though – when we were in the Colosseum he was friendly but insistent about getting our group access to various view points which was greatly appreciated given the Sunday crowds. Although Matteo's voice definitely was strong enough, the tour utilized a wireless mic system which worked very well. We ended up spending nearly the entire tour in the Colosseum. That is not meant as a criticism – Matteo definitely would have moved faster and had asked us several times if we wanted to move out toward the forum, but the group was enjoying the Colosseum part. Once we exited, even though the tour was over, Matteo walked us over to the Forum and gave us a nice introduction before leaving. Given that the Colosseum and Forum are two of the most icon, familiar sites in Rome, Matteo made it seem new and brought to life the reasons that tourists make a point to see them. His love for his native city was evident and conveyed a passion that was contagious.

Our “small group” had 29 people. The gate through which our guide tried to enter only allowed groups of 20, which required her to split the group, and email 9 tickets to a volunteer in our group, who went with 8 other group members to enter via another gate. We then rendezvous back with the main body of the group, all of which cost us about 15 minutes. The colosseum part of the tour was competent; the guide was informative and responsive to questions, but the time not well spent. Several times we stopped for extended “photo opportunities” during which the guide said very little. These stops consumed a significant fraction of the total allotted time by the end of the tour. We then made our way to Palatine Hill. The guide was clearly less familiar with the ruins in this area. Again there were several extended photo ops, including 15 minutes spent at an overlook of the Forum, which the guide spent away from the group, standing in a nearby shaded area. Finally, we descended toward the Forum, where the tour abruptly ended without entering the Forum. The group tour never entered the Forum. Not what was advertised.

I reserved the skip-the-line small group tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill for 2 with City Wonders on Aug 31st and paid $99.90. When we arrived at the meeting point for the tour on Sept 10th, we learned that our tour had been cancelled. I did not receive an email, text or WhatsUp informing me of the cancellation, just surprise! My $100 were never refunded, and trying to contact TripAdviser is like trying to contact the Pope: not possible. I would like to receive a refund for the cancelled tour, any clue how to go about it?

I booked this tour after my small private and much more expensive Colosseum tour was cancelled by another tour operator. I am glad I did! Although there were 22 people in our group, we were given headsets so we could all hear our guide clearly. Elena, our tour guide, was amazing, she made sure we had breaks, led us at a comfortable pace, told us where to go for the most amazing photos and made the experience really interesting even for my teenager. Bonus was that we also got to see the Forum and the Palatine Hill and the price was very reasonable. Highly recommended!

Absolutely amazing tour, Raf was knowledgeable and entertaining. She gave a brilliant tour of the Colleseum and the Roman Forum. Highly recommend booking this especially at the moment with crowd numbers down due to covid restrictions.

Our tour guide was superb. Be sure to ask for Alessandro with City Wonders Tours. He is an archaeologist himself and is a wealth of information, eager to share. The tour wound up being about half an hour longer because everyone was so interested and kept asking questions along the way. A couple of people had to leave early for dinner reservations but pretty much everyone stayed to the end because he was captivating.

Our host Riccardo was very pleasant and super knowledgeable, and it's definitely worth paying for skip the line and to have an in-person guide (rather than a pre-recorded one). Quite a bit of the history was lost on me/ us, but that is a reflection of my lack of knowledge rather than a criticism of the tour - some more tangible 'tit bits' that keep your interest would have been welcome. It was easy to find the starting point, we left punctually, and the group wasn't too large (around 20 people). The only thing we were left confused by was the fact that we purchased a ticket that included a tour of the underground of the Colosseum. Whilst we saw it from afar, I can't really describe it as a tour...

My group and I had an amazing time on this tour with our guide, Eddy. He made it fun despite the rain, bringing a ton of energy / enthusiasm, jokes, and he was incredibly knowledgeable about the history behind the sites we visited. Eddy even incorporated time throughout the tour to take photos of our group on our behalf to help us memorialize the experience.

I’d definitely recommend this experience to anyone who’s even slightly interested - thanks, Eddy!

Tour felt very well organised. The guides were easy to meet with the given directions and the check in process was easy. The meeting point is an added bonus for wonderful photos of the colosseum.
Headphone quality was really good and I could hear the guide clearly at all times. The guide on my tour was Sabrina and she was very knowledgeable and allowed plenty time for photo opportunities and questions. She explained how the tour would work very well and also gave us personal tips/information.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this tour.
Please just be aware you are on your feel and walking for a very long time so make sure you’re dressed comfortably and have water.

The tour could not have been organised better. The booking process was simple. The instructions where and how to meet before the tour were straightforward and we were welcomed with all the right information.
Sara, our guide, was excellent. She keep all the tour party involved and engaged with good stories and background as well as practical advice about good photo opportunities as well as food and restaurant choices!
She carried a City Wonders flag so we could always identify her. Other tours we noticed had guides waving folders and small books which didn’t look professional nor easy to spot in the crowds which fill the colosseum from morning till night. City Wonders do a great job

Our guide didn’t speak English at all. Only some English words, he was saying words in Italian and he was asking us how to say it in English. Me and the rest of the group were asking questions and he didn’t understand us.
The tour lasted more than 3 hours, he was reading the captions in front of the monuments and then said almost the same with what it was written.
We didn’t make any stop and he was running all the time.
Also he was racist and made some not funny at all “jokes” and comments.
I do not recommend this to anyone.

The tour was just shy of 3 hours long. We started at 9am on an extremely hot day. There was 20 in our group, a mix of young families, couples and older friends.

Our guide Sylvia was fantastic at making sure we were moving along as schedule, but also that we were in the shade and hydrated as much as possible. Her passions seeped into everything she said and we were hung on her every word. Her love for all things Roma made the experience that much better. Her knowledge of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Roma Forum was spectacular, informative without being too drawn out.

We were given headphones and a speaker to which Sylvia had a microphone. It was not always needed but in the forum it is particularly crowded so having her voice in your ear was a big help. She openly wanted questioned and was delighted to answer anything we would ask.

Would highly recommend this to anyone who is interested.

The sites themselves are astounding, however after taking 5 tours during our stay; we will stick with small local tour companies in the future.
Our guide did work at the Colosseum as an archaeologist & I did learn new a few new things. However, he seemed more suited for didactic academic instruction not a personable tour guide. He was not captivating in his demeanor, he relied heavily on a book for examples as opposed to compelling stories. There was no consideration for us as guests or clients of his company, he berated a fellow tourist for purchasing water, he voiced political/religious bias more than once. He wasn’t courteous, no bathroom breaks, no water breaks, no photo opportunities/suggestions, just forward march, keep up with me. People in our group got bored as he droned on. It was like being in a class of a great topic but a lackluster teacher.
Friends of ours took the same tour with Sylvia and had a completely different experience. They were 1 million times more positive. I think it’s hit or miss with large companies and their tour guides/staff. We found the smaller companies to be consistently engaging, always thoughtful, considerate and always looking out for their guest. We did not have a good experience with this company.

This tour was totally value for money, as our guide (Nick) really made the place come alive. The pace was good, the audio equipment worked well and our guide spoke slowly and clearly and gave us a lot of information not only around the Flavian Amphitheatre and the surrounding areas but also about the people of the era these buildings were built in. I totally recommend booking a tour if you would like to visit the Colosseum as this is the best way to get the most out of the experience.

Unfortunately I cannot give this company a rating due to not being able to go on this excursion. I let the company know I was unable to attend and requested a refund. I was told that since the cancellation was less than 24 hrs they were unable to give a refund. So beware if you have any extenuating circumstances cancel before 25 hrs if able, because they WILL NOT refund.

Our guide Amil was outstanding! She was the best guide we had during our month-long trip. She was knowledgeable, friendly, very passionate about history and kept everyone entertained and laughing. She brought photos and drawings to illustrate her explanations and kept everyone engaged the whole 3 hours. My boys 9, 11, and 13 years old loved the tour! It was a very hot, sunny day, and Amil made sure we all had enough water at all times, and had us stop in shade when she explained, which we greatly appreciated. Also, she took us to the best photo spots and took photos of every group. Last but not least, her English is spotless.
Definitely recommend this tour and I hope you get her as a guide!

Nic was knowledgeable, created a comfortable pace with stops for information and rest, and definitely added to our experience with history and anecdotes. Also, we were able to get access during the time frame we wanted by reserving the tour. Worth it!

Our tour guide Hector was very knowledgeable. We got thru all areas efficiently while he provided a great commentary on what we were seeing. His suggestion to see a few movies Like Gladiator or Spartacus to get a big picture view of the past was great. This tour is not for those having problems walking. If you have trouble you may want to get a private tour guide so you can go slower. Some people did drop out. Also go early in the morning the Roman sun can be brutal in the summer. Very worthwhile

We started at 2 PM and it was supposed to start at 1:45. The tour guide rushed us down to the entry to wait in line with everyone else. We stood and listened to her talk while in line. She seemed confused about what to talk about. We were then taken through the security, etc. and told to stand around her where we had to stay and listen to her for a long time. We were not allowed to wonder to take pictures. She kept saying we would have time, but we missed everything from her rushing us from one place to another and making us stay and listen to her and not see things. We were given 10 minutes to take pictures and then rushed, and I mean rushed out of the Colosseum to the Palatine Hill. We could hardly keep up. We then got inside and had to stand around and listen to her talk and not see anything at all. We walked up some steps and listened some more and then she said to give her back the receivers and be out of the Colloseaum by 4:10 or they would be mad at her. It lasted 2 hours and almost 10 minutes. It was supposed to be 3 hours and I don't even know if we saw the Roman Forum. So confusing and rushed and constraining. I am here fore 20 more days and wanted to book many more tours, but now I fear it is a waste of my money. I pad almost $75 for this two hours. So sad in Rome.

Our family of 5 did a tour with Nicola from City of Wonders. He was great, very knowledgeable about the Colosseum and the Forum. He was very easy going and funny at times, we all enjoyed his tour immensely! I would recommend booking an early tour because by the time we finished at 11:30 the area was much hotter and crowded then when we started.

This was terrible. Do not recommend. We paid over $200 CAD for a 2 hour tour. In which, our tour guide showed up 25 minutes late, when she finally arrived she rushed us through the streets to make our Colosseum entrance time. Giving a very poor explanation of the surrounding structures that couldn’t be heard at all due to her microphone placement that she was told multiple times about by many different guests. After finally getting through and in to the Colosseum she gave us almost no history of the place and only mentioned we were standing on the stadium floor about 25 times. She was extremely repetitive and very flustered the entire time. Very unfortunate as this was going to hopefully be one of the highlights of our time in Rome. The entire group seemed very disappointed. To cap it all off, she finished the tour 15 minutes early.
Tour total time: 1 hour 20 minutes.

Hi, I paid for a Semi Private guided Tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill with City Wonders. This tour was advertised as a small group of no more than 12 people for a 2 hour duration and with head sets included. We arrived at the designated area where we were greeted by a member of City Wonders, we then were introduced to our guide who we later found out was a free lance guide. The tour started with 14 people but grew further down the line as the guides own clients joined the group. We had no head sets as advertised and with the rain and wind found it difficult to hear her. We skipped so many areas of the Colosseum like videos and artifacts, were given brief descriptions of the main areas and were then ushered out to the entrance for the Roman Forums where we were left to our own devices and our tour guide left, this was also after an 1 1/2 hours and not the 2 hours advertised. It was that bad that a French family wanted to stay and look further around the Colosseum and were told that was fine but they would then have to pay again for entrance into the Forum as it was a group booking (surprisingly they did) At £135.00 for the two of us this was extremely poor value and City Wonders should vet their guides more stringently?

Unfortunately this was not a great tour. We were really looking forward to it, too.
1. The meeting spot was a bit tricky to find, not knowing the area. We planned ahead and got to the area early, and still just barely made meeting up with the group.
2. Our guide spoke English, but was hard to understand. I looked around at the group and saw everyone listening, but also watching her lips to make sure that they were understanding everything.
3. Our guide was using a tattered up magazine to tell us things about the Colosseum. I get it--there's a history there that can't visually be shown "as is" at the current site, but being in a large tour and having a small magazine shown to us, when we paid so much to BE IN THE COLOSSEUM was a bit ridiculous.
4. We didn't know that water would be allowed in the Colosseum and it was very hot. Luckily we were able to grab water from a vendor on our walk to the Forum.
5. I didn't realize that we were just going to be dropped at Palatine Hill and were going to tour that, and the Forum on our own. I feel like we missed a LOT of possible learning moments, not having someone show us around those two areas. I must have misunderstood and thought that the tour would include a guide for all 3. Instead we were just dropped off, maybe due to time?
6. It was crowded and sometimes difficult to see exhibits inside the Colosseum. The guide was explaining things that we couldn't see, so it was frustrating.

I really wanted this to be different, but it was unfortunately our experience. It could have been the day, or maybe the guide, but it wasn't a great experience for us.

Colosseum amazing but guide not so. Didn’t learn very much at all. Group was more than 12 and we missed our time slot to enter the colosseum itself so had to hand around outside in the sun for 10 mins whilst that got sorted. Guide often unintelligible and seemed to want to play the part of a cartoon Italian tour guide. I’m sure it can be better.

This visit was the highlight of our recent short delightful holiday in Rome. Ourt tour guide, Allessandro, made the Colleseum experience come alive.

Hi narrative on the building of what was originally called the new amphitheatre gave a conclusive overview of us how the architects and builders managed the construction, how the events were run, an insight into brutality, financial information and peppered with amusing historic anecdotes. Alessandro was very considerate finding shady places for us to listen and observe. Absolutely excellent.

This was a very well organised and informative guided tour. On arrival we were all given a radio and ear pieces in order to fully hear the tour guide. These worked well for the most part but there was occasional cutting out/crackling, however this wasn’t a big issue. Viola, out tour guide, was accommodating and got the best spots at the Colosseum for photos and sight seeing. It was very hot and she made sure to point out all of the water fountains so that her visitors could fill up their water bottles. She was extremely knowledgeable and able to answer all questions. We found out so much about the Roman history of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill and it was engaging, not only for myself and my husband, but for our 2 teenagers as well. Highly recommended.

Slightly complicated instructions to find the meeting place, but if you simply trust the directions given (through the subway station) then all will be okay.
We saw the CITY WONDERS guys with iPads, checked in and were directed to our guide, Giuseppe. We were then given "radio packs" and ear buds so we could easily hear everything that the guide said as we walked along, even when 10-20m away from him!
Off we set for about a 3 hour walking tour (NB if your not so good on your feet, you may wish to choose another tour as lots of walking, including steps and cobble stones)
Had a fantastic time learning all about the history of the Colosseum & surrounding area. Giuseppe was extremely knowledgeable and clearly enjoyed sharing this with the group. He was also very happy to stop where we wanted and answer any questions asked. Can't rate him high enough.
Fantastic experience and would recommend to everyone

The heat was intense and the stairs leading to the meeting point were not accessible so we did not find the group! I called the company but they were unable to reach the guide so suddenly we stood there without any hope of getting inside he colosseum and the forum after having looked forward to it for months! I was crushed and so was my daughter. In desperation, I approached another guide carrying a "City Wonders" flag and he was so friendly and calm. He told us we were welcome to join his group and I could have wept with gratitude. Thank you, thank you, Nick for saving our day and for being so kind and flexible.

The visit was a real treat as he cleverly chose to focus his comments on the experience that a Roman citizen would have had when visiting the Colosseum. He really made it come alive and kept it interesting. I felt that we learned so much during this visit. I would highly recommend this tour with him.

Couldn’t find the tour guide. It was never mentioned that you had to go in the train station and climb the stairs to the top. She wasn’t holding any sign other than a carrying a pole with a plastic saranawrap. This was supposed to be a small group and there were 22 people in the tour. The headphone volume was low and the guide didn’t speak English well so very hard to understand. Since there were so many other tours and so crowded, it was very easy to get lost and you couldn’t linger or take much pictures. I took this tour so I could learn the history but due to not being able to understand the tour guide well and having a lot of static in the headsets, it was very hard to follow the conversation. I would have rather just used an app and gone on my own without the crowds at a cooler time. Waste of money.

Matteo our tour guide provided the best experience. His information and insight into the history of the Colosseum left us with a better understanding of Roman culture and its' profound impact on history. His sense of humor and presentation style captivated the group. Gracias Mateo!!

Going inside the colosseum was an amazing experience, however seeing the roman forum and palatine hill was much more interesting. Our tour guide didn’t seem to know much about about the history of the colosseum and we skipped past a lot of parts that looked interesting.

We had a break when at the forum and was able to use the toilets and get a drink if we wanted (There is a small cafe and a water fountain to fill water bottles up for free).

While the tour was a good experience and we enjoyed it, I feel it would’ve been better and more interesting if we had booked a ticket to go in by ourselves, rather than with a guided tour.

Emanuela was such a great guide! Everyone received listening devices with headphones so that we could hear her loud and clear the entire tour. First, we went inside the Colosseum and she told us its fascinating history along with mockups of what it used to look like to give us a better understanding of the venue. She kept all of us engaged and interested by giving knowledgeable answers and insight. We also saw the Palatine Hill and Roman Forum, which were beautiful as well. At the end, she gave us recommendations on restaurants and things to do in Rome. Great tour, thank you Emanuela!

I booked this City Wonders tour via Expedia for the Colosseum and Roman Forum.

The meeting point was relatively easy to find and the tour started promptly at 10am. Our tour guide was Tiziana, she was very knowledgeable and very funny!

We were advised not to take backpacks into the colosseum but there were other people in the group with backpacks and no issues. You are scanned like in the airport though before entering.

The tour lasted only 2 hours (not 3 as stated on the booking). Tiziana advised you can only visit the lower levels of the colosseum in the summer months. You are given a radio and headphone are provided so you can hear your guide talking even from the back of the group.

Overall the tour was good but I was a little disappointed we only had an hour in the colosseum, particularly given the price we paid (approx £100 for 2 people).

Our guide was great and the views are even better, would have like a little more time in the colosseum.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND booking your tour with this company. When we arrived to at our meeting place the organizer informed us and another couple that we were not on his list and we could not take the tour. We were shuffled to two different other tour companies and finally placed in a tour that was very large and later than we had time for. Consequently we missed our next tour to the Vatican. When I booked the tour I saw a few bad reviews along the same line but thought maybe it was a fluke. It wasn’t, my daughter and I were basically left standing there in Italy speaking a different language as we watched the tour I had booked for $148 leave without us. Extremely frustrating and disappointing. When we were finally placed with another tour company it was large, not going where we had wanted however for a large group our guide was terrific. I don’t remember which company it was but it definitely wasn’t trip advisor or visator.

Maria was amazing. She’s very passionate about what she does and explains everything in great detail. She had a book and showed us what we were going to see so she could explain it better. This helped with the large crowds and being able to hear.
She explained things about the art and the history of the Catholic religion that was understandable. Being Catholic, I appreciate this.
If you do this tour or any Vatican tour…Please respect the Chapel and don’t speak. It really does ruin the experience when everyone is talking. It’s 10 minutes of quiet.

Our guide, Patrick, was incredibly knowledgeable, had a great command of English, and engaged the entire group as he verbally and visually took us on a journey through the centuries. He led us to the best vantage points from which to observe the specific places he was describing and then showed us artist renditions (based on extensive historical research) of how these structures likely looked. It was fascinating. He had a great sense of humor and was very personable with an engaging manner that encouraged questions. [As an example, having been born in New York City, I was particularly (and extremely) happy to learn that the ancient Romans invented graffiti — not New Yorkers!! Grazie!!] We were not rushed and Patrick went to great lengths to ensure our rather large group of 26 was kept intact, as well as informed. Kudos to Patrick for a phenomenal tour and a very memorable day.

The subject of the tour was of course very good (The Colosseum) and our guide provided lots of helpful background information. But our time there began to drag a bit and the guide’s reference to pictures he had in multiple folders began to feel more like a lecture than a visit. The trip was very skewed towards the Colosseum with the Forum feeling like an afterthought and Palatine Hill not featuring at all. The guide though was friendly, humorous and knowledgable.

Lina was an excellent tour guide. Very knowledgeable and striking the right balance of how much to say (some tour guides feel obligated to talk nonstop which is annoying). The tour was informative definitely helped us get through in a timely fashion given the mobs of people that were there.

We had a fantastic tour guide (I didn't catch her name but she was Irish!). She was welcoming, friendly and funny, and didn't make anyone feel rushed at any time. We had plenty of opportunity to take photos and ask questions, and her knowledge of the Colosseum and Roman Forum was amazing. We really enjoyed our tour and would highly recommend to others. We did it at 9am on a Saturday morning which meant it was definitely quieter than on other days, and early in the morning also seemed to help with this. If you're in two minds whether it's worth paying for this tour, it definitely is!

Our guide Ambra was amazing! She was extremely passionate about the material she was talking about and clearly cared about how the group felt including taking the time to keep people in the shade in the hot weather. The tour was perfect in terms of length where we did not feel rushed, and it did not feel too long. Very well done.

This tour should have been better, considering it was a very expensive trip around Ancient Rome. The tour guide was very nice but her English was almost unintelligible. Speaking very quickly, and wearing a mask, simply made the matter worse. The part of the tour covering the palaces was drawn out and tedious, and since it was September the heat was overpowering despite being only about 10.30 am. There was nowhere to sit down and precious little shade, and so by this point it was impossible to enjoy the tour.

This tour is the best value for your money. This tour was very informative and well put together for the time and money spent. The tour was approx 3 hours and our tour guide Sylvia was super. She was fun, caring and informative. She ensured the group stayed together as well as kept us going with a small sugar fix with light candy on a hot roman day to keep us going as well as reminded us when stops were available to refill our water bottles. Additionally, as a native of Rome she had a list in her phone of top restaurants in Rome for us to take pictures of that she recommended while on our stay here in the city. She made this tour top notch.

Great tours through City Wonders
Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palantine Hill (our guide was Guisseppe)
Vatican museums (Ellana)

Our group of five had excellent tours with both Guisseppe and Ellana. Both guides were knowledgeable and passionate about their tours. Extremely informative, animated, and open to questions.

If we had visited those landmarks on our own, we would not have gotten so much out of it. We had quite a few questions along the way, and the guides were always helpful and eager to answer them. They seemed to have a genuine passion for their jobs. I highly recommend City Wonders.

The tour was an experience more brutal than The Year of Six Emperors. Paid for a small group tour - MAX 20 - as we joined the group we were informed that the group was 40 people. Then we met the guide… that was comic. Historical analysis was limited to the fact that Titus had floated up to the clouds upon his death. The tour of the Colosseum consisted mostly of the guide saying “this is the colosseum. It is beautiful”. Don’t book with this company.

We were so excited for this tour with our 20 year old son. The colosseum was amazing but we didn’t learn much because our guide was very difficult to understand and didn’t seem to know a lot. We retained little to no info about Palatine or Forum as we (as well as most of our tour mates) had tuned out after about an hour. We have friends coming next month and have this same tour booked so hopefully they get a different guide.

We had an amazing tour given by Emanuella. She was so knowledgeable and kept everyone engaged. The 3pm tour during July is very hot. She was able to make it very manageable despite the heat. It was great to skip the lines and go straight into the Colosseum. Along with her tour she would show pictures and tell stories of what would happen on a typical day. I would highly recommend taking the tour with her. I also loved having the headphones while she was giving the tour. It helped hear her voice very clearly during the tour

0 out of 5. This was a terrible experience. We didn’t even get to take the tour and I haven’t been refunded. We never received information for where to meet up with our group and I spend 30 minutes on the phone in 95 degree heat with City Wonders customer service trying to locate our guide. They gave us bad directions and our group ended up leaving without us. Stranding myself and my four and seven year old children who had travelled all the way from the US to tour the coliseum. I don’t recommend!

Absolutely AMAZING, best tour we have ever been on. Our tour guide (I think name was Alexander, picture below) was so knowledgeable— he actually worked on the archeological dig for the Roman Forum! Answered all of our questions, even stayed after for about 20 min to finish answering questions. Brought a laminated binder to show drawings of what the buildings and ruins looked like, which really helped us visualize it. You could tell he is super passionate about ancient history, and because he worked on the dig he knew so much more than we could have expected. Would go on the tour again just for him so we could ask more questions!

Major roadblock in Rome due to some official representative visiting. Had to walk the last mile or so as the cabbie had to drop us off. Notified the tour operator that we will be 10-15 mins late via the chat function and left my contact. Rushed to the meeting point - everybody left already. Tried to contact the tour operator via phone and was kept on hold for about 15 mins. Was told that there is no way to enter the Colosseo and join the tour late and was offered a discount of 50% for the next tour. What a joke, 160 EUR down the drain. Was told by another tour guide after that there are tours offered by archaeology students for way less (e.g. coopculture.it). Please avoid this scam.

We had an amazing tour with City wonders and would definitely recommend doing this if your in Rome. Sylvia was our guide she was an archaeologist and was so passionate about the history of the colosseum and Rome . Sylvia was amazing, she explained everything so well and took you back so you could imagine actually being there. When I walked through the gates the Gladiators would have walked through I had goosebumps. It was a fascinating place. It is very hot though so make sure you take lots of water and a hat or an umbrella to shade you from the Sun!

I enjoyed the tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine hill. Giuseppe also had a great sense of humour, personality and very good knowledge and delivered the tour in a fun way which Made it so enjoyable and understandable. Giuseppe was also very approachable with questions etc from other group members. Meeting place was easy to find and organised and the radios/ earphones worked well so I could hear well during the whole tour, tour size I think was approx 22/23 with the radios it worked well as a result. It was nice being left in the Forum at the end of the tour to explore more/ take more photos at own speed. A great day definitely recommend.

A real tour de force - Giuseppe kept us enthralled and engaged for the entire 3 hours with many interesting facts and stories of the Colosseum, Palatine and Forum. He spoke excellent English and his talk was accessible to our 8 and 9 year old children. Very knowledgeable but also humorous and interactive with the audience at the same time. This tour is highly recommended- thank you.

This tour of the colosseum was amazing! Our tour guide Sylvia was brilliant, she was so knowledgeable on the history and architecture. She also was mindful of the heat and always gave us time to stop for water breaks. Overall the tour was very good and worth the money - Sylvia also gave us some restaurant recommendations which was lovely! The colosseum is amazing, and so was walking around the Roman forum and the palatine hill seeing all of the original architecture. I would highly recommend this tour!

Our tour guide Amil was fantastic! Honestly I think she was the best guide we have had during our whole trip in Rome. She was so informative, friendly, very passionate about what she was talking about and kept everyone engaged and laughing. It was very hot and she had us stopping in shade a lot, which was greatly appreciated. Definitely recommend this tour and hopefully you get her as a guide!

This was the exact trip we were looking for. We wanted a knowledgeable guide who could explain the history o the Colosseum and allow us to see the interior. Our guide was an archeologist and explained things very well. The tour of Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum was a bonus and was great to hear the history and a detailed description of what we were seeing and what was once in this spot. We would highly recommend the tour..

I paid nearly 100 dollars per person and could barely understand our “english” speaking guide. I would have expected when signing up for an English speaking guide that we would get someone who is fluent enough to hold a conversation or tell a good anecdote but instead our guide struggled with the language and seemed very inexperienced as an English speaker. Highly disappointed with my experience

Our trip was fantastic. Sylvia our guide, was brilliant! Full of knowledge and good humour as she showed us this jewel of Rome. She looked after us and guided us to plenty of shady spots on a very hot and sunny day, as she told us the history of the Colosseum and it’s audiences and “performers”. She was willing to answer questions and kept us entertained throughout. I would recommend the trip and ask to put in Sylvia’s group.

Not worth the money. We paid $180 for this tour when 2 regular tickets would have been $38. “Skip the line” might help you skip the main line, but you still need to wait in the “skip the line” lines and group gatherings. It took us over 30 minutes to start our tour after we got there and the regular line didn’t look that bad. Plus our 2hour tour was nothing more than we could have walked in 20 minutes.

Also, we paid for the semi private tour group, but had 18 people in the group. I think the sales page says 10-12 people in semi private groups.

Well, the audio guide is not as thorough as I thought it was going to be but the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palpatine Hill all have signs to help you along the way. Skipping the line is a plus. I would recommend using a guide for other places over these places ( The Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palpatine Hill) because I think managing on your own is very enough. It was also a plus that you had a window to visit the other places. I recommend the Colosseum first, then have some lunch, then the Forum and then if you have time and energy Palpatine hill. I found the hill to be the most walking and the least exciting and interesting.
It's a long day so wear good shoes, a hat, sunscreen and bring a water bottles - there are fresh water spouts throughout the area

Guide was superb, clearly passionate about Ronan history. Very informative and engaging throughout. Saw plenty of people ambling about the Colloseum without a guide, but you need a decent guide to inform you of all the history. She chose good stop points throughout the tour. My only little gripe was we paid for group of max 10 people but over 10 in the group, the guide advised group was 10-15. Then be honest on description.

This tour's title is misleading as the experience was so disappointing. I hate writing bad reviews of any business, but in this case, you should know what you're paying for. For starters, there is no tour of Palatine Hill - our tour guide literally pointed to it and said, "That's Palatine Hill. You can go up there on your own later if you want." That was actually it. No exaggeration. She didn't even say what Palatine Hill actually was. I learned more about Palatine Hill from reading the very first paragraph on Wikipedia.

The tour of the Forum lasted less than 10 minutes. The Forum is staggering with thousands of years of history, and we simply stopped at the first two sights near the entrance with minimal information given. It was over practically before it started.

The Colosseum itself is amazing, but this tour did not make it any more so. In fact, it took away from the experience. It was very rushed with very little time given to take photographs. There are information placards all over the place in multiple languages that go into just as much detail as this tour did, if not even more so. Personally, I feel a great tour should help bring a location to life and give you greater historical context. Instead, our guide literally held up cheaply printed pictures to show us what gladiators used to wear. I don't know why we're directing our attention to cheap pictures when we're standing in the epic Colosseum.

I honestly would have rather waited in line than have taken this tour. That said, there were numerous other tours going on from other companies that seemed far more informative with far more engaging guides.

Our tour guide, Sylvia, is an archeologist and was extremely knowledgeable. She had the most infectious enthusiasm. Her passion made every minute of the tour worthwhile. She told stories with visuals and helped bring the colosseum experience to life. After her tour, I definitely gained an interest in Rome's history. In addition, she is a kind human being. She was not only helpful to her group, she was also helpful to people that had questions about City Wonders that she happened to pass by. She is an outstanding human being, and we were very lucky to have gotten her as our guide!

Beware of the tour’s representation of small group. Although your group size may only be 15 people or so, you’re back to back with dozens of other so called “small groups”, so be prepared to being confined to something more like floor concert tickets for the better part of the tour. Website also erroneously listed the guide language to be English only to end up with an Italian only speaking guide.

This was a really great tour - our guide was very knowledgeable and passionate about her subject and this really came across. We learned a lot and it was great to be part of a small group. It is good to be able to miss out on the long lines although sometimes you do wish you could stop and read some of the information available. The instructions for meeting the guide were good but you do need to be aware that there are a lot of people hanging around near the station that will bother you given half a chance. The staff are good at picking you out and ushering you to the guide.
One thing I would mention is that on the information regarding the tour when booking they mention that there will be an option to "upgrade to include the access to the third tier, arena floor and underground chambers—sections of the Colosseum that are either newly opened or typically closed to the general public" - I queried this as when I actually booked that option did not come up and didn't really receive any answer, just the confirmation of the standard tour.
Nevertheless it was a very interesting tour and quite lengthy too - would definitely recommend it to others.

The experience with the amazing Silvia was breathtaking. She was incredibly knowledgeable, always engaged the group and picked the best spots in the shade to protect us from the heat. We spent the entire morning exploring the history of Romes most famous landmark and we were very happy to have someone with so much passion and love for Rome herself, to guide us. Thank you again and do not hesitate book this tour. 5/5.

Simon was an excellent tour guide and made this a fantastic experience!

He did everything right as a guide and more. He was very informative and clearly enjoys the history of this area. He had knowledge of the history, architecture, even some of the upcoming additions and pop culture of who has been there recently. He was also mindful of the entire group. He understood it was a heatwave and coordinated in the appropriate times to get shade and water, as well as use the restrooms. He also let people have their time for photo opportunities around the arena and made sure to note when that was without rushing. He tried to make sure the group could all see and gather around while discussing certain things, and made sure to get the whole group involved with questions or insight. He also helped a couple who got lost from their respective group.

Only possible con that people could have had is if they weren't a fan of Simon's jokes. I enjoyed them, even if I was the butt of some of them! It was all clearly in good fun which added to the experience in my opinion.

Overall, this was a great experience. I highly recommend Simon, he's very knowledgeable and down to earth which made the experience a memorable one.

Our guide Massimo was fantastic. His historical anecdotes and knowledge plus how he took care of a large group on such a hot day was impressive. I would love to take a smaller guided tour with him again in a future trip.

I cannot remember the name of our guide but he was amazing....totally knowledgeable and clearly passionate about the history of Rome.
We had such an amazing time on this tour. It was so interesting and insightful.
We took around 3 hours to get around all three sites and it was three hours and money well spent.
The Colosseum was breathtaking and again our tour guide provided us with some really insightful information and laid some pre conceptions to rest.
Paletine Hill was beautiful and the Roman forum again was absolutely amazing.
It blows your mind to think how the Romans built these vastly huge buildings and monuments when we can't even manage to build houses without them falling apart.
Well worth the money, we'll worth the time.
You will not regret it.
☆☆We couldn't help but return to the Colosseum at night for a few pics,if you gey the chance take a walk for an evening visit you won't be disappointed☆☆

Silvia our guide was really good at ensuring we all got the most out of our visit. She brought to life Roman times in the colosseum and pitched it just right so we were not bombarded with historical facts but could well imagine how it was back then. The pace was good and the fact that we could roam around the Forum at our own pace at the end of the tour was also good. Would definitely recommend this tour

This was just excellent. Fabio was an amazing & knowledgable guide, who was even able to keep my teens engaged. Boundless energy and inspiring passion. Great story teller who was able to take us back hundreds of years. Definitely worth the investment of a guided tour. If you are intent on getting into the "basement" of the arena, note that this is a separate cost. Confirm beforehand.

Inga was an absolute delight to tour the Colosseum with. Her insightful and in-depth knowledge of the place was delivered in a clear and concise manner without ever feeling like she was dragging anything on needlessly. Her calm and relaxed demeanor, paired with her excellent command of English, had us all engrossed in what she was saying (with some rather handy visual aids she brought along) while she gracefully took us through the crowds at each visitor site. Thank you so much, Inga!

Mixed review for 2 reasons. As for the tour, luckily we had Poula ( not sure on the spelling ) as our tour guide, a archaeologist as told to us and she certainly knew her stuff about the Colosseum. A great, informative, engaging tour that went by too quickly, and learned lots of interesting information. The Colosseum itself is nothing short of amazing, takes your breath away at its scale.
As for City Wonders, I'll never use them again as we had booked to do the underground tour which we expressly wanted to do, and we aren't likely to return to Rome anytime soon, but they decided to cancel it 2 days before we arrived, so I had to try and find another tour ASAP before we arrived. After sending several emails requesting a reason for the cancellation, they don't have the decency to reply. I can only take it they deliberately overbook tours and then just cancel at the last minute clearly not giving any consideration on how much it can upset someone's trip. We did, however get the money back. A bitter taste ruining an other wise great time in Rome. Use CIty Tours, be prepared for an upset.............

Our tour guide was brilliant - her knowledge of the colosseum was second to none and the use of images also helped set the scene. It was great to be able to go onto the arena stage too.
However…the meeting point wasn’t the clearest and we had to ask around to find the guide in the blue polo shirt (which guides weren’t wearing). It also wasn’t a tour of all 3 sites - it was a tour of the colosseum only and then a brief introduction to palatine hill and the Roman forum before the tour guide departed. Would recommend taking a picnic to palatine hill if you can as the grounds are stunning and it would be a great place to take some time out.

Nicola was a fantastic guide who really knew his information. He also did a great job timing the stops with the information and finding us shade when possible.

I was also impressed with his English, it's hard to be funny in a second language!

This was the first tour we took during our trip to Rome and I'm so glad we started with this Colosseum tour. It was a good dive into some Roman history so we could enjoy our trip to Rome even more. Nicholas was a great tour guide , very friendly and knowledgable - I wish he could have stayed and led the guided Underground Tour as well rather than someone else. The info he provided when touring the Roman Forum was very insightful and interesting!

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the time slot that we originally picked had to be switched for an earlier time slot, and they were accommodating with us in case we wouldn't have been able to make the new time work.

I booked this tour for me (30 year old) and my mother (61 year old). The meeting spot was exact and once we had all the travelers, we were able to start our tour about 10 minutes early. We had Francesca as our guide and she was great! She is so knowledgeable and was able to answer all questions. She had great pace and let us enjoy the moment of being in the Colosseum and take pictures. The tour of the Colosseum was about an hour and a half and then she took us to the Roman Forum, gave us an overview and let us be on our way. In this tour, the ticket to the Roman Forum is included but that’s where the tour ends, no guided tour through the forum. I would recommend this tour to anyone looking to truest experience the Colosseum.

Miki went above and beyond when touring our small group through the Colesseum, Forum & Palatine Hill. He was personable and remembered everyone’s names, he is so knowledge and passionate about the history and continuously checked in on us. A few of us were feeling a bit tired towards the end from also touring Vatican City earlier that morning, but Miki kept the enthusiasm alive made sure breaks were taken when necessary. Miki, thank you so much for the unforgettable tour through Rome.

My teenage kids said Raphaella was very animated, funny, and knowledgeable. She was considerate of the extreme heat and made sure to provide resting spots in the shade and options to continue the tour or take a break and be picked up later. I 100% agree!

City wonders has a very strict policy on late arrivals. We were very sorry to be lost in the city looking for you because of multiple streets blocked etcetera. We immediately reported the issue by message to trip advisor via the tour operator and never got a response, not even later they responded. We called also that we were lost and we were not even given the opportunity to change to a different time or date. The lady in the customer service was very short, blunt and not even provided any kind of solution. It was just like “ too bad you’re late “. I would recommend booking your tour with another company but not city wonders. No refund was issued and I lost my wasted my whole morning of a beautiful day in Rome.

I'm estimating 150 people were signed up for the tour, and the operator took attendance then separated the people into groups of 24. There were 7-8 different tour guides, so I'd imagine that your experience might depend on the quality of the guide.

Our guide was excellent. It was mid May early morning and it's not clear how much time we saved by 'skip the line' but some I guess. It might have been more had we showed up during the heaviest tourist times, but I'm sure it was some.

The tour guide uses a radio and each member of the tour gets a receiver and earphones. The sound quality was pretty good. You could hear him quite well. He was open to questions and was quite knowledgeable. He did seem to be on a schedule and there were times we were a little rushed.

After he was done I used the Rick Steve's free audio guide which I had downloaded. It was as good, but obviously less interactive.

Horrible tour operator. We had called earlier in the day and mentioned that we were running 10 minutes late due to a planned taxi strike in the city. I called 40 minutes ahead of time and was told that it was ok if we were only 15 minutes late.

I arrived and the tour guides said they could no longer take me and my family. They told me half the tour did not show up but they left anyway. Unfortunately they did not offer a chance to take a later tour and told me it was my loss.

The tour guide that we received was amazing! She was very knowledgable and had lots of interesting facts. She also made the tour very engaging throughout our time at the colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. It was also a great way to skip the long ques and gaining detailed facts and figures.

Our tour guide, Maria, was wonderful. She arrived about 20 minutes late, however.
At the meeting point: No guide was wearing blue City Wonder jackets. One wore a red jacket, one was in a brown sweater, and our guide wore white. No flags were raised. We had to continually ask if we were in correct place. The guides would shrug and point to general area when we asked “Is this City Wonders tour?” They really acted like they didn’t care.
Sad.

It was not small group or skip the line we had over 35ppl and we had to wait in the individual line to get in. Our guide was clueless he didn’t speak when we were walking around the Coliseum only stopped at 3-4 places, we were not in there long and when we asked if we were going back in he said no the Coliseum was for tourists. Like what were we in Rome for? I would suggest finding a better tour with better guides. I’ve had some phenomenal tours in Rome with very knowledgeable guides who really taught you things as you were walking and showing you important items and historical significance. Not this tour.

Enjoyed the tour given by guide Elisabeth. We started at Colosseum (where a toilet break is possible) and many details were given in circa one hour. Everything is well understandable with the headsets.
Then continued towards Forum and Palatine. Here we had to wait 30 minutes to enter. It is a bit crowded, but once in all went fine. First stop was at Palatine hill with interesting explanations. Then the tour continued to Forum. All by all, we recommend this tour and the guide, who is very knowledgeable and speaks English well.

Check in instructions said staff would be easily identifiable by their blue polo shirts. Not one staff member wore the described shirts and there were multiple tour companies in the area. It took us almost 10 minutes to finally determine where our tour company was. Our guide was good but the tour of the colosseum probably could have been done in 1.5 hours and when it came time to do the Roman forum/Palatine Hill, she took us to the entrance and pointed in 2 directions and said "Thank You and Good bye". We were left to visit these 2 large areas alone. The area was as large as the colosseum and definitely needed at least audio guides to make the experience more interesting.

Simon was an amazing tour guide to say the least! He kept a lively pace with funny and interesting historical stories for the colosseum, palatine hill, and Roman forum. He was very informative and interactive with our group, as well as considerate to our needs and physical abilities. We highly recommend booking this tour. Don’t miss out on this experience!

Fabulous tour made special by the tour guide, immense knowledge and sooooo interesting. Everyone should visit the colleseum when in Rome and take in all the history and breathtaking views. The tour lasted about 3 hours, it was very hot walking around the Palatine Hill and Forum but worth it, great views of the city from palatine hill. A must see attraction, definitely our favourite whilst visiting Rome.

This was our first time going to the Colosseum and Roman Forum and it was everything we hoped it would be and more! Our tour guide Inga was super knowledgeable and kind and did a fantastic job of bringing the history of the spaces to life! She was very engaging with the whole group and made our group of 20+ feel more like an intimate tour for a small group. Inga also did a wonderful job of finding shaded spots for our group to stand while she explained the history of the spaces which was much appreciated since it was about 33c/93f outside with no clouds in sight. She also recommended next time we come adding in a tour for the underground of the Colosseum, since it was recently opened and excavated it sells out fast! 10/10 would recommend this tour!

Michail (not sure about the spelling sorry) our tour guide was fantastic. My 5yo son Zackary loved the tour because Michail included him and also entertained him all throughout. We learnt so much and can feel our tour guide’s passion for history but he also made the tour light through his humour on a very hot & sunny day. Thank you Michail.

Our tour guide was Valario. He was very informative and provided the tour with in depth historical content. As he is a professional architect he was able to provide many details that I was not aware of and that I did not come across in reading guidebooks. His explanations allowed us to try and imagine being at the Colosseum as was built, as it hosted events and how it was used for salvage materials. Valario gave a fantastic tour that I highly recommend to anyone visiting the Colosseum or the Roman Forum. It is hard to understand these sites and the life of the inhabitants without a knowledgeable guide explaining what is left to see in the ruins. When in Roman let a Roman like Valiario tell you about this great empire.

The group was very large (24) and we found the guide, Eddy, was very opinionated as opposed to giving us facts/history. We felt as though we were shown through the Colosseum very quickly and we still had to queue for the Forum & Palatine Hill. Disappointed with the experience.

Had a fantastic tour with our guide Laura who was very passionate and informative about Rome. Her knowledge of everything was unbelievable and was able to answer every question we had superbly. We had only arrived in Rome a few hours before and were so glad we booked this tour. If you're only in Rome for a few days I highly recommend booking this tour. It takes about 3 hours or so and you do a fair amount of walking but it's at a slow pace so you won't feel rushed.

This tour is a must-see for all visitors going to Rome. Having the tickets pre-purchased was useful and made the trip much more relaxing as we didn't have to wait in line to get them at the ticket office.

Much praise has to go to our tour guide Fabio who was an absolute delight. His enthusiasm for the tour and his desire to ensure that everyone in the tour group was involved made the trip so enjoyable. This enthusiasm was equally matched by Fabio's vast knowledge of the Colosseum's history, the Roman Forum and Palentine Hill. Definitely my favourite tour guide I've ever had and moreover one of my most favourable tours I've been on too. Top marks to the organisers and many thanks once again for Fabio.

The tour alone is great value for money, but seeing the spectacular views along the way (particularly towards the end of the tour) makes it even more worth it. 10/10 would recommend.

We had a fantastic morning at the Colosseum with our tour guide Giuseppe who spoke excellent English. He was very informative and answered everyone's questions with ease and was very enthusiastic and funny during the tour. We would definitely recommend this tour, we had ear phones which were excellent and took a lot of photographs.

We did the above ground tour with Carlo and it was awesome. He was really well informed, enthusiastic, and welcoming to all of us.

The tour spends most of the time at the colosseum, putting the building in context of the history of the time. Then it goes up to the Palatine hill where you can get great views over Rome and learn about the palace that used to be there. Then it goes into the Roman Forum for just a bit (and you can spend more time there afterward). At the 10am tour it wasn’t too crowded to walk around and Carlo did a good job navigating us.

There is water a few points along the way, but after leaving the colosseum. Rome has free, cold, clean water from ancient aqueducts almost everywhere around the centro historico so bring a refillable water bottle. In the middle of May it was already quite hot and water was needed.

We arrived a couple minutes late and the company was still able to accommodate us, even after 2 of their tour guides were out sick because of Covid. Thank you so much!! Grazie!

Fantastic experience and tour of ancient Rome. Sylvia was an outstanding guide, courteous, insightful and very friendly. Great tour for the family (my kids are 12, 11 and 9), recommend you book in the morning, can get very crowded by noon and hot in the summer. Highly recommend this tour!

Great tour of the colosseum and forum. Very well-paced, the guide ensured we stopped in the shade and explained the context and history of what we were looking at extremely thoroughly. She also helped us find more sites to go visit in the city once the tour had ended. Would recommend! (I believe her name was Maria Louisa. Apologies if I butchered it!)

Amil (hope I spelled it right) was fantastic! She knew her information thoroughly and did a great job at picture painting in order to bring the fascinating history to life! Her enthusiasm was infectious and her love of ancient history was undeniable. She was able to answer all questions, never made us feel rushed, allowed time for pictures, and made it her business to help us all be in awe of the Colosseum and the ancient ruins as much as she was. Highly recommend her and this tour!

The colosseum was awesome, bit I found this ticket way overpriced. Our guide rushed through everything and I felt she couldn’t answer all of our questions. Save yourself some $$ and buy a cheaper ticket.
Also, we went with our 6 month old and didn’t take a stroller because of all the reviews, but I would definitely recommend to take one. Especially when you go during the hot months. We went mid July and yes, there was a lot of people but if you go early you can avoid the masses. Most people help you or give way when you’re with a stroller. The path can be a bit rocky and uneven so just make sure you have a sturdy stroller. The colosseum self is stroller friendly with lifts going to the upper floors. We took a carrier but for us it didn’t really work. Our baby don’t like the carrier so much it she’s not napping so we had to carry her all the way. It was so hot and uncomfortable. Not great. But that is just my experience and opinion.

Our Group’s guide named Sylvia was amazing!! She was very informative during our tour of Colosseum and Roman Forum. Sylvia was very funny and helpful throughout the tour. She even took extra time to go above and beyond at the Palatine Hill to provide us with extra information and recommend local spots to eat afterwards. Highly recommend!

I was hesitant to book this, but I’m glad that I booked it. Emiliano was a wonderful guide breathing life into the history of Rome. For anyone who loves history, this tour covers it all, from the inception to the fall of the Roman Empire! I wish that I read about it more before my trip.
I went in November, thinking it would be fewer people but it was packed, I guess it just goes to show how amazing these monuments are. The only comment was people not coming prepared, this slowed the group. My advice, bring your COVID passports & be on time.

We did the tour with Simon and had a great time he was very entertaining, knowledgeable and gave us a fabulous tour. Even though it was very hot and uncomfortable, he distracted us with his humor and good stories. I would highly recommend taking this tour with Simon!

Paula was amazing! We were initially skeptical of doing a tour, but the description sounded interesting so we thought we'd give it a try and it turned out that the tour was excellent and well worth it. We lucked out with Paula (I think that's how you spell her name - or Paolo?) but she is an archaeologist and offered many fun facts and details - some of which will surprise you! She is also very personable, fun, and an easy person to spend 3 hours with touring the city learning new things. It was definitely worth it and time and money well spent.

We turned up for our tour at 9.50am when the tour was due to depart at 10am and the guide was not there to greet us. We waited for 10 minutes then called the number provided to ask where the tour guide was. We was then told that the tour had been cancelled and we would be given a refund. We had no prior warning or email to say the tour had been cancelled and they actually only took out the money for the tour 48 hours beforehand. We have been given a refund but this was really disappointing as it meant we had to queue for an hour to get a ticket when we had booked skip the line weeks before.

This tour was made great by the tour guide, unfortunately I have forgotten her name. She was such a charismatic, caring, charming and funny Italian lady, I was laughing the whole time during the tour. She had huge enthusiasm for the job, was extremely knowledgeable and was able to answer all the questions, especially the awkward ones from the over excitable Americans on the tour. Overall a great experience and was shown all the major highlights. 10/10

We took the above tour plus the underground tour of the Colosseum, and it was excellent. Christina was our guide--we would highly recommend her! She was so knowledgeable and presented information in a way that was accessible and relaxed. I wasn't sure how interested I was going to be in a tour that lasted a couple of hours, but I thoroughly enjoyed every moment minute. Definitely bring water and sunglasses, and wear your most comfortable shoes.

One of the highlights of our trip was definitely our tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. We cannot say enough positive things about our guide, "Barbara (Blue Eyes)" and the experience she provided! Barbara is a phenomenal guide! She is extremely knowledgeable, educated, speaks fluent English, and really explained so much of the history without ever making us feel rushed. She also really paid attention to meeting the needs of everyone within our group.

We have visited many places and have been on several guided tours and have often felt rushed, had language barriers, and at times have felt like cattle being herded. This experience was hands down 'THE BEST' and most enjoyable we've ever experienced!

Thank you to Barbara and to City Wonders!

It was pretty bad. First our tour at 10:50 w/ arena access was canceled with city wonders last minute. We quickly looked online and found this one with city wonders at 10am. Looked the same but without the area access. It said small group but there was 30+ people. We didn't skip any lines. In fact, we first waited in the group entrance for the colosseum then they told the tour guide to go in the other line. I believe our group was too big for that line. Our guide didn't know english very well. So hard to understand. He couldn't even answer questions some people had because he didn't understand the question. He walked quickly and didn't stop at important things people wanted to see. Probably because it was too crowded. He quickly walked around the colosseum and when we went to the exit everyone was shocked because no one realized we were leaving the colosseum already. People asked to go back because they would have stopped to take some pictures if they would have known. He said that's a tourist area and we will go to more beautiful and important areas. In the Roman Forum & Palatine Hill he did spend a lot more time talking. However most couldn't understand anything he was saying with his strong accent. Most in our group had already taken out their earpiece and started to just read the information next to the sites. Sometimes there would be other tour and my husband and I would listen to their guide to get information. About 5 people from our tour returned their headset and left the tour once we got in. Glad we were able to see the colosseum and Palatine Hill but would never do this tour again. It 100% matters what tour guide you get. We got a really bad one. It did seem like they had a lot of tours going and probably have a ton of guides. Based on other reviews some guides are good. We were in Italy for 2 weeks and did a totally of 7 tours while there. This one was the only one I regret. Wish we either did it ourselves or went with a private tour.

Alberto was excellent as our tour host. He provided such interesting history about the colosseum, the Roman forum and the emperor’s palace. It was refreshing to hear a tour host who speaks slow and clear to get his points across.

Paula was our guide, and we learned so much about the history of the Colosseum and the surrounding area! I had no idea how or why the structure was there, but learned its history with help of the learned tour guide Paula! (Who knew arena meant sand - and how it was used!) 😳 In addition to all of the fascinating information, I appreciated the pace of the tour (Paula did not rush, and since there was some stair and hill climbing, this was important and greatly appreciated!). I also enjoyed her reference to Rome as “our city.” Somehow that made all the information feel personal to her, and that she was sharing it with our group. I loved the special surprises on the tour - special spots that Paula shared for the perfect photo or the perfect view! Special memories were made today - thank you Paula!
