Sara our tour guide was an absolute delight. Very informative and just an all round star! She recommended us different things to do in rome, and her recommendations have been excellent. During the tour, she was very engaging and went out of her way to get the whole group involved. I would definitely recommend!

The Colosseum is a must-see attraction when visiting Rome. Initially we had planned to visit the Colosseum on our own, but we were not able to get entry tickets ahead of time. Fortunately, we were able to book a tour with City Wonders, and it was worth it. Our tour guide, Giuseppe, was great! He brought the history of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill to life. He is very knowledgeable and professional. My family and I really enjoyed the tour, and we would recommend it.

Lydia, our Liv Tour Guide, was absolutely the best. We were so pleased with her passionate fund of knowledge. The entire tour exceeded our expectations. The history of the area, history of the development of Rome, and what was involved with the performances that occurred in the Colosseum amazed us. Another home run for LIV tours.

Tour guide was nice. But radios didn’t work so we pretty much couldn’t hear anything. And we ended up way behind schedule due to some needy tour members who kept asking basic questions and the guide didn’t know how to manage them. So we ended up just turning in our non operable radios and leaving the group and touring the forum on our own (as did some other people). To be honest, the experience was the most painful of our two weeks in Italy.

We have taken a lot of tours across the world but this was by far the best ever tour. Our guide Sylvia was so knowledgeable, enthusiastic and the most amazing guide we have ever had and what she doesn’t know about Rome isn’t worth knowing. Cannot recommend her tour of the Colosseum more highly as it was such a wonderful experience. We walked for miles but she made it such an exciting experience we didn’t even notice and had us hanging on ever word she said. I felt like I was hundreds of years in the past experiencing what the Romans experienced in the Colosseum, such an amazing tour….thank you Sylvia….an experience of a lifetime worth more than money xxx

Thank you for the great tour Marianella (I hope I spelled it right, I’m sorry if I didn’t)

This tour was fun and informative and definitely paced well. There are always a ton of people going to the colosseum in the day so you cannot control that and so of course that’s when more people will be there. When going at night there is definitely a lot less people and I presume the same for the morning. We were able to take lots of photos and she always showed us the best panoramas. She told us how there use to be so many more colosseum visitors before and I’m glad it’s not like before and tickets are required to enter. The best part was that you could stay and walk about the Roman Forum and Palatine hill even after the tour and until closing if you wanted to. We were glad we had this experience because we learned so much from it.

I had a flight delay and was going to be arriving late. I informed them of this 8 hours before and they informed me there is no refunds. I explained to them the situation beyond my control. They advised there was nothing they can do other than give me another day by paying at least for one more person. I asked for a manager of some sort and they disregarded my request.

I understand business but this was beyond my control. Unfortunately I’ll have to dispute this charge instead to obtain a refund.

We LOVED this tour!!!! Our guide Paula was funny, engaging and informative. She gave us enough time to take pictures but also spent the time to explain the history and answer our questions. Even my husband who is not a fan of history was into the tour. We did not feel rushed. As you can imagine the coloseeum can be very crowded but she managed to find pockets where we could all stand around and listen and not feel crammed. Highly recommend! Rome is a huge city and these historical sites are large. It is difficult to tour it on your own. Highly recommend!!!

Great and informative tour. Our guide really knew his stuff. He was engaging and phenomenally knowledgeable. We would definitely recommend the tour as there is so much history and one needs a professional to guide you through.

Guide was very good, but paid a premium for "exclusive access to the Colosseum floor". Not sure it was worth it. It was hot and crowded and I know I'll never come back to Europe in the Summer or even early fall. Do yourself a favor and come in the off season it you really want to enjoy the antiquities.

Rosa was a very good guide, and very knowledgeable. In spite of the crowds at the Colosseum, we stopped at several points along the way, and we were given some time to roam around free and take photos (not something you get on many Rome tours).
The only downside is that you should know that Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are NOT included in the GUIDED part of the tour. After the Colosseum, your guide will just leave you in front of the Roman Forum and you are free to explore that and Palatine Hill on your own. (This may not be clear to everyone reading the description at a glance.)

Arrived at the office near the venue at 10am as per email received once paid online.

Group was approx 20 in size and the tour starts with Palintine Hill, Roman Villa and then the Colliseum

Our guide was Italian but had excellent English and clearly very passionate about what she did and worked so hard for iver 4 hours explaining and describing every detail on our tour.

For approx £40 each, u just wont get a better value for money tour than this.

I'm glad I took the 0900 tour because by the end of the 3hrs, it was getting warm. A lot of history. Sometimes Anna would mumble making it hard to understand her. Had 2 bathroom breaks and could also buy drinks. Interesting seeing the inside of the Colussem.

I really enjoyed this tour. The guide (I think her name was Marina) was really knowledgeable and friendly. I felt like we covered every part of the Colosseum and the surrounding area up Palatine Hill. The pace of the tour was really good, I'm not the fittest of people and I was able to keep up with the walking around.

It was a really hot day when we had our tour and Marina made sure we stopped for water and a toilet break for those that may have needed it. We also had time to take pictures and have a little explore of our own in certain areas too.

I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to visit the Colosseum and have a guided tour.

My partner took a funny turn during the beginning of our tour. As a result, our priority was to sit down and drink water in the very hot weather, leaving the tour behind. When my partner began to feel better, we asked to join another City wonder tour, with a guide named Simone. The guide graciously allowed us to join the tour, had an amazing sense of humour, and really made us all feel welcome. He was very knowledgable and demonstrated a strong sense of humour. Our guide also graciously allowed us to join the tour with the Forum and Palatine Hill, which he did not have to do as we were not officially in his group. As a guide, we were allowed to experience a snapshot of a pivotal time in Rome’s history and to envision an experience in Rome’s most famous amphitheatre.

Mama G was a great and passionate tour guide , who showed her local pride and knowledge. The tour meeting point was easy to find, although she was not wearing a blue polo as mentioned in the instructions. Currently due to covid, a separate tour guide from the colosseum is giving the underground and colosseum tour, but city wonders arranges the handoff. City wonders covered the palantine hill and Roman forum first. The Underground tour is a must see!

Overall an ok experience. Personally the Colosseum didn't live up to expectations, there was too much looking at exhibitions inside the structure and not enough outside in the actual Colosseum. It felt very much like a museum rather than the actual building.

Now, the good part. The Roman Forum part of the tour was absolutely stunning, the guide was so knowledgeable and parts of it were mindblowing. Seeing the rock on which Cesar's body was burned was a particular highlight for me. Some of the views at the top of Palatine Hill were also breathtaking. If I were to ever go back to Rome, I would skip the Colosseum and do The Roman Forum and spend more time here.

Super efficient tour from start to finish. The instructions given beforehand were clear so we found the meeting point easily and were allocated to our guide, Laura. She was fabulous - upbeat, engaging and so interesting to listen to. The Colosseum is incredible but it was Laura’s extra facts and snippets of detail that made the trip so memorable. If Laura ever considers a career change she’d make the perfect history teacher. She absolutely brings things to life and she makes you want to know more. A real must do tour - and if you get Laura as your guide you’re in for a treat.

Our guide, Julia, was amazing! We had such a great time and we were so glad we choose a guide as opposed to going through the process of getting a ticket individually and going through the crowds alone. This tour helps you get to the places you want to go in a relaxed and much easier manner. Highly recommend!!

I'd like to give this a massive review but I can't simply because 20 minutes before my tour started I got an email to say it was cancelled. I was already at the meeting point and told by an agent that my booking was cancelled and I would get a refund.. too late I'm here for the tour!!!

I was offered a later tour at 2pm and asked for my credit card details in a busy street to pass down the phone.. Don't think so pal..

So as we walk away the agent took us by the arm and said he would put us on the end of the tour we should have been on free and that we could do our own thing once Inside. As we approached the tour we were handed radios for the tour ..seemed we had the tour after all .

Well what can I say the guide was amazing she was so knowledgeable about everything so passionate and pointed out a lot if things a normal guide wouldn't like different levels of ancient Rome and such. It was a fantastic tour and thoroughly enjoyed ..

Turns out we got it for free when we got home I had a refund !!!

Our tour guide, Giovanna (Mama G), took great care of our group and shared a wealth of knowledge about the Colosseum/Palatine Hill/The Forum while keeping it fun and energetic. It was a bit hectic with so many other tour groups, but she did a good job of keeping tabs on everyone to make sure no one was left behind. Great information and detail we would have otherwise not gotten from a self-guided tour. Would highly recommend!

Our guide Giuseppe was brilliant and was very informative, insightful and fun to listen to him talk about Ancient Rome. The entire tour was excellent from start to finish and he provided a great background to the specific places, and gave opportunities to ask questions.

It was our first visit to Rome and the city is amazing, but this tour made it an unforgettable trip and will be returning again for future tours.

Thanks Giuseppe!

Really informative tour. Our guide Louise was very knowledgable, caring to the group, making sure all were included and was really friendly. The tour was very well organised, making sure all of our headphones worked well before we left and it was about the right amount of time - we were a large family of ages ranging from 16 to 77 and we all really enjoyed it.

Our tour guide, Eddy was excellent! He is very knowledgeable and it show how mych he enjoys what he does. Our tour was at 3 PM in the afternoon and despite the extreme temperatures he made it fun so we didn’t notice much how hot it was outside. Eddy was very considerate of our needs and kept us in the shade as much as he could, pointed to water fountains and restrooms.
Eddy made it so interesting by throwing funny remarks throughout the tour. Strongly recommend!

This tour was fantastic! Although there were, what seemed like, a gazillion people gathering to see the Colosseum, the tour leaders quickly got us together with our guide and off to the front of the line. We saved hours of line-waiting and skated through pretty quickly. Our guide was patient and explained the process very clearly, so we all knew what to do and where to go. She was also incredibly knowledgeable as her other job is as an archeologist...so we really felt like we were getting an insider's tour. It was engaging and kept us riveted with tales of yore and information that doesn't always come from a book. When we moved on to the Forum and Palatine Hill, we got to see real archeological digs in action, too! I never felt rushed and although the tour was long, it kept me interested the entire time. I'd absolutely recommend this to anyone who wants a deeper exploration of these historical giants.

Great tour with Assan. Knowledgeable and I insightful historical I formation providing comparisons of size and volume to modern day so more impactful a learning for kids and adults a like. Great that tour some was smaller Luke tour indicated. Great overall experience - thank you

Simone ensured that the tour was both entertaining and informative. Rather than offering a dry tour to tourists, Simone was simply showing a few friends around his city. Though Rome is beautiful, his company made our time more enjoyable.

We loved our small group tour with access to the arena floor. Elizabeth was a fantastic tour guide with an incredible amount of knowledge and passion on the subject. Her enthusiasm was infectious and despite the heat, we loved every moment! Skipping the lines and having access to areas only available to tours was well worth the extra money. Would highly recommend this experience!

Of course the subject matter was extremely interesting, but our tour guide Alessandro made it the best tour ever. I am hearing impaired and I heard every word through the headset provided. He is very knowledgeable and his delivery was stellar. Nicely paced, a wealth of information, and all in his own words. No typical monotone or bored voice. Just great and interesting facts about whatever we were looking at and one could tell it interested him as well. He showed pictures throughout the tour of what the buildings would have looked like. He made sure every person on the tour saw them. A long three hours mostly in the hot sun, so when he came to a place he knew we would circle back to, he suggested that any person who wanted to could rest in the shade for so many minutes until the group returned. A very knowledgeable and kind man. Oh, the directions to the pickup place stated to meet at Largo Gaetana above the second floor of the Metro line B. That is a square and you have to meet on the second level. We didn’t understand that and thought it was the second floor of a building. Have a great time. The small group is worth it.

So glad we booked a tour, the Colosseum/Forum entry area is big, and confusing. We met up with our guide Silvia very easily, the directions were super clear, and we left promptly at 12:30. Our group was 20 people, which was totally fine, as the audio devices allowed us to hear Sylvia with no problem, even if far from her. She was super knowledgeable, friendly, funny, and sweet to the young kids in the group, who I suspect found it hard to stay interested. We started at the Forum, and Palatine Hills, and then went to the Colosseum, whole tour was two hours, which was plenty given how hot it was. We did get onto the floor of the Colosseum, which was great. CityTours did push our time back in an hour, which was no problem for us, but maybe wouldn’t have been great if you had plans on the back end. But first rate tour experience, would highly recommend.

Thank you Amil for such a great tour! You made everything so interesting and you could really tell you have a passion for Roman History. Answered all our questions, excellent tour guide! This was definitely the highlight of our trip! Would highly recommend to anyone. The whole experience was stress free, skipped all the queues and got straight into the colosseum.

The tour to the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill was amazing. Booked using link on Trip Advisor. Guide was Selena. Very well educated on Romes history.
We did the Vatican first and then the Colosseum but I would reverse that order if going again. It is a total waste of time going to these places if you dont go with a guide as I feel a person should know what they are looking at. No queues anywhere and it was just great for us. Feel sorry for the Restaurants, busses, taxis etc. As tourism is dead here at the moment.

This tour is an absolute must. It was filled with information without feeling overloaded or rushed. Worth the money because I’m sure if I would have done the self guided tour, I would not have learned anything or even known what I was looking at. HIGHLY recommend.

This was a fantastic tour! Our tour guide, Silvia Rana, was AMAZING!! Very informative, friendly, helpful, and very funny! :) She kept the entire tour very interested in the history and stories she shared. Highly recommend for families and couples. She even went the extra mile by staying with some of us and continuing to the second site and by providing us with a great list of foods to try while in Rome. We had a wonderful time! Thank you again Silvia!

Tour was excellent! We had Stephanie as our guide. She had a great personality and a wonderful way of relating to the diverse group that we were, from all different parts of the world. She pointed out things that I would never notice if I were on my own. She also was able to tell the history in a way that made it came alive and made it relevant to our lives. Thank you!

Sarafina was amazing and extremely knowledgeable. If you’re very interested in both the Roman Forum and the Colosseum equally, I’d maybe recommend booking a separate tour for each. Although this tour was very thorough and overall amazing, we did have to skip over some parts for time’s sake, which was totally understandable. Great value for the price. Many thanks to Sarafina, she made the experience awesome!

Perhaps there’s a different understanding of “small group” in Italy, but 44 people per group makes a tour utterly useless.

The tour was horribly organized - we started the tour 1.5 hours late, were forced to wait during the tour due to operator error with number of guests/tickets. If you book this tour in the morning, make sure you don’t plan anything for the rest of the day - you’ll have to leave after the colosseum (1/3 of the tour) if you plan to abide by the stated tour time.

The guide was lovely and knowledgeable enough, but the company seems to be cutting corners. While the review states it should be 20 people or less, our group was 26 people (enough for two reasonably sized groups.

The large group made it difficult to navigate the entire group through the Colosseum as we could only stand in certain spots without blocking everyone else. It also made the tour feel very impersonal.

Given there was no wait (and thus no line to skip), there was seemingly little difference between this tour and, say, downloading an audio guide and just entering without a guide. At least without the guide, one could go at their own pace.

Again, I must say that the guide was lovely. Just a bit upset at the company for misrepresenting the tour by saying it would be 20 people or less.

Our guide Anna was great - very friendly and knowledgeable. Ask for her if you have the choice! The Colosseum tour was impressive and I highly recommend it.

The downside was the Palatine Hill & Forum - to say it’s brief is an understatement. They get you through the gate and give a 5’ overview and that’s it - it’s in you to wander around and see it (the no tour guide). I think they could’ve been more clear that this is basically guided tour of the Colosseum and nothing else.

I still recommend the package but if you want more of a guided experience oh Palatine & the Forum you’ll want to look elsewhere.

The coliseum is wonderful. Do not miss going inside. The ticket for the arena floor is silly. It does grant much more access than a regular ticket. But I would have loved to see the underground area where the staging of animals and gladiators took place. The guide was wonderful and was best for us but you do go a bit faster than I would have preferred. But it was already very long with Pallentine hill and the forum. All were really worth the price.

We went on the tour as a family of four and our group consisted of 15 people in total. We were guided by Paula who was an amazing guide. Even though it was a long tour with lots of walking, Paula really made it worth the tired legs. She had amazing knowledge throughout and it was so insightful to see these great landmarks with the complementary story.

This is my second time on this tour and there was somethings I learned. However, the tour was heavy on architecture and not the stories behind why the city was built. Also missing was the stories of who the GODS were or who created the city. We received that in the first tour.

Our guide, Valero (hope I got it right) was very knowledgeable and was able to share many new data points as we walked the coliseum and outside areas. He was able to keep our group together in the chaos and allow us time for photos and toilet breaks.

Fair warning! You will be on your feet for what seems like ages. Steps are steep, worn, slick, and often no handrails. Streets are rough, no benches, loose pavers/cobblestones, and no protection from the elements.

People on carts, wheelchairs, crutches, canes, or difficulty walking, should expect a long, hard day.

You will exceed your steps quota easily! But it is worth it.

Amazing tour. Our tour guide, Dorianna, spoke excellent English and was an archeologist on the site so was full of knowledge. She went at a good pace and we were given earphones so we could hear her clearly without standing next to her. Take a water bottle as you can keep refilling this as you go round. It's 3 hours on uneven ground so make sure your feet at comfortable. Well worth the money, but glad I didn't do this and the Vatican tour on the same day.

Tour guide was brilliant new what she was taking about. Passionate about her country.
Lots of steps and walking which is exactly what we expected.
Really enjoyed the tour and it was around 3 hours. Only thing I would advise is lots of people also did the Vatican City tour in the same day. Where as we did it over two days.
Doing the Vatican City tour and colosseum tour in one day would be far to much as there is no time for lunch as you go from one side of the city to the other. So glad we did it over two days!

This was such a fantastic tour and well worth the money. Our guide Marco provided such thoughtful detailed information about the Colosseum, palatine hill and the Roman forum as well as historical information related to what was in view. He is a complete professional and really makes you feel comfortable. He brought a class to life with his detailed, clear information . Marco provided excellent stops to stay covered in the shade, find water and clean bathroom breaks during the 3 hour tour. My no longer teen son was really impressed with the information and despite the heat of a Roman July, we’re so pleased with this tour. Meeting point can be tricky but really is a great spot. Walk INTO the station and immediately left under the sign for Largo Agnesi, go up the stairs and back outside. Then you made it! Highly recommend this tour and Marco! Grazie!!!

Very comprehensive tour with our wonderful tour guide Amil. She was very knowledgeable, and even as a history teacher I learned lots of new things! Entry to the colosseum was quick and easy which afforded entry onto the arena floor, from where you get a real understanding of the sheer scale of the building. Amil was more than happy to take photos and ensured she paused at great photo spots. She then took us across to the forum, and after giving us a quick overview we were free to explore on our own.

Amil was PHENOMENAL! She moved at a great pace through the sites, found spots in the shade, and provided great ‘local’ tips. Her enthusiasm and knowledge made the entire tour even more memorable.

I’ll definitely be back for a night tour of the Colosseum!

Our guide was Rosaria and she was great. Full of knowledge and interesting stories. Only downfall for me was that we were not given a tour of the Forum, we were brought in and left to look around ourselves. We thought having paid €180 that we would be given a guided tour of both. Either way I would highly recommend

What a wonderful tour with Nic. His knowledge, openness and attention to detail made our trip to the Flavian Theatre and the Forum so interesting and memorable. Our tour was two and a half hours long but felt much shorter because it was so enjoyable. Nic answered questions at intervals and made everyone feel very welcome at the beginning too. I will recommend this particular tour to friends who visit Rome in the future

Eddy was a very knowledgeable tour guide who took us round the colesseum (beating the queues) and gave us great insight into the historic building. We then went onto Roman forum and Palatine hill where his charismatic approach kept us going for the 3 hours. Really worthwhile booking this tour!

We had skipped the Colosseum-Tour on our first trip to Rome, so now we decided to finally visit the ruins in a semi private Tour and it was amazing!
Our guide Giuseppe was well informed and took us to a journey through the ancient Rome and its ruins, giving us insight and many stories and anecdotes. His enthusiasm and knowledge were the cherry on top of an amazing tour. We will definitely come again!
Also maybe good to know: Everything went very smoothly. The tours of city wonders are well organized and so are their guides. The headphones work perfectly and all entrances are easy to access and quickly passed.

Endlich ins Kolosseum!
Wir hatten diese Tour auf unserer ersten Romreise nicht gebucht und waren nun fasziniert von der Geschichte und den vielen unglaublichen Ruinen und den Anekdoten, die unser Guide Giuseppe uns erzählt hat. Eine wirklich absolut empfehlenswerte Tour mit einem großartigen und sehr gut informierten Guide!

This was the only way to get morning tickets. I’m guessing the tours buy them up and if you want to stay out of heat, you must do the tour. Our tour guide spoke English, but difficult to understand. If you are hearing impaired, you will not understand any of the dialogue.
It is lots and lots of walking and stairs. If you are not capable, do not do this tour. We saw one lady fall on the steps. There was an elevator but it was never offered to anyone that might have used it in our group. We did have 5 or so out of our 22 that would have taken advantage of elevator!
I would have preferred to download Rick Stevie’s tour and done it on my own.

Sara from City Wonders was a fabulous guide. As an archaeologist who has worked on the excavation site, and also is working on the C-line for the metro, she has great insight to the goings-on at the Colosseum. While we did not have time to explore all the artifacts on display there, she explained, while ancient, they did not come from the Colosseum but were on loan from other organizations, so she didn't take the time for them. We were given ample time for photos and she had great photos and renderings of past likenesses of the area. She had much knowledge about the Roman Forum and explained to us a lot of the history of the area. The view from Palatine Hill where the tour concludes was amazing, and we were allowed plenty of time after the tour to explore that area if we wished. Lots of walking and stairs; particularly steep steps in the Colosseum, and more steps going up Palatine Hill. Highly recommend!

My wife and I recently visited Venice, Florence and Rome for our Honeymoon and picking City Wonders Tours was probably the best decision we made. Beginning with Florence we did a Half Day Tour with Angelo and he was awesome! He definitely kept our attention for the tour with his vast knowledge of the city and the background regarding the statue of David. When we went to Rome we did the Colosseum/Roman Forum tour with Louise and she was so much fun! she was funny, sweet and had the best stories! The Best of Rome tour with Giuseppe was also a must do. He made sure to give us bathroom breaks and photo opportunity breaks and made the tour worth it after a long day at the Colosseum.

Joanna was our tour operator and was a very knowledgeable guide. Joanna took us on a tour of the Roman Forum and into the Colosseum. We highly recommend this tour - you won't be disappointed but bring your walk shoes. October was a good time of year to visit - weather was perfect and although there were a lot of people, it was manageable - the only real congestion was the stairs in the Colosseum.

Gloria was our tour guide (we believe it was her first day working for City Wonders) and she did a fantastic job! So informative, so helpful and patient. She answered every question and was very easy-going - did not feel like we were rushed. We took our tour early in the morning which meant the Colosseum was not too busy and no queues so you could take your time. Fantastic views and experience - would definitely recommend!

The tour guide was obviously very knowledgeable but all in all I was disappointed with this tour.
Firstly our guide walked VERY slowly, uncomfortably so and (especially in the Colosseum) felt like we were just in people's way.
Secondly although I guide obviously knew alot about the history, he said too much and I didn't take in the vast majority of what he said.
In the Roman Forum I wanted to look and explore far more than we were shown. I could have gone round after the tour ended but by that point I needed a stiff drink so we made a swift exit to the nearest bar.
This would have been far better as an audio guide that could have been taken at your own pace.
I

Amazing tour - highly recommend. Sara our guide was fantastic - so friendly, well spoken, enthusiastic, knowledgeable and efficient.

This was our first tour in Rome and set the bar very high for future tours. None of our other tours compared.

The tour was run very efficiently - we showed up as instructed and were promptly assigned a group and given a headset to hear better throughout the tour. The only lines were the security lines and these weren’t super long.

Sara used the time we had on the tour to provide us with interesting information and always kept track of all participants when moving around and during breaks. It was greatly appreciated that she always made sure everyone had regrouped before she began sharing important facts or walked to another area. This is something other tour guides failed to do.

Sara encouraged questions and made the tour a great experience. This tour was an excellent way to learn about the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum. I am so glad we picked this tour! Thanks Sara!

Really great way of seeing the Colleseum! Our guide Sarah was fantastic and had a really good knowledge of the history. The only downside was we had to queue for over an hour to get into Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum which meant the tour had overrun and it felt a bit rushed at the end. Overall a great tour and we would definitely do ut again!

This tour was amazing. Our guide was Eddy and I have to say the his knowledge was incredible. Eddy made the tour fun and entertaining while giving us allot of history. My son and I were blown away and this was the best thing we did in Rome.
I would highly recommend people use this tour, it really is worth every penny.
I feel it would be impossible to learn about these places without one, and skipping the line is awesome. Thank you very much.

If you visit in Summer make certain you have wide brimmed hat and sunglasses. Great experience but is very crowded and heat and light reflects off of stones. Also glad that I had a bottle of water with me.

It was a great tour that had many bumps along the way, since there are so many tourists at the same time in the same place.
Our tour guide had to maneuver our group while giving lots of information and details about the history everywhere.
Whenever you go, keep in mind not everything will be under their control and the colosseum is not accessible-friendly.

We had Silvia as our tour guide and she was wonderful! She was very informative and has such a great personality. She knew the answers to all the questions and even handled a difficult person on the tour really well. It was very hot the day we toured, but still well worth it. I highly recommend this tour.

This was a fascinating insight into a bygone age and I thoroughly enjoyed it. It surprised me just how busy it was and at times it made listening to the guide difficult. However, it is a site not to be missed. Only downside is if you miss the toilet at the beginning, your next opportunity is in the Forum and there was one toilet for M and one for F, so the queue was a long one!

Was a semiprivate (around 13 people). First part of the tour was really crowded, the guide told me that in the early morning is totally better. Anyway the Colosseum is amazing and our guide Nick was really knowledgeable.

We went with City Wonders and our tour guide Alba was amazing. She was very informative and explained everything with such excitement that you could tell she really loved her job. Her enthusiasm made you want to hear from her. Highly recommend.

Our tour guide Jess was fantastic, informative and entertaining. She was friendly and keen to answer all questions. We spent plenty time at all three destinations and had photo opportunities a plenty.
The queues were long and even longer when we left, so glad we skipped the queues, would highly recommend this experience.

Tour did not deliver what was booked. Colosseum was great, but the tour only spent very short time at Roman forum and missed out Plalatine hill completely, so payed for stuff that didn’t happen. The guide gave a very vague explanation for this, saying the colosseum timing had to be changed so we don’t have time for the other things, rather disappointing. Maybe book with a different company for same tour.

I had a great experience on this tour and felt immersed in the history of Rome. Our tour guide was clearly passionate about the history and she supplemented her teaching with pictures and diagrams that help to illustrate the history which really made a difference. The only reason I rated the tour 4/5 is because the group was much larger than I had expected which made it less engaging.

So much great information. Fabio was an outstanding host. Start and end perfectly on time. I’d recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see and get historic details of the coliseum and Palantine Hill. Outstanding afternoon!

Our guide did not have a command of English sufficient to create a compelling experience. She repeated the same facts MANY times and did not have much to add to the basic facts.
We bailed out after half the tour. Just too hard to understand her and not an enjoyable experience.

it was not realy a "small group" with 20 people. The guide was always running, so that we could not take a picture! The Colosseum is one of the most visited places we saw in Rome. And it was real overcrowded. We stopped the tour and didn`t took part till the end. It was also difficult, to listen the voice of the guide.....

Tour was advertised as being 20 person but our group was 31+. That size group could not manuveur in the crowded colussuem. The guide did not take us to the lower level to look down in the underground area and several folks asked to see it as he was exiting the area. It was obvious that many of us were upset to not look down from the lower level

The tour guide spoke broken English with a heavy accent and we barely understood anything he said. We couldn't tell if he was knowledgeable since he struggled to communicate with us.

Some left in the middle of the tour and we wished we had as well.

I was very disappointed in this tour. The company allowed approximately 40 people to join the small group tour that had a maximum of 20 people. The guide was a very nice person, but was not very knowledgeable in the Colosseum or the forum and struggled with English. The company was through city wonder tours. I would not recommend this tour.

Our guide was incredible with so much knowledge and many memorable facts and tales. She helped us navigate through the throngs of people and brought the history of this fascinating and spectacular part of Rome alive. I highly recommend this tour. Money well spent.

The meeting area was hard to find. I could not find a way up to the 2nd floor, and the map was misleading, so I missed my group. There were also literally 10 other people who were on the same boat but the staff was extremely rude to us. He screamed at us and cursed at us. Long haired blonde Italian person. I called the office but they told me to beg my way into the next group. Which was 5 hours later. Do not go with them! They hate tourists.

Absolutely loved our tour. Big Mama G (as she called herself) was very engaging. She made sure she introduced herself to everyone and got to know what they wanted to get from the trip.
Would definitely recommend this trip to everyone. Perhaps next time would invest in the tour including the dungeons.

I’m not usually the type of person to book a guided tour but some friends really recommended the Colosseum and Roman Forum tour during my visit to Rome. From a purely practical level, the tour was worth it because we bypassed the very long, typical lines to enter the sites. The tour was fantastic—our guide Giuseppe was extremely knowledgeable and shared many facts about the culture, economics, and history of these places. He was able to explain small details in the structures and also the linguistic relationships between these historical activities and our modern English language. In addition, our tour guide had a good sense of humor that made the afternoon feel light and entertaining. Highly recommend this tour if you have an afternoon to do it!

We weren't happy with the quality of tour and specifically tour guide. Our tour guide seemed to lack interest and excitement in providing information. So it was very difficult to stay engaged. Also she was constantly missing the tickets/vouchers to enter the sites and we wasted so much time there. Overall wasn't happy with our experience.

We just arrived from Barcelona and have been doing long, 3 hour historical tours. We half wanted to cancel because we were so tired. However, our guide Mateo made us grateful we chose to go. He was so polite, energetic and funny. He took his time to explain everything, was not rushed and even threw in a few quips that taught us a few things about Roman culture (then and now) as well. You can tell when a person respects and appreciate what they’re teaching and that’s Mateo. He definitely took us on a journey through an ancient experience. He made this hot, exhausting day enjoyable. Extra kudos for recommending one of our now favorite spots to eat in Rome and for the time to take great pictures. Ask him about his photography skills. 😬

This was an amazing experience. Our guide Silvia Rana was very friendly, very attentive, very knowledgeable, and her hospitality was of the highest quality. It was a wonderful tour with a wonderful guide, it was a magical experience. My family and I are definitely doing it again in the nearest future highly recommend others to take this tour.

Without a doubt the best and most worthwhile guided tour in Rome. We had Patrick who was very knowledgeable and easy to listen to. Looking at ruins is not easy but he put everything into context and I’d thoroughly recommend this one.

Paula was excellent. Her knowledge was second to none. My children understood her perfectly and were able to engage well. Unfortunately, the Americans in the group complained about our guide's accent and explained that they really couldn't understand her. They left early and we were fortunate to have Paula's experience for a further hour. Here's a suggestion - if you plan to book an English tour, be sure you can understand English first.

A few days ago I mistakenly posted my review from a City Wonders tour of the Vatican here on the Colosseum Tour. I regret the mistake, as the experience was significantly better at the Colosseum. I deleted my previous review that was made in error, and here is my review of the Colosseum:

Silvia Rana was an EXCELLENT guide. I was thrilled to find out that she actually has a PhD in Archeology, which was certainly part of the reason she was so good.

She was kind, professional, very personable, and clearly cared about the subject matter and the people on the tour.

She even gave us more time than what was planned! Excellent experience

We booked the Colosseum, forum and Palatine hill tour. Our guide Sarah was really informative and looked after our grip during the tour.
She was really knowledgeable and answered all of our questions with ease.
We really enjoyed the tour and would recommend it to others

We took this informative and interesting tour of the Colosseum with access to Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum with Inga. She paused at the appropriate times to give us a little history lesson before showing us the corresponding sights. Her information and visual images really helped us to better understand what happened during this time. I definitely recommend getting access to see the arena floor. It was a wonderful experience and one that is greatly enhanced with a knowledgeable guide.

If you are thinking about visiting solo or with an audio guide, don’t. I’ve done both and I think a tour guide makes the experience way better.

Nick was a great tour guide. Very knowledgeable, made jokes, and was available for every question. Moreover, he pointed where the water fountains were all the time, which are an absolute must to survive the day.

I would not recommend this tour to anyone.

The guide didn't provide us much information on the history and it felt very generic. We spent most of the time of our tour walking around and taking pictures. We felt like we missed a lot of elements from the colosseum as it was rushed.

All in all the tour duration was less than 1.5hours. To our surprise when the tour was done we were told by the guide we could not go back in.

I got in touch with customer service explaining the situation and requesting a partial refund, and absolutely no effort was done.

My recommendation would be to

Too much to see and way to busy to do this on your own. Have a skip the line tour helped us make sure we saw the best things to see without wasting time trying to figure out what we were looking at. We got in faster, clear presentations as we each got earphone so no matter where you were looking we always could hear the explanations. On our own we would have spent twice as long and really only learned and understood a fraction of what we saw and learned with our wonderful guide.

Excellent tour, our guide Selenia was very knowledgeable, engaging & passionate about Roman history, would highly recommend. Plenty of time given in both the colosseum / palentine Hill. Felt we got a really good idea of life back in ancient Roman times with the help of imagination and Selenia's pictures and explanations.

Our tour of the colosseum and roman forum was a highlight of our time spent in Rome. Amil was our tour guide, and she was not only knowledgable and engaging, but she made every part of the tour interesting and took time to take pictures of us at the best "photo spot" in the Colosseum. We couldn't have asked for a better experience!!

To anyone wanting to see the Colosseum or Roman Forum for the first or 7th time, this is the only way I would do it because it covers everything!

What an incredible experience! Our tour guide was super knowledgeable, friendly and answered any questions I had. The tour was exactly the right amount of time to see a lot but not get overwhelmed or desensitized to the actual history. Having the tour guide hooked up to a microphone made hearing him through all the other tours came in really useful. 10/10

Had a great tour with Sylvia Rana on this small group tour. She was super knowledgeable, funny, and really engaging with our group. Loved learning from her! Easy spot to meet and nice to skip the lines as well!

We just did this tour yesterday. I wish I could remember our guide’s name, but he was the one with the Smurf on his flag. He did a great job and was very informative and entertaining. We learned a lot on the trip. City of Wonders just happened to do 3 of the 4 tours we did in Rome and all of them were done very well. They have a smooth and efficient operation. Here’s a tip though…Even though the guides will try to find you shade when they can it’s not enough. Wear sunscreen, wear a hat, and take fan with you if you can and water! It’s hot in the Colosseum and in the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill.

We had our tour at 0920 on the 7th of June 2022. I’m saying this because I can’t remember our tour guides name (I remember his name was 5 letters long), oops(!) but he was AMAZING! So knowledgable and very interactive. We had a great time. It was the first time my partner had been to the colosseum and with this tour, it really helped him to understand the history and more. We had a guided tour around the colloseum, we then (as a group) were taken to the Roman Forum and given a lot of information and facts and then toured the forum and palestine hill at our own pace without a guide. We would highly recommend this tour.

Our tour guide Dennis was so knowledgeable and friendly. He knew it was a hot day so stopped in shaded places to talk to tell us more about the history of the colosseum. He also always asked if we had any questions and even offered his time after the tour was done to answer more questions other than about the colosseum.

We booked this tour for our final day in Rome and we were absolutely blown away by Valerio’s incredible knowledge about the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Rome in general. In a small group of 6, with audio equipment to make sure we didn’t miss a single moment, and with Valerio’s handy reference pictures, it was incredible to be guided by a real-life archaeologist with first hand experience of working in the Colosseum. We learnt so much and Valerio answered all questions in great depth with a touch of humour. A fantastic experience!

We had a great tour guide - Lara, who gave a detailed and knowledgeable tour of the sites. It was taken at a steady and manageable pace and done with patience and good humour. She was able to convey the wonderment of the Roman period and had an immense background of art history. It is a thoroughly recommended tour with an excellent guide. Thank you, Lara!

I liked the tour with the guide with first name like Claudia and last name Constantine. For me, her guiding talk (in English) was informative, engaging and nice to hear. She provided not only facts but also comments on the history of the place and she answered the tourists’ questions warmly. She also offered to take photos of the tourists during the tour and provided suggestions on where to go next after the coverage of the tour.

Our walking pace was not too fast, hence we were able to appreciate the surroundings. We were also allowed to stay in the area to independently visit the Roman Forum for an hour beyond the duration of the walk.

I booked for 4 adults. Our flight was delayed significantly meaning we would have been half an hour late after rushing and trying our best to get there on time. When we where leaving the airport I called the company to explain and see if it was possible to reschedule. I understand there are no refunds, all I wanted was the possibility of rescheduling for another time/day. I was told no, nothing, so unhelpful. That was £170 odd down the drain. Very disappointed! Will never book with this company again.

I had always wanted to see the colosseum so finally booked a trip to Rome for me, my wife and 2 kids aged 10 and 9. We decided to do a guided tour to get the best out of the experience. Our instructions were clear and we were met by Sabrina our guide who spoke excellent English. The colosseum itself was amazing and really felt like you were stepping back in time. The tour was very good, Sabrina was very knowledgeable and kept the children engaged. Well worth the money to also skip the queues. She took us into the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill after and this is where my only criticism comes. With the amount of ruins available to see I would have appreciated a guide to point out the ones of most significance, I ended up walking around them all taking photos with not much of an idea what they once were so a condensed tour would have been good as I saw many others. Other than this an excellent experience.

This was in interesting tour but probably a lot longer than it needed to be inside the Colosseum. It was a hot day and although our guide did know lots of information about the Colosseum, he was more of a "facts & figures" type and not story telling so the tour was a bit boring at times and add to that the heat made it seem much too long. By the time we go the the Forum & Palantine hill we found that we were not wishing to explore as much as we had planned. We like that we had all the free time we wanted in this area but wished that we would have been done sooner in the Colosseum.

Colessium tour and surroundings were so wonderful. Our guide Nick was so patient with us and he answered all of our questions. He took lots of care to make sure that we never got lost and that everyone could hear the information. Best tour with Nick.

We had the pleasure of having Elisabetta as our guide - she was kind, and funny and made the tour so much more enjoyable. We opted to take the tour at 3 PM rather than in the morning - it seemed as though this was not a peak time for tours, so the Colosseum wasn't as crowded as I had anticipated which was great! Elisabetta gave us a ton of knowledge, and made it really interactive. Be prepared to walk, a lot - lots of steps, hills and just overall covering a lot of ground. The tour was only 3 hours, so we got to see and learn a lot without it eating up our whole day. Definitely recommend!

Worst guide ever! We are literally standing in a place of such rich history… rather than give us quality information, our guide would give us sentence than say etc, etc, etc.. repeatedly the entire time. Complaining constantly about the steps. Ruined the experience of an amazing place.

The booking information was confusing. We believed based on the description that we were booking a tour with access to the under ground catacombs however that is not we received, nor did it show in the email receipt ( but was on the description we clicked the book button for).

The tour guide was nice, however repeated herself a lot and didn't share any new information I didn't already know watching Gladiator, reading wiki or the Coloseum website. I do not believe we received our money's worth on this tour.

I wish we would have just booked tickets directly from the coloseum and done their own audio tour, I think I would have learned more.

My favorite tour of many over 16 days in Italy. Yes, the meeting point is above the subway stop which u get from a very careful reading and asking someone how to get up there. Yeah, stressful. But we did have a small group and our guide was British and easy to follow without ear buds (which is good for me since they insist on not offering buds that fit small ear canals!) I will say tho that everything gets long on hot days. I looked at the website that said no full water bottles. That needs to be updated. One can bring water, not soda. We brought empty bottles and found nowhere to refill them. We nearly passed out! One elderly woman had to bail out early. We only could get water after the tour at the lunch spot on the hill near the Forum. Even the souvenir shop has NO water fountain or bottles of water for sale. And we did the 9 a.m. tour. All that being said, I learned a lot, now knowing what I thot I knew was wrong. And got great photos. Do this tour, but early and bring water!

Our tour guide did not speak good English and was very unorganized in her tour narrative. She also did not cover Roman Forum at all. Quite disappointed with our tour. Though it said it is a 3 hour tour, she completed in less than 2.5 hours

Though being able to see the Colosseum was amazing, it was hard to understand our guide, Marco, who was a pleasant fellow but kept using the phrases “be careful” and “ok guys” constantly (out of context). We had no time to take photos in the colosseum, as he kept taking us to small alcoves to get out of the sun. And then scolded when we separated for a few moments to take photos. Everything seemed rushed. Maybe, having some picture time built into the tour would be good. This is not the tour for you if you want a leisurely tour.

Would have preferred a self guided tour. The group size was 24 and the guide was difficult to understand. She knew her info, but her English was not great, the earbuds were very low quality, it was extremely loud and packed with tourists, and she was somewhat soft spoken. We estimate that we hear about a third of what she said. The tour felt rushed and we breezed past many informational signs that we would have read had we not had to keep up with the group.

Having experienced a rushed tour of the Vatican with a different operator I was a little nervous about this tour of the colosseum .... I should not have been. This was the highlight of our trip to Rome by quite some way. The awesome opportunity to explore these ancient wonders was made all the more incredible by our enthusiastic and most knowledgable guide ‘Gigi’. He brought the whole thing to life. His anecdotes, his history lesson and his humour was just brilliant. Skipping the queues actually just became an added bonus and I would thoroughly recommend this tour and this operator to everyone. I would fly to Rome just for this experience. I don’t know if you can request a specific tour guide but if you can... ask for Gigi.

This tour is a must when you visit Rome. We met our private tour guide Silvia just outside of the Coliseum entrance. There’s lots of vendors there selling hats and water which came in handy for us. She guided us through each part of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum with excellent details, storytelling history, and knowledge. Her voice was pleasant and exciting! She was so patient and graciously took video and pictures of us throughout our 3 hour tour.

When you go to Rome and want a special guided tour, ask for Silvia! She was EXCELLENT!

Had a great time on this tour and really learnt a lot about the history and culture of the city as well as seeing some beautiful views. Would definitely recommend and our tour guide Patrick was really friendly and knowledgeable. Skip the line queues were a bonus too!

The instructions from the company stated to
Meet the representative who would be wearing a blue company t shirt. The meeting area was extremely busy and we couldn’t identify our guide. My wife eventually saw a lady holding an extended stick which appeared to have a small flag with company logo on. When we asked if she was the guide for our tour, she directed us back upstairs to an office and then left. She was our guide and after following her instruction, missed the tour.
Unfortunately, the 3pm was the last of the day. I phoned the help number who confirmed we wouldn’t be able to go. No other help was given. Very disappointing, I will be requesting a full refund.

We traveled with family and a young child in a buggy. Guide was very much unaware how to facilitate needing a lift. The tour guide ended up leaving us at the Colosseum and not allowing for us to continue the tour. Our group had to split up and it ended up ruining our experience.

Giuseppe was an AMAZING guide! He was so patient, attentive and knowledgeable (and funny too!). He made the three hours fly by as we had so much fun. The Colosseum is breathtaking and the Roman forum was not what we expected at all (in a good way)! Would recommend to anyone, there were a range of ages in our group and everyone seemed to enjoy :)

Our group is supposed to be 20 people but we only had five. Our tour guide was Renata and she is great. Her eyes lit up when she talked about the history of the Colosseum and all the cool facts that she provided. You can tell she is passionate about what she does.

I wish we had earphone so it would be easier to listen to her the whole time but because it was a smaller group, she just spoke normally. But there were a lot of people so sometimes it’s hard to hear.

If you are going during cold season like Jan Feb- make sure to bring an umbrella or poncho. Luckily after we finished our tour that was when the rain started: we had to buy an umbrella last minute from this Gypsies on the street for 6 euro.

First of all we can not agree with the last review. The meeting point is simple to find. There is link on the email/ticket and funny enough the other 5 dozen people for various language groups alao found the meeting point.

Now for the Tour review: Absolutely Magnificent. Andrada is a Super Tour Guide with amazing historic knowledge.

Best tour, because of our really great Guide Andrada through ancient Rome. So much fantastic information "come on," She loves her job. We had the great chance to dive into history and she made it like we were back in time. Phenomenal Absolutely recommended. She always had the group together, asked if anyone needed water or bathroom break. No waiting in line ...thank you Andrada!

P.S. We loved her tour, first the Roman Forum, then the Hill overlooking everything and the Colosseum last leaving you time there and also for the gift shop :-)

Our tour guide Sylvia was a fountain of knowledge and had many great stories and facts about the Colosseum, Forum and Palatine Hill. The history alone was very interesting, and the scenery was humbling. We did the first tour of the day and would recommend as by the end of the tour it was getting busy. Skip the line is a must as we had no wait time going through security.

I mistakenly booked the wrong language (I take full responsibility for that). Our guide (who spoke very good English) told us we could stay with her to get into the Colosseum (because she had our tickets) then go off on our own, since we wouldn’t understand her anyway. We specifically asked if we needed an additional ticket to get into the Forum and Palantine Hill. If we needed a ticket for that portion, we would have stayed with the group. She told us we did not need another ticket, we could just go into the Forum. So we went on our own. She was wrong. We did need a ticket to get into the Forum and Palantine Hill. So we could not get into that part. This is a guide who does this tour often. She spoke our language well, so she understood our question. We asked the specific question and she gave us the wrong answer The tour company would not do anything but say sorry.

Myself and my partner booked onto the colleseum tour with palitine hill and Roman forum. At first I was worried 3 hours would be too long... the complete opposite. Our tour guide Francesca was amazing. Her knowledge was outstanding. She was informative. Welcoming. Engaging and friendly. I couldn't recommend this tour highly enough. When next booking a city excursion we will be sure to book a tour using city wonders. Many thanks for making this bucket list experience one I will treasure forever.

This guided tour of the Colosseum, Palantine Hill and the Forum was informative and moved along at a good pace. Our guide was knowledgeable and pleasant. The included audio device worked well and made the guide easy to hear. It’s hard to imagine a 1st trip to Rome that didn’t include these sights and this trip did a good job of presenting them.

Very poor speaking English speaking tour guide. She cut the tour short due to extreme heat conditions. There were approximately 35 people in our tour group which was significantly too many. Next time the tour guy should speak much better English and the tour should be the full 3 1/2 hours rather than two hours.

The tour advertised small group (max of 20).
There were 40 people in the tour. Barbara our guide was horrible. She basically said this the colosseum, and this is the Roman forum, and at the top of the hill she said this is palatine hill.
After the tour (wasted 3 hours) we walked through and googled the sections and learned more. Our worst experience so far.

(Oct 22) This tour is well worth booking in advance. It's well organised, easy to find the meeting point as described in the booking details. Our guide (Eddy) was extremely knowledgeable (PHD background in Archaeology), professional and had a great sense of humour - thank you! All the historical facts provided made it really informative, that you would only get from a guide. This was our first visit and it was a great experience. Certainly recommend this.

This was a really wonderful tour led by a very knowledgeable tour guide. I loved the way she got us to think about how the ruins we see today may have looked centuries ago. The only other comment I have is that the tour did not go as long as advertised – we had been expecting a 3-hour tour, but our tour only lasted 2 hours.

Excellent experience with Sara. She knows really well and explains very clearly all the history and anecdotes behind the Colosseum and the Roman Forum. She was very considerate to everyone in our group and managed very smoothly or our different needs. Totally worth it.

10/10! We only had a short time in Rome and this tour allowed us to skip lines and have commentary on the above sites. Our guide was very friendly and informative. We thoroughly enjoyed our time with the guide and on the tour. Highly recommend.

This tour spent the vast majority of the time at the Colosseum; little time at the Palatine Hill and even less at the Forum. The guide said the Forum was the most important ancient site in Rome, yet we hardly saw it and learned very little about it. The Colosseum part of the tour was very repetitive. The weather was tough because it was so hot, but nonetheless I didn't think the tour matched the description and was disappointed.

Straight up - our tour wouldn’t have been the same if Tatiana wasn’t our tour guide. She made it what it was. Yes it was very long, after a while you get super tired and drained but her personality and sense of humor carried us through. A strong Italian woman she reminded me so much of family members i know and was very knowledgeable, passionate on the topics and professional! Not to mention City Wonders has a great partnership with these monuments and tours so you get to skip the line or as she would say “roll out the red carpet”. It was a wonderful experience and I would definitely do it again.

Never happend because they canceled 15 hours before the start. We saw the message at 22h at night, when the tour was supposed to happen at 9h30 in the morning. We found ourselfs with no tickets and no guide at the Colosseum, which was something I dreamed to do since I was a child. We finally did it on our own, the exact thing I did not wanted to do! Such a huge dissapointment for us!! It was the french tour, so I guess they were not making enough money with the people that had reserverd. But it meant everything for us, and they just didn't care. Such a weste of time and money.

I don’t know how this has good reviews. Our guide didn’t speak very good English, and I’m not sure HE even knew what he was saying. Our group for sure did not understand most of what he said. He frequently would stop and talk for a loooooooong time about something very specific and then proceed to walk past tons of ruins and not stop OR say a thing about them. I basically felt like I was on my own to figure out what things were. He seemed to only talk about things that he thought were interesting and then skip all of the history. He didn’t stop for photos but got mad when people didn’t keep up.

Just terrible! I would not recommend ever.

The tour was in depth. All aspects of the colosseum were covered, from architecture to usage through the ages. Almost two hours were spent inside the colosseum, leaving just time for a thorough overview of the forum. Sabrina was very knowledgeable and very detailed in her descriptions

Our tour guide was Alessandro he was great! I would highly recommend him as your tour guide. Alessandro was very knowledgeable, informative, and spoke clearly. He was attentive to us, making sure we had shade while standing long periods of time, water and bathroom breaks. I would definitely book this tour again!

Grazie

This is a forgery.

We bought some « skip-the-line » tickets, but because of the Covid-19 security checks we still had to queue the whole line, during 45 minutes under a hellish sun.

So in the end the tickets were useless, and we even ran short of time because we had to go to the Coliseum afterwards. So in the end we only got 20 minutes inside the Forum.

A very bad experience.

Vasco was our guide for the morning, and he was excellent! He knew so much detail about the Colosseum and pointed out details that I definitely would have missed or rushed past on a self guided tour. Despite the oppressive heat that day, he was very engaging and enthusiastic. We spent approximately 1.5 hours at the Colosseum, and the rest split between the Palatine Hill and the Forum. The only thing I would say is that if you wanted a longer tour of the gardens and the Forum, it may be best done on your own time, as they are quite extensive and 1.5 hours wasn't enough to get through it all.

Sylvia was a great tour guide, she is full of enthusiasm, you can tell she loves what she does. Sylvia’s knowledge about the Colosseum and Palatine Hill was excellent and she was happy to answer any questions the group had. This was our first time in Rome and without a guide I would not have known the history of Palatine Hill & although the tour was 3hrs you could spend a full day there

We had an excellent 5* guide, however this was not a small group tour as advertised. There was close to 30 people in our group. My poor rating is a reflection of the company not the guide. Our guide was funny, knowledgeable and tried very hard to engage my 14 year old and did a great job.

This was an incredible tour - mind blowing. Sylvia was a brilliant guide - friendly, engaging, passionate, informative and bubbly with a lovely quirky personality. She was full of information and really looked after everyone in a very busy environment. Highly recommended.

Radu was a next level tour guide. He was funny and incredibly knowledgeable and engaging. This was my second tour of the Collesseum and I came away from this one with a new perspective on it, learned so many new things and got such a great feel for the history of the place. On a very hot day, he kept us as cool as possible and completely kept our attention. It's hard to imagine a tour where I'd want to go back and do it again, but this was it.

Our small group tour was with Nick who was an exceptional guide. His extensive knowledge was coupled with great enthusiasm and story telling. Lots of insights to what real life might have been like for those connected with the Colosseum. He also built in breaks for photos and questions, the two hours flew by.

We had a fantastic tour of the Colosseum with our brilliant guide Silvia, her knowledge is astounding. I could listen to her stories of the gladiators and ancient Rome all day. Unfortunately the Colosseum is mainly ruins now but she described it very well and used a book to show examples of what it might have looked like. Being an archaeologist she was obviously passionate about the subject and i believe you really do need a guide to get the most out of it, especially the forum. She made sure we stayed in the shade where possible and was happy to take pictures for everyone.
Skip the line was definitely worth it as we walked right in past the crowds waiting in the sun. You wear headphones to make sure you can hear your guide too.
We saved this tour until our last day as it was what we were most looking forward to but i wished we hadn’t as Silvia gave us a (long) list of her favourite places to eat. We will just need to come back!

This was an amazing tour. Walking with a guide helped us understand the deep history of the colosseum and the Roman forum. We were joined by our two teenagers who also really loved it.
It was easy to find our tour group and tour guide was filled with knowledge.

The tour was all around the stadium and the arena floor. It did not include under the arena. We also walked to Palatine hill and the Roman Forum. Our guide gave us an overview and then we had the rest of the day to explore on our own.

Our tour guide, Alba, was terrific. She had such enthusiasm and knowledge on all aspects of the tour. She encouraged and was able to answer questions of a wide range of questions from everyone on the tour, from the Coliseum, Forum and Palatine Hill to different recommendation for the city. Highly recommended

We took this tour on day 2 of our trip to Rome, having visited the Vatican on day 1. We met a few people who were combining both in one day. I can only imagine how tiring that must have been!
This is a very comprehensive tour for anyone wanting to take in the key sites of Imperial Rome in a relatively short space of time. Anna our guide shared so much of the history and her ability to put across all the detail in a very accessible way was much appreciated. Quite a big group (26) made for more limited interaction with our guide than on the smaller group trip we took, but still a very good experience overall. Definitely one to do when in Rome.

The private tour at 14:10 has been cancelled. We had no information although our mobile number was known. After asking many many people we found a tour guide working for city wonders. He did not wear the city wonders jacket but was very simpathetic and helpfull. He proposed us to switch to the semi private tour at 12:50 which we did. Now we are waiting for the partial refund.

Excellent guide (Maria) gave a brilliant 2 hour tour. As we visited just as travel is picking up after covid travel restrictions have lifted, there were very few visitors which meant that we could really take in the tour even more. Maria looked after us well and she pitched the tour perfectly to bring all the sights to life and put them in context. The head sets we were provided with so we could hear her commentary were brilliant as we could keep our space/mooch a little without missing out on what she was saying and we could enjoy the sightseeing even more. There were only us and one other couple on the tour but I am sure families would really enjoy it too. Maria mentioned how children respond to the information and which bits they particularly like.

Exactly what we wanted! Our guide Nic was GREAT - so funny, so knowledgeable, and could answer every single question we lobbed at him (and we asked a lot!). The tour was 2.5 hours all up which ends you up in the Palantine area where you can keep wandering around as long as you like. It was the perfect amount of time; we had reached saturation point!

RECCOMMEND!! We did this tour a few days ago and it was perfect for all ages and interests. Our guide was Giuseppe and he was 10/10. He was beyond informative, friendly, exceptional language/ communicative skills. We enjoyed every moment of our tour and it was our favorite part of our whole trip to Rome. I would highly recommend City Wonders and it was very good value. The tours were well organized and group sizes were well proportioned.

Amazing Tour thanks to our guide Giuliano!!!! Extremely Professional, knowledgeable, and passionate about his job. Best tour guide ever and everyone that was part of our group enjoyed it. He Went above and beyond with recommendations and answering all sorts of questions for everyone. It makes the tour so much more enjoyable when you have a great guide explaining stuff. The colosseum was awesome and so was palatine hill. Definitely a must when visiting Rome! Highly recommend!!! Giuliano made it a memorable tour for my wife and I, a tour we won’t forget. Oh and he also recommended his favorite pizza spot in Rome… we went later on the the pizza place and ran into him there while we were eating haha! Thank you again!!!

Excellent tour with clear and informative and kind guide named Alexander. We were running late and called ahead and customer service rep was helpful and we got lucky to make it only 5-10 minutes late and still made the group tour. Only 12 people total in our group so much more personalized experience.

Woah it was hot! We did this tour On Tues July 5th; our guide (woman I can't remember her name) was very knowledgeable. The only thing is she was too fast and didn't wait for the rest of us to catch up to her. I seemed to find this true of the Vatican tour with this company also. I think their guides need to be cognizant of the entire group. I know they are on a timeline but at times felt rushed. I did appreciate her stopping at water and shade spots for us.

Great tour of the colosseum with our tour guide Giuseppe. He was very knowledgeable, friendly, accommodating, and professional. He shared many facts , led us to best spots for photo opts, and gave us rest breaks from the sun. Luckily I went early in the morning so it was not as hot as later in the day. Great tour!

Lorenzo was a very informative guide and someone who is obviously passionate about the subject. Entrance to the Colosseum was very thorough - temperature check, bag check, sanitiser available - which made us feel quite safe. In a funny sort of way we feel lucky to have visited during these very odd times as we suspect none of the tourist sights were as busy as they would normally be. We were also fortunate to be staying in an apartment very centrally placed for so many sights. The Colosseum was only a 10 min walk away.

Our tour guide Nicola was outstanding. I could spend an entire day listening to him! Not only he showed us the beauty of ancient Rome, but also a fair share of the Italian charm ;)
His English was excellent and made us laugh a lot.
This tour was wonderful and I’d totally recommend to discover all secrets of Rome with this guy!

Please do not spend your had earned money on this. The guide could barely be understood . She kept referencing a booklet with pictures to assist in her descriptions .It was sloppy and actually looked like her dog chewed most of it as it was frayed at the ends. She gave us 3 breaks during which she told us to walk around. People just sort of wondered off and we joined another companies tour who was doing a much better job. It was obvious we had a disgruntled tour guide who did not enjoy her job. I am sorry we wasted our time and money.

We had nick for our tour today and he was absolutely brilliant, he had so much information about the history and explained everything very well and was very knowledgeable on other aspects not necessarily regarding the tour. He has a brilliant attitude and is very passionate about the history we have the privilege to see. Thank you Nick for being a great tour guide!

GG was our tour guide and we was amazing. He was personable, engaging, and very knowledgeable. He had great stories from ancient and recent history for both the Forum and the Colosseum and kept us laughing the whole time.

We appreciated the great tour! It made our trip even better!

-Robert Martin

The tour spent too much time on Palantine Hill and not enough in the Forum. The time in the Colosseum was adequate. The guide went into too much detail on the history so that it was information overload. He had a background in history, and you could tell he was passionate about it, but it got boring.

This was an amazing tour, many thanks to our tour guide Giuseppe! He was so engaging, enlightening and fun, the whole time. He clearly has a passion for his job and we were so lucky to have him as our guide. Would recommend this tour to anybody wanting to visit the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine hill.

The only minus is that they give away a one-time use headphone set, would prefer a more sustainable option.

We were part of a small group of a dozen people. Our guide Silvia was very informative, friendly and delivered the tour in an enjoyable way, even engaging with each person on the tour individually throughout and answering oir questions with pleasure. Highly recommend tours by Silvia!

Tour was beautiful, love the history and the scenery, however, our tour guide was hostile, borderline rude, was obviously very anti catholic and demonstrated no shame in sharing his beliefs which I thought to be extremely unprofessional. His name was Valerio and it was 93° and he got angry when we went to get water. Overall a good experience but it was sad our tour guide could not have been more welcoming unlike Alberto from the Vatican! he was wonderful.

We were lucky to have Sabrina for our tour guide! She was amazing! The tour was nice organized. The headset was very important and worked very well. Sabrina told us all important information and spotted the best places where to take pictures. It was worth of participating the tour!

Our tour guide, Amile, was very knowledgeable and went into great detail. It was informative and I learned so many new things and had several things I thought were true, debunked. She was very good at making sure we had time to get water, go to the restroom and even took the time to take pictures for everyone in our group who wanted one. I highly recommend her. My only complaint was that we had booked an underground portion with the tour which we were so excited about but it was cancelled with no explanation which was very disappointing.

Do yourselves a favor and book this tour!! The information given is so important to understand the magnificence of this place! It will help you understand so many things!. Vasco was out tour guide and we could not have asked for anyone better! His passion for history and culture was so evident and contagious! We could not stop raving about his wonderful lessons. Overall an amazing experience, something you will noy regret!

We really enjoyed our very informative tour by our lovely guide, (whose name, unfortunately, I did not get) on Friday morning the 3rd December. It was my first time in Rome and I learnt so much from her about the history of this beautiful city. My 10-year-old was very impressed also with the tour. Not only was the tour excellent but our guide recommended a excellent place to have lunch and I want to thank her for the great recommendation.
Suzanne Reid

We really enjoyed this tour. Our guide Raff was very knowledgable and friendly. We went in winter and it was the best, very low traffic and good access to everything. The Colosseum is STUNNING in person, and the best way to experience it is with a guide to fill you in on the history of this colossal.
