We choose this tour because of the small group as we were in Rome with our college age daughter who was studying in Florence and we wanted a more personal tour. Our tour guide was Donnie, he was absolutely fantastic!! Donnie was so knowledgeable, he answered each question we asked and shared his obvious love of Rome and the Colosseum. The tour is definitely worth the price, the ease of entry, small group and ability to visit the lower and upper level made for a wonderful experience. I would definitely recommend this tour and I hope you are lucky to experience tour guide
Donnie.

My tour guide was Mateu, he is very very passionate about his job and about history….
Some people may be overwhelmed because he is like a history machine, he talks a lot, but I enjoyed, had a really good talk with him.
I feel like 2 hours in the colosseum is a little bit too much, but I enjoyed the tour either way.
Skipping the line is also great!

My partner and I were met by Hilary (English name or Yaya) at the designated point easy to find and because we had taken the 3pm tour and with not so many tourists due to reduced visitor numbers were transported through time and history in a tiny group of three. There is nothing that this lovely lady can not tell the visitor to the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palentine Hill her sweet nature and extensive knowledge mad it a fabulous experience. I would most strongly recommend this tour and company just the best, thank you YaYa.

Our tour guide had a passion for the history and people from this era and helped put much of what we saw in context. Very pleased with his approach and found the logistics to be much as we expected. One tip: The meeting point at the Colosseum Metro is one level above street level. A helpful local pointed us to the right place.

This tour was our most enjoyable experience in Rome. It was well organized, consisted of small groups as advertised, had an incredible tour guide (Donatella was simply amazing!), and visited amazing sites, starting with the Colosseum. We even walked away with a recommendation for dinner that night!

I would highly recommend this tour - you won’t be disappointed!

My wife and I do not ordinarily do guided tours but this one was great. P.G. was our guide. He was fun and funny and knew the history and features of the sites we toured in incredible detail. You could tell he is passionate about it. Definitely recommend this tour if you are looking for a guide for the ancient sites.

My husband and I did an afternoon tour with an archaeologist guide last week on our first day in Italy. “Eddy with a Y” was excellent. He was very knowledgeable and charismatic. I like a goofy tour guide, it makes the learning experience less like a lecture and rather like a fun conversation with a much smarter friend. The only downside was the cheap earphones that did not fit in my ears and hurt by the end of the tour. We had the summer heat and blasting sun, but Eddy brought us to the shade as much as possible and pointed out fountains for water refills. The main benefit of a guide over an audio tour, I believe, is the ability to ask questions and learn something that the pre-set audio may not cover (as well as point out good photo spots and take pictures for you instead of depending on selfies).

Our tour was led by Silvia Rana on an exceptionally hot July day - 35 degree heat. But Silvia made it an absolute pleasure. Not only did she impart many interesting stories which gave us a real feel for life in the colosseum and Forum, but she knew all the places to make sure we were in the shade and also made sure we filled up our water bottles. I don’t know how she managed to maintain her natural passion for the stories in that heat!! Would highly recommend. We’ve been to the colosseum before but without a tour, it wasn’t a patch on our experience with Silvia.

We were so fortunate our tour today was led by Alessandro, an archeologist. The Colosseum and other places we visited are beyond fascinating. Our tour guide brought it to all life with non-stop stories to give us a deeper understanding and appreciation of Roman history and life. It was the perfect tour to kick off our first trip to Rome!

We took this group tour of the Colliseum and the Forum with our wonderful guide Viola on a blazing hot afternoon in July. Fortunately, we had skip the lines passes, which were wonderful. Viola was very funny, highly entertaining and informative with numerous humorous stories in addition to facts and other insightful anecdotes. She kept us moving and was very good to find shady spots. We had a great time.
There is no way we could have learned the amount of information we did with a guide book alone. A knowledgeable guide is a must and Viola was the perfect expert for our group.

We had the very lucky privilege to have Marcello Vinciguerra as our tour guide. Marcello is an incredible tour guide. He was entertaining, funny, and most importantly, knowledge. He told us every little detail about the Colosseum, Roman forum, and Palatine Hill in addition to answer every single one of our miscellaneous Roman history questions. I would highly recommend this tour and trying to be in Marcello Vinciguerra’s tour group.

Our Tour Guide was Inga and she was excellent. Her knowledge was encyclopaedic and her English clear and easy to understand. The tour encompassed the colosseum, the forum and Palantine bill. Inga’s descriptions of life back then was very entertaining which made the whole tour even better. She brought Roman history to life. It was, however, during a heatwave and temperatures reached 31c which felt like 35c so sun cream and water a must! There are free water fountains with delicious cold drinking water everywhere in Rome and Inga made sure we stopped to refill our bottles whenever required. Nothing was too much for her and I’d highly recommend her and the tour. After 3 hours of walking in the heat she suggested various places for lunch too! 🙂

We had a knowledgable but extremely verbose guide - Matteo Fabri - who literally talked us into boredom as he strayed from the topic continuously to discuss politics and ended up not covering a lot of interesting topics. Please give the guide feedback. Thanks.

Our guide was Alessandro. We had a medium sized group which was a job to manage but was handled very well. The audio equipment was a great help as you could still hear the guide if you cannot see them. The tour was very informative, so much to see and learn. I would highly recommend the tour. Alessandro did everything possible to make it an enjoyable tour.

Valerio gave us a fantastic tour of the Colosseum. He is as a very clear and knowledgeable guide that explained the history in a very entertaining fashion, took the tour group through at a reasonable pace and answered all questions we had. The whole family thoroughly enjoyed his tour and would have no hesitation in recommending him and this company for further tours. They were very easy to book with and find for the start of the tour.

The tour guide was excellent and so knowledgeable. I would highly recommend this tour but you need to be fit as there is quite a bit of walking. You also get a set of earphones so you can hear the guide, but don’t mix this up with being a audio tour.

The tour felt very rushed. Did not spend enough time inside the colosseum and or the arena. The tour guide did her best to explain but needs a lot of training in English to keep up with current and relevant information. We exited the tour about an hour into it as we felt no value.

Patrick was a really knowledgeable, funny guide. He had my attention for the intire tour of 3 hours, and time just flew by. I loved how he explained and showed the comperason photos how the buildings could have looked like. I'd highly recommend taking this tour.

Great experience for our group which included three adults and four teens. Marina was really well informed on ancient history and she chose the most interesting details to share that brought it alive. I'd been to these sites without a guide in the past and was so happy to benefit from this wonderful tour with the historical context. Learned so much! The Colosseum had a complicated system of retractable awnings. Gladiators had to win ten battles to be freed. Vestal virgins were released from service at 30 and could marry. ....

We had Silvia for our guide and she did not disappoint ! She was very informative, very engaging, and made sure to make the tour very interactive. She answered any and all questions and kept the discussions lively. Our two teenagers loved it as well. Thank you Silvia ! Highly recommended!

Enjoyed our tour very much! It was busy but our guide did a great job of explaining the overall history of the colosseum and many other small details. She was also willing to answer any questions we had. Once we were on Palatine Hill our guide did a great job of pointing out the several buildings on the hill and in the Roman Forum while explaining their history/significance. Make sure you bring a water bottle if you’re going in the summer!

We have had a very patient Tour guide, who explained every important detail about the history of Roman Emperors and The Empire itself. He talked about facts and myths of the colosseum and it was a big pleasure because it was more than obvious that the man loves his job. His name is Erturk Durmus and we even took a selfie with him at the end of the tour. Awesome.

The trip was fantastic, really easy to find the start location. We were a bit on the fence about booking a trip because we are the sort of people to go with the flow and turn up and sort it, but we were so happy we booked this tour the queues were very long for tickets so saved the hassle of that , the guide was brilliant and explained everything, was no rush and as we were going round he explained if you wanted to stop and take pictures don’t worry. You felt really engaged because you get headphones and the guide talks you though the Colosseum. Well worth the money get yourself booked on.

A tour very much worth taking, only complaint, though it didn’t hinder the tour, it says small group…we had 24 in ours .
Our guide was fantastic , she knew so much, which made the tour enjoyable and very informative, had a few laughs along the way, and was more than willing to answer any questions . The time just flew by, although a lot of walking was involved, but could have stayed on another couple hours .
Thank you for great tour

Guide was extremely knowledgeable and passionate. Explained historic facts that are not displayed anywhere else. We had an issued with the headsets but he was able to fix it by making continues stops to explain everything in detail and we all cut heat. It’s a shame that no body tips him.

Very nice tour! Our guide was extreamly helpful and polite. He is also an archelogoist and can give u info and funny facts that u wont find in textbooks and internet. Enough time for pictures, no rush and u can also leave at any moment if u feel like it. Highly recommend!

P.s. visit rome in spring or fall. Summer is a burden, the heat takes a little bit from the excitment

This tour was an excellent value. Our guide, Claudio, is a native to Rome. He took his time explaining all the ancient history associated with the area. The walking & climbing steps is not for the weak. Although Claudio is 65+ he walks this path regularly and is in great shape. Wear comfortable shoes and bring your own water.

We took the subway from our hotel to the Colosseum station. There, we easily found the guides on the 2nd floor, who checked us in and passed us on to our guide for the day, Inna.
Inna, did an excellent job, guiding us through and up to the Colosseum. It's an amazing feeling to walk in this structure which is over 2000 years old. After the Colosseum, we walked over the the Palatine Hill, which was impressive on its own.
We then continued to overlook the Forum, which again is just amazing. Inna, did an excellent job explaining to us all the important and historic structures.
The tour ended after about 2 1/2 hours.
Definitely recommend this tour.

An informative walking tour that allows you to see the sights and understand the history of the Colosseum, the Forum and ancient Rome.

The cost may seem expensive but it is worth it. Using headsets the guide walks and talks you through the sights and history of the key sights around the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Forum. There's so much to see and some time is given to take photos - if you can find space. You can stay in the Palatine park /Forum after the tour to discover more. - recommended. You avoid the queues, also. Even out of season it is very busy.

We absolutely loved this tour! Our tour guide was very knowledgable and really brought the history to life. He went in to detail in the architecture and pointed out things we would never have seen on our own. We also walked straight in so no queuing in the baking heat! It was a very small group so we could ask lots of questions, and we were also given little radios with headlines so we could hear very clearly. I’d thoroughly recommend this tour.

The good: We we’re able to skip the line and go in as a group to view the colosseum. We got to see some great sights, we were able to hear the tour guide well, and our guide was very friendly and polite.

The less good: Our tour guide could have done a better job of describing what we were seeing. I feel like I missed out on a lot of basic information about the different sites.

This tour was amazing and I'd definitely recommend it. Our tour guide Silvia Rena was fantastic. She made the tour so much fun and enjoyable. She's an archaeologist so was full of passion, excitement and lots of fascinating information. She was bubbly during the whole tour and even showed us around part of Palatine Hill and gave us tips of what to see in the Roman Forum. She showed us photos of what it would have been like in the past. Before the tour ended she even shared her favourite restaurants with us to check out. I definitely think Silva made the tour so interesting.

The tour was very interesting, we enjoyed it a lot.. our tour guide Umbra was very pleasant and enjoyed every munchkin mute of the tour. Would definitely recommend it.. lots of information given during the tour and questions answered. A must during visiting Rome .

We went on a very hot day so it was a challenge to climb all the stairs but our guide made sure to give us breaks to rest and get water. Olga was very knowledge about the sites. We would go again. The history is amazing!

Unfortunately our guide Paola was impossible to understand. Our whole group really struggled, which was a bummer, as I know she had a lot of knowledge to share. Her accent was so strong and she struggled with a lot of the English words so that made it harder to follow. We had prior tours with other Italian guides and there was no issue understanding them but it was so bad on this tour that at a certain point we took our headphones off. She took us on a great route and we ended in a really cool spot overlooking the Roman forum but we didn’t really get The typical tour experience.

Patrick, our guide, explained in great details the sites we visited. It felt like having a friend from France introducing to us the historocal and archeological sites of the Coloseum and the Forums of Palatin.

Great tour and we highly recommend Patrick a'd the tour.

The tour was great despite the weather, since was a rainy day . Unfortunately due to the weather conditions the “ underground” portion was cancelled but we got a partial refund by the company . The guide was very knowledgeable and put an extra effort to compensate for the unexpected cancellation. The audio was perfect using the headphones and able to listen the entire history of the colosseum etc. we definitively recommend this tour .

Tour guide was very knowledgeable, really enjoyed the tour! We both thought it was fun and that it was good value for money. Headset quality was great, she got us involved at various points to ask us questions. Only negative was we kind of struggled to find the meeting point but that’s only because I was convinced I was in the right place!

We did our small group Colosseum tour on 10/4/22 at 3pm with our tour guide Mr. Simone. He was one of the BEST and funniest tour guides ever!!!!! We truly enjoyed every minute of our tour with him. He was professional, experienced, knowledgeable, genuine and hilarious!!! We learned a lot and Simone kept it enjoyable! Highly highly recommend this tour to everyone!!!!!

Terrible tour, did receive any historical information, just received unnecessary comments towards me and my partner. Incredibly disappointed. Did not receive the service which was advertised, incredibly let down and was not worth the money at all. Mental health was damaged after the tour

This was a great tour for our family, including 2 kids and grandma. We gained a much better understanding of the history if the area and what it would have looked like. Fabio our guide was very knowledgeable and patient with the questions people had, and was very good at maintaining the kids attention ill n. He also made accommodations for the older members around steps and slopes. We had a great time.

The tour was amazing and Sara was very knowledgeable. My three children ages 6,9 and 12 all had a great time and it was even better because our guid spent the time answering any questions they had (my 9 year old was excited to go on this tour). I reccomend you wear the most comfortable shoes you have and bring a water bottle, there are may places along the tour to refill.

Our tour guide Sylvia was amazing! We really loved her energy and enthusiasm. She had a lot of knowledge to share and made the tour super interesting. Would recommend. We went on a few tours during our trip and she was our favourite tour guide 🙂

Skip the line is a must. We were there nearly 3 hours aa there was so much to learn and ask about.

'Miracle' our tour guide (whose name is similar to what is in the speech marks) was incredibly funny. He knew a lot about alot and that really added to the experience.

We woyld definitely book with these again.

Great tour. Our tour guide Louise was brilliant, very knowledgeable and kept us interested the whole time. The queus were really short (due to covid) so it made the trip even better. The communication from booking through to meeting up at the designated meeting place, and the whole tour was really well organised. I would highlly recommend City Wonders for this tour.

Such a great tour experience from the meet up through to the end. Our guide did a good job preparing us and balancing the work of the official guide who handles the underground part of the tour. Headsets were the best of all the tours we did on our vacation as they were over ear that worked perfectly for our younger child. He took to the tour and enjoyed the details through the headset finding it all interesting. So many great photo opportunities and a lot of information at the various stages that allow you to really understand what is happened there. Then heading over to the Forum was great and having a few items pointed out and then left there in the Forum to finish at our own pace. It was so nice for the information and the skip the line access to the Colosseum was worth it.

Maria Luisa was fantastic - knowledgeable, clear and eager to answer questions. She had many visual aids with her as well which really helped us to understand what the various sites originally looked like. I had another guide who had these types of pictures in a 3 ring binder- that might make it quicker to find each laminated picture. The audio devices were also very helpful and assured we could hear everything.

It was OK. Not bad, but also not excellent. A bit of a hickup with an entry. The group was too large for one entrance, so 9 people had to go to the other entrance. Guide Gloria was OK; she was nice, friendly, and gave us enough information.

Great tour - knowledgeable and entertaining guide. Amazing to learn what a day at the colosseum was like for the Romans. The guide used a useful reference book to show us what the romans would have seen compared to what we were seeing. Good opportunities to take photos. Thank you!

Rome is breathtaking in terms of bearing witness to significant aspects of human history. The attractions were amazing. Also, Christa (hope I’m spelling that right) is simply fabulous! So knowledgeable, upbeat, kind, and entertaining. A+ experience.

Our tour was very well organised and so informative. Our guide Nick was so knowledgable and enthusiastic, he never failed to answer any questions with as much detail as possible. We had an amazing time and it really made our trip!

My family and I had a great time! Our tour guide Ana Drada (may be spelled wrong) was very knowledgeable. She was able to answer all of my questions, and her English was great.

It was a very hot day and she made sure to show us where the water fountains were, and to keep us in the shade when she could. She kept our group well organized, and we had plenty of time to take pictures.

Our guide (Damiano) was very informative and brought history to life. A fantastic guide and well worth the tour. There is quite a bit of walking up and down stairs but our guide was very patient with my wife as she's not the quickest at walking due to a previous ankle injury.

Ms. Rossella, Was truly a wonderful Tour Guide. She was very knowledgeable and took her time to explain the different areas in the Colosseum. She also was very considerate to me being a disabled person. Your company should recognize her quality. As a result of her knowledge, and helpfulness I will recommend your company to my Family and Friends. I will also will use your company based upon her quality.

Our guide, Alessandro, was very knowledgeable - in fact he had actually worked on the excavation of some of the Roman Forum years ago! He was very kind and loved to answer everyone’s questions. He even had brought a book of drawings showing what the areas would have looked like in their heyday, which was so interesting! It was nice to have a guide and a small group as we were able to bypass the lines. It was a hot day but we thoroughly enjoyed our tour.

Not sure that mere words can express the depth of knowledge we gained from this experience. Our tour guide, Laura, was such a font of knowledge, a lovely lady that took back 2000 years and helped us to truly understand where we were, what we were seeing and also dispelled many inaccurate myths we brought with us.

This tour is not for the faint hearted nor the unfit, a fair amount of walking is involved. From the many steep steps of the Colosseum to the undulations of The Palatine Hill and finally down into the forum.

We absolutely loved this tour and were fascinated from the first minute to the last, some three hours later. Absolutely worth the fee and effort, do it, you will not be disappointed.

Micky, our guide, was truly exceptional. His infectious enthusiasm and extensive knowledge made for a wonderful few hours. The Collosseum and Roman Forum are fascinating to visit and it is really brought to life by a great tour guide. The one downside was the difficulty we had in finding the meeting point for the tour. This was a bit stressful, as it wasn’t indicated anywhere that we could find. It should be clearly marked in the instructions where exactly the meeting point is. Overall though, we had a really enjoyable tour, and would definitely recommend it to others

We had the best time with Giuseppe! He was so knowledgeable of the incredible history of this location, as well as a gifted and humorous story teller. This was my fifth and favorite trip to the Colosseum/Forum. It was the first time for my fiancé and he got to see everything! Thank you Giuseppe for a wonderful time!

Paola was a great guide, very interesting & funny. She said it was a good time to come as it wasn’t very busy. Ii that’s the case then I wouldn’t want to be there when it was! In saying that we didn’t really have to queue for entry at all and taking pictures wasn’t too bad although there was a lot of people there. It was nicer in the Palatine which was very impressive. Recommend

The tour is a must to understand the wonderful sights and rich history of the ruins. Our tour guide, Amil, was a wealth of knowledge and with the aid of radio/ear buds, spoke to us continuously as we strolled and caught the views. We truly saw some of the best sights in the world!

This was a 3 hour tour .
Huge negative at the outset finding the meeting point . It states above the Metro on second floor !!! The second floor turns out to be a small green space outdoors adjacent to the Metro entrance ,,,, let’s just say lost in translation needs to be amended !!!
The rest was all good
Our tour guide Fabio was knowledgable , funny , helpful and easy going
Covid rules still applied for entry ( six nations weekend )
The coliseum is awe inspiring , we were told it took 5000 slaves 9 years to build and was earthquake safe
49 metres high amazing
The tour also took in the forums and pallintine hill
Lots of walking take some water
Thank you Fabio

We came across this tour by chance on Trip Advisor itself and what a great thing that was. It’s rare to find a tour guide with so much passion and knowledge as Micky had. We did a small group which was perfect, there was lots of time for questions and photo opportunities. There were very strict rules with regards to Covid such as temperature checks and face masks to be worn at all times which was great. Make sure to wear comfortable shoes and take a water bottle with you. There’s plenty of fountains on the way. A really great tour and even better if you get Micky! Thanks so much - we had the best time.

Really enjoyed this tour! Our tour guide Patrick knew so much and was super passionate about the subjects. I enjoyed that we ended in the forum so we had time to explore on our own. If I could do it again I may have added on another colosseum tour, but I think that’s due to personal interest/preferences. I would recommend this tour! It was the first one I did in Rome, and my favorite one yet.

Elizabeth is the best guide one could possibly hope for. Her wealth of knowledge about all things Rome is outstanding. Her personal experience with the excavation and discovery of Nero’s home was fascinating. The head sets really helped to hear Elizabeth. Will definitely look for tours by this group next time we’re in Rome.

Have start location and company name on E ticket. This would make it easier to use the app. Sadly we missed the tour as we couldn't find our group until it was to late. This was also hindered as there was a taxi strike, making the metro start area very busy and groups sheltering from sun under tree's difficult to find.

Fabulous tour, led by a knowledgeable guide who had conducted an excavation within the area, and is an art history teacher as well. Could not have asked for more. She spoke great English. and the microphone system really worked well allowing clear hearing of explanations. Exciting insights into how the colosseum worked underground were enjoyable. Thanks for a great morning.

Paula was a lovely tour guide, she was very infomative and enjoyable to listen to. She told us all the best stops to get photos and filled us in on all the local history. I would 100% advise doing! Just make sure to eat well beforehand as the tour is 3 hours long, and wear suitable footwear as a lot of walking is involved!

Our tour of the Roman Forum and the Coliseum was amazing. We had a lovely tour guide, Amil, who expertly guided us through the Forum and highlighted key areas for the teens and 7-year-old touring with us. We toured the arena of the Coliseum and Amil shared so much information about the happenings at the games. She kept our entire group engaged and everyone had a great time. We’d definitely go on another trip with Amil in Rome!

Great tour led by Ambre. Very informative and interesting. It was 31° when we did the tour and she made sure to stop in shaded areas for us at regular intervals. I would definitely recommend. The scenery is gorgeous and was the highlight of our trip.

Place is great, but the tour sucks. First, it was very rushed and short compared to what is expected of places of this magnitude. Second, the tour does not actually cover the Palatine hill - you climb to a small corner of it for pictures and for a peeing pause, but do not go to the remains of the emperors' palaces, which is the whole point of the hill, nor does it cover half of the forum area to the right hand side towards the imperial fora. This means exactly 1/3 of the promoted areas was not actually covered by the tour. Worse - the guide did not even point out these places, so you would need to find your own way there. Third, the guide was friendly, but unprofessional - mumbling a lot and not remembering stuff. Go only if you want quicker organised access to the areas, or are late for tickets directly from Colosseum website (like us), or if you are satisfied with quickly seeing limited areas to tick the box for Colosseum and forum.

The tour was great and the chance to get on to the floor was even better. Four stars because you don’t actually get a tour of palatine hill or the Roman forum as listed in the itinerary. You spend all of the time in the colosseum go through the ticket entry of palatine hill and then get dropped and left on your own to view the other tourist destinations

Great way to see the Colloseum up close, without waiting. We enjoyed the tour, our guide was a very nice, well organized, he explained everything in a professional manner, not rushing. Unless we asked, he did not overwhelm us with details.

Simone was an amazing tour guide! My friends and I thought he covered the appropriate topics, and took care of my pregnant friend really well - making sure to let her avoid any scanners or security lines. We took some shade breaks so we didn’t roast too much in the sun either. Overall had a great time!

G was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about Roman history. It was a great experience having him as our tour guide. Awesome value for the price. We had a great time and would book again.

Side note: the "skip the line" part seems to be irrelevant due to COVID screenings. However, there's also currently fewer tourists, so wait times aren't bad (Colosseum - less than 10 minutes; Forum in ~30 minutes). In case you don't know this, Rome is hot in the summer (shocker). Bring water, wear sunscreen, common sense stuff. If you can't handle the sun, go vacation somewhere cooler.

We had a fantastic tour with Frederica. She was friendly and knowledgeable. I cannot imagine seeing the Coliseum and Forum without someone like Frederica. One small thing that also helped...City Wonders uses radios so the small group could all hear every word of the facilitation. With so many folks touring these sites, this really enhanced the experience. I highly recommend City Wonders and Frederica.

Excellent.

We took a tour on 4th March. Our tour guide Nick, (Nicholas) was enthusiastic and full of knowledge. He obviously loves his job and Roman history. His English was also excellent.

The tour was just under 3 hours long. There was around 24/25 in our group, but with the headsets all of Nicks info could be clearly heard.

He was very happy to answer questions, not that we had any, as he had covered it all!

Thanks Nick!!

I highly recommend our Tour Guide Raf (Rafaella?). She was AMAZING!!! She was very knowledgeable and she totally did the tour backwards which we all preferred as we got to do the Colosseum last and stay there as long as we wanted. Seeing Roman forum then Palantine hill and then Colosseum is the best way to see it and if you get Raf as a tour guide, her guide book is AMAZING with how everything looked before.
Highly recommend.

A lot to see in 3 hours. Our guide Marco brought a lot of passion and humour to our group of 20. If you are the type who likes to linger and read all the information signs you might be frustrated as you move through fairly quickly as this a tour that covers a lot of ground! Think of this as a survey course, and come back another time on your own if you have the time. If you don't, you will still be gob smacked.

Overall it's an ok tour and it does save you a lot of time to skip the lines. My husband and I both felt that it wasn't as personal as we were with a group of 15 or more. You're kind of pushed through various stopping points and catch a few nuggets of info from time to time on the history but by no means feel immersed in the story of the historical Colosseum.

PG was our guide and very funny and knowledgeable about the site and area. We had a good group too, who all asked great questions about the Colloseum and Palatine Hill area. You get what you put into the experience so ask questions. Thanks PG for a great day!

tour was easy to find and well organised. 25 people in the group-I saw another setting off at similar time so obviously careful not to overbook. had headsets so easy to hear.guiseppe was excellent,giving us plenty of information, making us smile and happily answering any questions.

Site coordinator was a bit rude.. but the event guide Olga was decent.. was super concerned with the loss of headsets.. but showed us around the colosseum nicely.. the trip post the colosseum (palatine hill, roman forum) was average..

Group size was about 30 (not small as promised)... headset quality was good.

It started off kind of bumpy with the meeting place but once we found it, the tour was nice. Our guide was very good. I will say it was crowded and hot with lots of steps and no hand railings. At one time I was able to use an elevator but not coming down the stairs and they are very steep. We actually bailed on Palantine hill because of the steps.

Refused to offer a full or even partial refund when I was unable to complete the tour due to an expired covid vaccination certificate.

The company did not highlight that covid certificates must be issued within the past 6 months.

My certificate was accepted for all other tours (Vatican, Pantheon etc). Information about the Colosseum’s more stringent policies should have been highlighted.

Loved my time with Enrica! It was hot, but Enrica always managed to find us shade and a place to sit if she wanted to go into more detail on something. It’s a long tour, but I enjoyed it! Either bring a snack or have a place in mind for lunch after and you’ll be fine. Also, bring your water bottle!!!! Plenty of opportunities to fill it up with the aqueducts. Tour says small bags only and my tote was fine. I also recommend bringing sunscreen. I reapplied twice in the 3 hours we were together (that Mediterranean sun is no joke). Would book again!

It was very easy to meet up for the tour. Our tour guide was amazing. She knew quite a bit of History and was patient during her guide with us to make sure that everyone was caught up and stayed together. She spoke English perfect we had a wonderful day I would do it again

Our guide, Eddy, was amazing. He was knowledgeable, funny and entertaining. Seeing Colosseo in person is definitely a dream come true and thanks to Eddy for making it more memorable. We spent almost the entire day exploring the Palatine Hill and Roman Forum, after a tour of the Colosseo. Highly recommended!

Vasco was an EXCELLENT tour guide. Charming, sweet and funny, and full of unflagging devotion to dragging our overheated selves around The Colosseum and surrounding area. He knows his stuff and hit all the right notes. Yeah it was hot as a Roman forna, but he made it all worthwhile. Thanks Vasco!

This trip was my first in Rome & I wanted to see all the must haves. My groups guide was Giuseppe, who was very knowledgeable in his area. He provided us was a lot of info, as well as some fun facts. Additionally he was very patient with us and allowed us time to take pictures, and ask questions (even after the tour was over).

We spent about 1 hour at each location ( Colosseum, Forum, Palatine), there’s a lot of walking, and climbing steep stairs. Overall, my experience was great and was definitely worth booking. Thank you to Giuseppe for being such a wonderful guide !

P. S. - make sure to wear comfortable shoes

We had a fabulous guide Ambra, she was informative, funny and very personable. The whole tour from meeting point to the guided tour of the Colosseum (the Flavian Amphitheater), Palentine Hill and Roman Forum was amazing. Our group was 22 of mixed ages and the pace suited all. Would highly recommend City Wonders and Ambra.

We booked a month in advance. We received confirmation. We arrived half an hour ahead of time. At the designated time, there was no one there. We called. They said 'sorry, tour is cancelled'. There was no notice, no explanation. There were two other tourists there who were also waiting and also didn't get any notice. What a horrible experience. Thankfully, we managed to join a tour with Crown Tours instead, but that was really pure luck. however, the original tour was supposed to include the underground parts, and the Crown Tours did not. We were really looking forward to that. Awful service.

Fantastic tour with Laura Sensi for our honeymoon on Rome. She was friendly, knowledgeable and ensured that we had plenty of time to ask questions and take photos of the best views. She gave personal attention to us all in the group and checked in regularly. Would highly recommend

Our tour guide, Simon, did a great job! He was interesting and made the tour fun with his many jokes. He always made sure everyone was together and he provided us with some good information. Also great to get a guided tour that includes skipping the lineup. Made a huge difference!

We did the 3 hour Colloseum, Forum and Palentine Hill tour on our 1st day and it was a fascinating insight and introduction to ancient Rome.
Blew our minds!
Sarah looked after us all so well and kept us all engaged and entertained at all times.
She was great highly recommend.

Unfortunately our tour guide, Marcello, was not a tour guide for English speaking patrons. His English was so broken and difficult to understand that the information he gave us was difficult to put together. It was very disappointing. We did see what was promised, we just don’t fully understand what we saw.
He was a nice person, just not a good tour guide.

We skipped the lines and security check was fast. It was good and informative but too much talking.. i would have preferred little less narrative maybe more time to walk around and take pics.. trying to listen and take pics at the same time doesnt give you enough time to enjoy the whats in front of you. Once is enough. Or audio tour would suffice if your not too much into history and give you flexibility.

Amazing tour! The 'guy with an M' was a brilliant guide- so knowledgeable, efficient and engaging. My friend and I loved the small group size, handy head set to maintain social distancing and getting to explore without the crowds. Best €40 I've spent! Crown tours was very easy to find and well organised- we'd even booked last minute. Don't miss this if you're in Rome!

We had a great time touring these ancient sites with our guide, Damiano. Damiano was very knowledgeable, passionate and excited to share his insights on these remarkable historical sites with the members of the tour. He was also very personable and helpful, making sure to explain and field questions as we went along.

Thank you for a great tour Damiano!

Our guide Eddy was awesome. A pHD archeologist who had studied the colosseum and surrounding ruins for past 15 years. Great passion and sense of humor. Wonderful insight and interesting history of this amazing wonder and city. Highly recommend and greatly appreciate Eddy and this experience.

Special thank you to the best tour guide ever... Sev!
Sev made the tour an experience we will never forget with his passion for history and unsurpassed knowledge. Fantastic day exploring the Colosseum and Forum. Sev is a brilliant story teller! Thank you so much for your time.

we were early to the meet up and couldn't find the group because of all the people. I called the customer rep before our time and they told me they would message the group to tell them that I was still looking for them. I was 2 minutes late when I finally found the company and they told me the group had left and that we didn't have a choice.
I understand being timely but this company does not make things easy for people.

City Wonders always does a great job. But today we had Silvia for our tour guide. She's the best guide I've ever had in my multiple tours of the Colosseum and Roman Forum. Her passion and detailed knowledge of Roman history is unlike I've ever seen. And she was fun and funny to be around for the entire tour. Our group loved her. I hope to have her as a guide again next time we come to Rome.

Ricardo was a fantastic guide. His knowledge was extensive, interesting and pitched at the right level. He had a good sense of humour and understood his audience.
The tour itself was brilliant, such an amazing experience.
The arrangements for meeting we're communicated well and easy to follow.
We would highly recommend.

Thanks to Patrick our visit at the Colosseum was very pleasant. He was very knowledgeable and took time to explain everything as well as giving us time to admire and take picture. The pace of the visit was very good. Will definitely recommend.

Excellent tour with a very knowledgeable guide (Lena). I rated it 4 stars as it was advertised as a 3 hr semi- private tour with 3 stops but ended at 2 hrs with a brief overview of Palantine Hill. We were left to explore this massive site on our own and no one for questions or guidance .

Our tour with Fabio was exceptional. He is very knowledgeable, and knew the best places to pull over for a chat about the history of the Colosseum or to get the perfect photo. He really made the tour personal, fun and engaging for the whole group, and made sure all participants were involved and taken care of.

The tour with Amil was a pleasure.
She was very knowledgeable and welcoming.
She made sure that everyone had a spot in shade and water to drink during the tour, which was great since it was very hot day.
I strongly recommend Amil as a tourguide.

We were scheduled for the 9:20 tour. Arrived 30 minutes early. Laura our guide brought us over to coliseum and then was told our tickets had a problem. She called the office and after about 15 minutes told us she needed two volunteers to move to the next tour five minutes later. We agreed after confirming it was the same tour in English. Then dejavu same thing guide told tickets had issue (not our tickets the companies ticket). After 10 minutes told us we needed to go back to the starting point to get added to a later tour. We went back and were told they would add us to 11 tour. No additional concessions for the waste of our time and delays. We were concerned we would have another problem and called the home office and were offered a tour three days later (after we would be back in Us). All they offered was a refund and start over with another company. I was shocked for being treated so poorly. I thought at a minimum we should receive your at no cost. Will NEVER book another tour with this company we had nine other tours on this trip and all others were nothing but amazing!

Visiting Rome this weekend and Vasco was our tour guide today for our colosseum tour and he was phenomenal.

Probably the most knowledgeable and likeable tour guide I've ever experienced in any country I've visited.

Will defo use City Wonders again.

Thank you Vasco

Elisabetta was the best tour guide! She was so thorough in her explanations, kept us intrigued the whole time. It was very hot, but she made sure to keep us in the shade as much as possible. Very happy with our experience, thank you Elisabetta!

Fantastic tour! Valerio was knowledgeable, engaging, and clearly cares about the history. Good answers to questions. Lots of fun stories of the times, modern references, and showing what it really looked like where you’re standing in its glory days for both colosseum and forum. Do yourself a favor and get some pro knowledge instead of walking around aimlessly!

Absolutely loved our tour with Allesandra. She has a background in archaeology which was very evident in her detailed explanations and knowledge and also in her passion for the topic. She made everything very clear and I was able to visualise everything she was describing - very challenging when you're mostly dealing with ruins! I loved hearing about the complexity of the lifts which used to lift the animals and gladiators up to the colosseum floor and imagining the ancient imperial palace when we got to Palatine Hill. Definitely worth it.

Have tour guide show up on time and wear the clothing he was supposed to. We were there from 9:35 until 10:05 when guide finally showed up...wearing khaki shirt and pants. No blue City wonders shirt as we were told. We booked another tour because we were told ours was cancelled.

Such a great tour and totally worth the price. Michela was super knowledgeable about everything and answered every question our tour had about anything and everything. With COVID, the tour group was smaller, which made for a better experience both for the tour itself and being at the sites.

Silvia Rana is the most inspiring and enthusiastic tour guide we've had the pleasure of educatibg us. This tour was amazing. Silvia took us back in time and you could almost taste the history. We were a family with relatively young children and Silvia made it interesting for everyone. Her knowledge and passion for the subjects is unique.

Alessandro was an outstanding tour guide. Incredibly knowledgeable and passionate, but also friendly and witty, he turned our visit to Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill to an unforgettable experience. Strongly recommended!

Incredibly interesting stories told in an engaging way by our tour guide. I learnt lots and we had plenty opportunities for photos. The tour provided radios and earphones so we could always hear the tour guide clearly.

Tour guide was fantastic. Roberto I think was his name. It was only our group of 5 and he kept a great slow pace and provided a nice amount of information and history. He also made reservations for us a great restaurant after the tour. Tip your tour guides, they work hard. Minimum of $100 is my rule of thumb.

Marina was an excellent guide who managed to bring the Colosseum, Forum & Pallantine Hill alive. She was both very knowledgeable & enthusiastic about the wonders of Ancient Rome. She was also very happy to take questions. I would definitely recommend this tour...& if your guide is Marina, you're have a fantastic 3 hours

This was a really good idea. The guide was brilliant, very informative and really helped set the scene.
Beware of the steps in the Colosseum they are very tall steps! Lift was offered though if anyone needed it.
Earphones and radio were really great as it was a little busy. Guide’s English was very good.

We really enjoyed our tour of particularly the Colloseum and also the Palatine Hill and Roman Forum, fascinating and mind boggling the ingenuity, scale and opulence of the Roman buildings.

You need to be fairly fit for this tour as it involves quite a lot of walking.

Selenia was our host and she was both knowledgable and enthusiastic.

The attractions were fairly quiet I believe due to the Covid situation, I hope for the tourist industry of Rome that this situation settles down soon.

Giuseppe was a very good tour guide. Very informative and funny. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars was because we never got to actually go into the Roman Forum or Palatine Hill because they closed it for the day for the G20 Summit, which was not the tour company's fault. The Colosseum tour was great though.

Eduardo was an amazing guide who managed to keep us interested and entertained during these 3 hours guided visit. He was very knowledgeable and happy to share his passion with us. Skipping the lines and getting a great understanding of the Coliseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill was the highlight of our stay in Rome. Booking same for Pompei today!

This was a.fantastic tour. Well worth it. Being part of the tour meant we accessed the colosseum easily through all the madness. The tour was informative and visiting the arena was excellent. It was 38 degrees and our group struggles but our tour guide Samantha was great. Patient and a wealth of information. Highly recommend

Sylvia Rana was an extraordinary tour guide! She taught us so much! As an architect herself, she was able to provide us with a plethora of information. She shared beautiful photos from her book to compare the past to the present photos. I would highly recommend this tour and request Sylvia. She is very attentive and nurturing, as it was hot, she gave us many breaks for water and shade. She made our time in Rome even more wonderful.

Our guide Massimo was fabulous! He provides so much detail, history and context about everything. It was really interesting and informative.

In addition he made sure we always had shade and some rest stops thru out the 3 hr tour.

Highly recommend!

Awesome tour and experience! We had Sylvia as our guide and she kept it very interactive, informational, and fun! Highly recommend. You’ll cover a lot of ground in a short period of time. If it’s hot out - bring a water bottle, because you can fill up at the fountains along the tour. 10/10

Sylvia was an excellent tour guide. She really explained the history of Rome & answered all our questions which was fascinating. She even recommended to us a list of her favorite restaurants in Rome which was very helpful. I totally enjoyed this tour and will recommend this to many.

A fantastic afternoon with Big Mama G.
A wonderful lady, passionate & very knowledgeable. So much information & areas to cover for a few hours, but she looked to align the focus areas to our interests whilst still delivering an enjoyable information avalanche. A great photographer too.
Would love to have had more time & seen more of Rome with her.

Highly recommended

The itinerary of the tour was good, The price of the tour was, i thought, reasonable. What made this tour 5star was our guide Amil. She's was charming, Hilarious at times, but also very very knowledgeable. Really went the extra mile to help us all visualise ancient Rome and how the area/life was. Brilliant. If there was an extra star to be given, I'd definitely give it amil.

We were looked after by Sev who was incredibly knowledgeable. A great and informative tour and I would recommend it to anyone. The radio and earpieces meant for a much more comfortable time without missing any of his vast knowledge. We were there with two kids (14 and 11) and they loved it too, despite the heat! Thanks Sev!

The tour guide spoke very clear English, was a wealth of information, and even knew all the great photo spots! Make sure you get the guided tour that come with the headset. We did and I was so grateful we did, as we were able to practice social distancing while still getting the most out of this experience. Our visit post-COVID was great; the tourism was incredibly low so it was a once in a lifetime opportunity to have the Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill all to ourselves!

The tour was very interesting and fun. Our guide Alessandra was the greatest tour guide. She had deep knowledge of the history together with an a talent in acting. She made our tour look like a vivid documentary. We recommend that you ask for her when you book with “Get your Guide”. Well done.

Great tour and Ricardo was full of knowledge. Lots of walking to be expected 16000 steps. I only gave 4 stars because were 35 people on the tour and tough to control. Advertises as 20 people or less- so that’s not true. Overall well worth the money and well organized.

Wished we could have seen more of the Colloseum. Dont think we considered how long it would take to walk up and down Palatine Hill when we thought about how much time we had in each of the different areas. If you like taking hundreds of photos this is not the tour for you as we moved between places quickly. Having said that, alot of detail was covered at each of the different sites. Very friendly tour guide and due to reduced numbers in tourists we did get perhaps a better view than has it been any busier. Recommended for those who like walking and want to get a better insight into ancient Rome.

Me and my partner went on the 16th of Feb. Our tour guide was alba she was fantastic very friendly and knowledgeable. Had a brilliant time around the Colosseum and everything that went with it. Will definitely recommend city tours to any of my family or friends that will be going to Rome.

The app says that there is a cancelation period. I learned after booking that there was a 90% chance of rain. Attempts to cancel did not work. I wrote to the contact us section with no response. The app appears to me to be book book book and lack customer service.

We were guided round by our lovely guide Giuseppe who was enthusiastic, knowledgeable and was highly engaging throughout. Good value for money. Good information. My only advisory to future customers would be that it is a long day! Be prepared to be tired afterwards!

In fairness I don’t know the quality of the tour itself, as we never got to participate, that’s why 2 stars.

We were late but they never answered our messages on this site or our calls to the provided number. Nor were they there when we arrived, though they claimed to have waited. It seems that they could have waited given we booked a private tour but there was no one around with the description provided.

All this could be understandable as we did turn up late but the total lack of communication or any responsibility taken for that lack was sorely disappointing. I’d advise anyone reading this to book elsewhere, there are many options and surely others are better to work with if things go wrong.
Great tour with a really knowledgeable guide. Relatively easy to find the meet up point. My only complaint is that they wouldn't wait a lot of time to take pictures, it was pretty go go go.

What an amazing touur guide. Jaber is a veteran guide, has enormous amounts of knowledge about the Roman history. Very kind and frienly throughout the tour
He made sure to keep things interesting with his wit and charming personlity. Highly recommend him for your tours.

We had a wonderful experience with Ambra at the Colosseum Tour with Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Ambra is very knowledgeable and shared extensive history during our tour. She made it fun and interesting. Ambra is a skilled story teller. She was a joy to be with and our entire group seemed to appreciate the 3 hours. We highly recommend this tour, especially if you can have Ambra for a guide.

Overall, a really good experience. Our guide (Ector?) did a great job keeping everyone engaged throughout the tour. We opted for the extra underground add on and it was well worth it. It was at least 3.5 hours in duration with considerable walking and climbing and descending stairs but it was very manageable. All in all it was a great experience and we highly recommend.

First I would like to give Kudos to Alisandro our guide for outstanding your guidance which was very informing. He’s was very organic zed and made the exhausting experience really a nice one. He made sure everyone was following him from the beginning till the end of the trip. Overall great experience.

This is a good tour for an overview of the three key sites. The Colossuem, Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum. The Colossuem was the highlight for me and I could have spent longer there and was hoping to visit the underground section but this tour did not include that. Palatine Hill and the ruins of the palace are amazing - the sheer scale and size of the site is mind boggling. And then you descend into the Forum and marvel at the construction and layout. It was interesting to learn that once the empire had fallen, the sites were plundered for its materials and used elsewhere - particularly in churches as a memoriam to the Christians who lost their lives.

Our guide was Paolo and he shared his knowledge of each location. The group was quite large tough , 26 and there wasn't much conversation when we were en route to the sites.

It's well worth doing this tour and once it is complete, you're free to wander around the Forum at your leisure.

Colosseum experience, Roman forum and Palatine hill was beautiful experience. Guide was well informed and talk interest stories. Only group was not small as it was stated in booking (22 people). And visit was 2 hours in total, despite it was stated it last 3h. It was with "City Wonders" operator.

Great to have a smaller group and visit tonnes of areas like the arena floor and Forum to look around. So much to see and learn about, great knowledge and instructions from Ambra. Really could take up a whole day looking at everything however we had enough time in each place. Great to finish and look around The Forum. Even the lightning, thunder and rain didn’t spoil it.

Great overview of an area you could spend days touring. Half day tour was really all that’s needed for the general tourist. It became very hot and busy by the afternoon so half day is perfect. Bring Water!!!

This was almost like a semi private tour & we skipped the massive crowds. Our guide was Eddy. He is a fabulous guide who kept the group entertained. He has a great sense of humor, is very helpful in answering questions and gave just the right amount of info which was engaging. He also gave us enough time for photos & helped out with our questions at the end. He suggested some fabulous spots in the Roman Forum, Palentine Hill to get some photos after the tour was over.

If you are a photographer, do note that this tour ends at within the grounds of Palentine Hill. You can walk to a gallery (uphill terrace) to snap cute shots of the Roman Forum as well as the Altar De Patria. From there may your way down to the exit near Colosseum & before exit find a view spot to grab the best photos of Colosseum.

Highly recommend this company & this tour.

Our guide Maria Luisa was excellent. We took 2 hours and 45 minutes. Lots of walking. Learned sooo much about the history and the known facts. Bathroom stop. Water from a fountain. Go for the early tour. We went at 9AM. Tourist sites are less crowded. And it’s not as hot.

Ana was our guide and very knowledgeable. Colosseum was amazing and very different than what I expected inside.
Palatine Hill and Forum were interesting but the amount of walking on cobblestones for that long was really hard on our feet. We wore good walking shoes and still weren't prepared for the amount of uneven hard surfaces.

4 hour short tour of the Colosseum, including the arena, and Agora and Palatine Hill.

Clear instructions for meeting guide (Jessica) and the skip the queue ticket was definitely required. Guide was knowledgeable and knew their information and level of English was very good. Informative and engaging.

The Colosseum was phenomenal to see in person and every bit as spectacular as I hoped. This tour was excellent and the perfect length for those that want some information but don’t want to be over loaded. Plenty of time and opportunity to take photos throughout.

Fully recommend.

I got this tor for my 24 yr old son and his buddy. I walked them there and met guide. They were very organized and started promptly as scheduled. My son said that the guide was very good and he was happy that I got it for him. He had been before on private tour but he was younger and didn't remember much. They were given headsets and audio was easy to understand. I always recommend a tour for the Colosseum and Roman Forum. You are missing too much if you try and do on your own or follow along on a phone video. City Wonders does so at a very reasonable price. The only reason I didn't give five stars as size of group. They don't hide it but twenty is about the max I would want.

I'd highly recommend this tour. Rome's history is anything but boring but Louise Kennedy as our tour guide didn't disappoint. She was a fountain of knowledge and her enthusiasm for this country's history was infectious. She gave us more insight than I've normally experienced in your average tour. Go raibh mile maith agat Louise!

Took this tour today , our tour guide Verco ( I hope I spelt that right ) made the whole experience thoroughly enjoyable. Very knowledgeable, asked all questions asked, as well as being witty, charming and courteous.
It didn’t seem like it took 3 hours. Bit of advice , take a plastic bottle of water and wear good walking shoes. If you get Verco, you’ll be in for an enjoyable and informative time.

We had a fantastic tour with Giovanni. He was so knowledgeable and interesting.

Nothing was too much trouble. He took us to lots of little places that you would never have known to go to. A very professional and lovely service, we couldnt recommend this highly enough.

We had the private tour for 2 on a golf cart.

The is terrible company forced me to stay in an Italian tour guide, i do not speak Italian. I booked an English tour guide and they told me I didn’t they are liars and very rude. Do not book with this company, also they cancelled all the Spanish tours and English, they are rude and super unprofessional, run away!!

Great tour, brought to life by our guide Marcello! Learnt lots and appreciated the humour and fun. Palatine hill was made particularly interesting (which was unexpected). It was helpful to have access to toilet breaks and water when needed as it was boiling! Appreciated skipping long queues. Recommend this tour as you miss so much with a self guided approach.

If you’re lucky enough to have Jaber as your guide you will have an amazing tour. So knowledgable and speaks with such passion about Rome and its history. The tour itself is a great balance between the Colosseum, forum and Palatine. The views alone from Palatine Hill are worth the money. Remember to take a water bottle and make sure you’re ok with stairs (colosseum steps will keep you fit!)

Guide was very good. There are so many interesting facts about the colosseum that we could have spent all day there. Luckily the guide highlighted the most important parts for us so that we could fit in the forum and Palatine Hill. She also took awesome photos of the family for us at the best spots.

We took the semi-private tour with access to the arena. Our tour guide, Jaber, was very good. We went at a leisurely pace and he had a good sense of humour. Entry into the various sites was easy and smooth. We also lucked out with beautiful weather that day.

Huge waste of money: guide meets you for be blocks from Coliseum and runs to entrance. She was finished after 5 minutes and struggled to make up stuff she read on tourist boards. This is Evening tour which means everyone gets to leave before lights come on.
DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY

A very last minute trip booked. Easy to meet location.

Val was fantastic. He is very knowledgeable about The Colosseum and Palatine Hill. He answered every question that was asked and made it humorous along the way.

If you are looking for something to do, I would definitely recommend.

Thanks Val!!

I had been to the Colosseum when I was a child and naturally, don't remember much. So, when I went back as an adult, I made sure to book a tour to get the most education I can out of it. The universe was listening. Our tour guide, Silvia was a gem. First and foremost, she is an archeologist by profession (I told you the universe was listening to me!) and her passion and love to teach and pass along the information is immaculate. She has such a love for history and just wanted every person to have a great time. She was energetic, fun and full of knowledge. The tour itself is tiresome but well worth it. As a side note, I'm so over stairs especially here as they are a bit steep but doable (be ready!). Walking these grounds and transporting yourself back thousands of years, is a vibe and an experience. There is so much history to learn and see. Hands down, one of my most favorite places to have visited. Thank you Silvia for making this a wonderful experience!

Very great tour, got to see a lot of the main monuments. The guide I forgot her name now but she was amazing, she went into great detail about the history of Rome. There is a lot of stairs in the Roman forum and palatine hill side so trainers were a good choice. Also the stairs in the colosseum are quite high, you can feel the burn in your legs.

Although it was extremely hot when took our tour 7/26. I am so glad we did the early tour and very greatful for our guide. She was so elegant and knowledgeable. She also always made sure we were stopping in the shaded parts. Easy to find the meeting spot, on time and very organized.

Had a great tour. Excellent well organised company using headphones so you can always hear your guide. Paula was great. She was extremely knowledgeable and delivered the historical tour with fun and enthusiasm. Highly recommend.

This is a great way to see some of Rome’s top attractions. You get to experience the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and Roman Forum in an exciting and informative way. You don’t have to wait in any lines either, which is a plus. Our tour guide was Marina. She was very professional and knowledgeable. We had our infant daughter with us, and she made sure we had a pleasurable experience. Highly recommend to anyone especially those with children.

Side note for the meeting location:

The meet up point is above the Colosseo Metro Station. Once you exit the station, you will be on the ground floor, next to the street. You will meet your guide on the floor above the station exit. Take the stairs up, and your guide will have a City Wonders flag raised up in the air.

Me and my friends had an amazing experience exploring Rome including the guided tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Nicholas our tour guide was very friendly and positive, and educated us on so many facts about the history of Rome. We loved every minute of it and 3 hours felt like 5 minutes with him!! Highly recommend Nicholas!! Thank you for the pleasant experience :)

our guide Viola was excellent. very knowledgeable and explained a lot of the history and timeline of Colosseum developement. she looked after us pacing our progress and finding shade and water. we really enjoyed and appreciatedd her efforts. withoout a knowledgeable guide you would just be wwondering around!

My husband & I went on this tour with our 8 month old baby, and had Rita as our guide. She was amazing, super nice and extremely knowledgeable. She explained everything to us, made sure we all followed along and no one was left behind. We took our baby in a stroller and she made sure to wait for us whenever we had to take a different route. This was the first tour for us in Rome and we were extremely happy!

Very informative and well worth the price. Had Alessandro as a tour guide - an archaeologist who was part of some of the excavation of the Roman Forum. His experience and knowledge was amazing and definitely made the Coliseum tour a richer experience. Would recommend purchasing this experience.

The tour was excellent. Colosseum was a little busy but I expect that’s quite normal. Paula had expert knowledge but it wasn’t dry. Her enthusiasm for Roman history and architecture and for the people of Rome shone through. Having said that she didn’t view them all through rose-coloured glasses! I would highly recommend this tour and you would be lucky if Paula were to be your guide.

At first I was hesitant to purchase a small group tour but oh my I am so glad I did! This tour was the highlight of my trip to Rome. The tour guide spoke perfect English and was very knowledgeable. Definitely get skip the line tickets for prime time (I came June 2022). I cannot recommend this tour enough!

Positives : Olga was our tour guide. She was very knowledgeable and gave us lots of information . The tour covered everything and had toilet stops.
Negatives: quite hurried and no time to dilly dally
Need to know: lots of walking. Take water, lots of it if hot.
Steep steps in colosseum
Take a sun hat if hot
Colosseum was best bit.

Amazing tour with Emanuela (Amy) who was so much fun and so knowledgeable. There were 7 other folks who did not show up so we had a private tour with her. Amazing sites and history. Her passion was evident; we loved the tour from start to finish. Thank you!

Tour was amazing! Great value and such knowledge shared with the group. It’s long tour, so bring your walking shoes and hat/sunglasses. The tour guide is a no-brainer, and really adds such value to your Rome trip. We highly recommend it!

A good tour. Silvia gave us a good overview of everything in the area of the coliseum. You could easily spend a few days exploring everything in this area. Would have liked to have gone down into the basement. I understood most of what Silvia was saying. She had a nice Italian accent, and spoke very good English.

Colosseum best bit is from the metro side and when you walk outside arena fence. What you then miss is all the technical details. Palatine is not for the faint hearted large area covered.
Roman Forum is to believed.
If raining then the original paths are very slippery. Wear sensible shoes. Guide was very informative. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

Thankfully, the taxi driver knew where to drop us off for the tour. We were early and had to find a bathroom. Thankfully, there was a nearby place that was available.

Lena was our tour guide. She was fantastic. Very knowledgeable about the Coliseum, Palatine Hill and the Forum. She spoke great English so there were no issues of miscommunication.

The “small” group was over the 20 slotted for the group. With that stated, their method of being able to hear what she said was great so the number really didn’t bother or hinder us. The earbuds were uncomfortable but tolerable.

We would recommend them for future tours.

Our tour guide Silvia was absolutely wonderful! Very easy to find the meeting point. I found you could ask her anything and she was more than happy to answer. She gave us plenty of information and was very humorous. She is one of the best tour guides I have ever had.

Maria was a fantastic guide! Loved the whole tour, from start to finnish. The best audio-tour ever, very good sound the whole time. Interesting and relaxed storytelling with a sense of humour from Maria.
Excellent tour with a knowledgeable guide. Lots of great information about how the Colosseum was built and used. Meeting point was easy to find, and the skip the line access is well worth the price!

It was a very interesting and informative tour. Louise Kennedy delivered it in a way that was interesting and fun. She is very friendly and knowledgeable. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting the colloceum and roman forum. We would not have had the same experience if we had walked around without a tour guide!

The tour was great and Radu from City Walkers was excellent. He was very knowledgeable and made the tour enjoyable. Almost forgot about the heat. He did a very nice job at keeping us in the shade when possible and checking on everyone. He was probably one of the best tour guides I have had do a tour.

Our tour was great. Paola was very knowledgeable and always made sure we were in the best places to take amazing pictures. I would highly recommend City Wonders, especially if Paola is your tour guide!!!!

This was a amazing tour and our guide Laura was wonderful. Very sweet and knowledgable in the history of its past. We toured the colosseum, Roman Forum and Palantine Hill. It was all beautiful and not too crowded. It was August so hot. Recommend to wear a hat and bring water.

It was the best part of Rome.

Really great tour of the colosseum and Roman Forum with Michele (our tour guide). It brought to life the history of the place that we wouldn’t have had without the tour. Definitely would recommend to anyone looking to find out more about either place

The tour guide did not speak good English. She was not very informative. She did not make sure her group was with her when we would move. There was not enough time at gift shops, The group was entirely to big. On the plus side the guide was very passionate about the sites. It would have been great if we could have understood her better.

Nice tour inside the Colosseum, guide is very interesting and skipping the line helps to save your time in the crowd. Unfortunately there is nothing saved in Colosseum, only ruins. Good to see once if curious not more.

Fantastic, extremely well organised tour. Fascinating information and history explained by a very knowledgable guide Jessica who is an Italian history teacher. Quite breathtaking to see and learn about this amazing place. Definitely book skip the line before you go . Well worth not waiting in the hot sun.

Our guide Rado is an amazing storyteller! We loved the bit where he demonstrated the gladiator fight. His passion and interest for history is admirable. We had a great time and we highly recommend him as a tour guide. Feeling very grateful to have had him as a guide today.
Thank you Rado! :)

Our guide was lovely, very knowledgeable and a good speaker. The tour was brilliant, well paced and covered a lot of ground. Well worth the price, as it provided details you wouldn't get just visiting them yourself.

Solid tour with an exceptional guide, Alessandro, a passionate archaeologist and true expert on Ancient Rome. You can’t visit the colosseum without taking a tour. Just too much fascinating info to miss!

Go as early as possible. Rome is positively overrun by tourists. Avoid the heat and crowds!!

Our guide was very lovely and obviously very interested in the tour. We did struggle a bit to understand him at times - not his fault at all. Would have liked a bit more information and time in colosseum ie exploring more it the many areas. Roman Forum was amazing. There were plenty of rest stops and he was easy to follow around.

Unfortunately our guide was sick and it was canceled at the last minute. I understand these things happened, but it would have been nice to know before walking three miles to the location 🤪

Thankfully with the help of others we were able to still do a tour with another company.

They did try to accommodate us unfortunately our time was out. They refunded us the money immediately. Maybe next time

Emil our tour guide was brilliant she was very knowledgeable and helpful throughout the entire tour! Would highly recommend.
The only trying that we felt that we slightly missed out on was getting to visit the lower part of the colosseum/under stage. But all in all was a great afternoon! Thoroughly enjoyed!

Gloria was a very knowledgeable and fun tour guide. We learned a lot about the Colesseum and the origins of Rome. She also did a great job of keeping us out of the blazing sun. I would highly recommend Gloria as a tour guide!

My brother and I did the Forum Romanum and Colosseum tour this morning. We had a great time. David, the guide, was very enthusiastic and passionate. Would definitely recommend this tour to everyone who wants to see and hear about ancient Rome!

Even though it was a crazy hot day, we really enjoyed this tour. Guide was exceptional and very informative (without seeming too much like a history lesson). Super interesting. I thought the balance at forum and Palantine hill with Colosseum was good. Would definitely recommend.
Our tour guide Nick from city wondered was great. The arena floor is worth paying extra for. Then there’s tons of free time afterwards to see the Roman Forum antique pictures.

So amazing day in Rome.
Specially with guide Silvia-Rana, she is really good and fun when explained. She is funny and tries to give everyone a happy afternoon.
Really high recommend with Silvia (in English)

Such a great tour which my son (age 13) and I really enjoyed. Our enthusiastic guide, Amil, brought everything to life with her amazing stories and fun facts. Much better than visiting on our own. Highly recommended.

Fantastic guide with lots of historical
Information and local information. We would never had experienced and understood so much if the history about the Palestine hill, and forum without our guide and skipping the line was a blessing. I can really recommend this tour.

Very interesting and informative tour from Amil today. She as a guide was so nice nd funny. We as a couple loved it, the headsets were very useful as u could hear at all times. So glad we spent money on the tour and would do it again. We will recommend yo family and friends travelling to Rome.

We met at the departure point which was easy to find opposite the coliseum . We were met by Patrick our tour guide who was very friendly and very knowledgeable. He explained in great detail the history of the coliseum and answered all our questions . A great tour and guide

Alessando was fantastic. Super friendly, super knowledgeable, super caring. My sister asked a question early on about restoration, and much later in the tour he pointed something else out relating to that question, so it shows he really cares about how much his group learns and enjoys the tour. Cannot recommend him enough.

Simone is an excellent tour guide—very knowledgeable, funny, friendly. Overall, this was a great experience. Simone is punctual, entertaining, and efficient. He even gave us great recommendations for other activities after our tour ended.

I had done this tour about 6yrs ago, and loved it. I had some other family members with me on this visit. The information given about the tour, and the meeting point, was just like years ago. We arrived in good time. We met our guide Patrick. He was great! I had a wonderful guide 6yrs ago, and I believe Patrick was even better. And with being on the tour, you certainly do save a lot of time waiting in lines. You really do get through so much quicker. On our tour, we received So much information, given in a way to be able to absorb it. We had fun. The 3hr tour flew by. I would have no problem taking another tour with City Wonders.

This was a fabulous guided tour. Fun, interactive and the perfect length in hot Rome. Adults loved it. Two kids 9 and 14 loved it. Radu was inspiring and made Ancient Rome come to life. Can’t recommend this tour enough.

We had an awesome time with the knowledgeable Serena. We were running a little late after a mixup with the time, but she was very kind and understanding. Serena showed us all around the Roman Forum, Palatine Hill, and inside the Colosseum. Very friendly, very knowledgeable, and answered all of our questions perfectly. Had a lovely time!

Very impressive masterpiece! Nice and friendly tour guide adds more practical information to the venture. Skip the line also saves a lot of time and energy. A bit pity that underground part was not included, but still, I will definitely choose this again next time!

Vasco our guide had an extraordinary wealth ok knowledge and a fun, playful sense of humor. The 3 hours flew by, you can tell he loves his job. A little strenuous with its many steep stairs.

If you enjoy history or just gin an understanding of the way life was, this is the perfect trip.
