I had visited once 10 years before without a tour and wanted to better understand the structure. We had a fantastic guide, Francesca, who was very informative and upbeat. She kept us moving along and provided good instructions on where to stand for photos/views while she provided historical information and interesting tidbits. Be warned that the tour does include a lot of walking so do wear comfortable shoes. Palantine Hill was also very interesting though we felt a bit rushed at the end. We didn't realize there was so much to see! Had we planned ahead and eaten a larger breakfast, we would have stayed in Palantine Hill longer and wandered through the ruins on our own for a bit after the tour.

This 3-hour tour is highly recommended to those interested in Roman culture, Roman behaviour and building structures. The guide we had was very skilled and gave a real impression of ancient Rome for better or worse. The headset worked perfectly and questions could be asked during the tour. Be sure to wear good walking shoes and bring some water, because there are no cafes or pubs alongside the route. Great tour!

We found our City Wonders guide, Damone, extremely knowledgeable and very personable. His English was excellent. He led us for 3 hours without a script and answered every question he was asked. The group was about 20 people. Definitely worth getting a guide.

We had a wonderful tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum. Our tour guide, Amil Bello was fabulous! Highly recommend her by name. She was knowledgeable and a great story teller who kept us all engaged and excited about each scene. She produced many pictures of the sites in there original form.

We had a fantastic, informative and fun tour with our guide from City Wonders Tours.
We went underground and had access to all tiers of the Colosseum. Brilliant.

At the beginning of the tour, the City Wonders guides slipped in and many of us "wondered" where the tour was to begin! Our initial guide was Julia. She held to the policy of starting times as a couple showed up late and were excluded. She did a very nice job through Capotiline Hill. Our nighttime guide, Giovanni, an architect was excellent. It was remarkable to see the Coliseum at night, underground and to stand on the stage.
I would have known as much by studying Wikipedia myself. Bad English. Of course she did her best but anyway.

I can not speak highly enough of this company and our guide, Francesca. This youg lady ws always smiling, so happy to be doing this tour, highly knowledgable, interesting and made sure our group missed nothing. She was just fantastic. I just cant speak highly enough of her. She was also fantastic with our 13yo daughter. It was highly educational for her because Francesca made it so interesting and she was so engaging. Francesca made sure the group stayed at a pace reasonable for everyone. I can not speak highly enough of this company and especially Fancesca.

As it was my first trip to Rome at our if the colosseum was on the list. Valerio was very easy to understand as he spoke fantastic English and imparted his insightful knowledge with a great deal of dry humour. The small group and skipping the line were essential as even though the tour started at 10 the lines were huge and the colosseum itself crowded. Thanks again to Valerio for a great experiences Flavium Amphitheatre.

Livia our guide was excellent she had an art history degree and was able to answer all our questions well. The tour started with the Colosseum then moved on to the forum and finished on the Palatine Hill. The colloseum was very hot so do take water with you on a warm day. Fascinating to see how the design is do similar to modern football stadiums. The forum was a little rushed got to see the Temple of Vesta but no time to see the senate building or inside many of the other temples. Finished off seeing the palace up on the Palatine overall no complaints.
This tour was outstanding. We had a guide who was an expert on the Colosseum and the other guide was an expert on the Roman Forum and Palentine Hill. OUTSTANDING HISTORY..

Booking directly with the Colosseum website gets you entry to all 3 sites (although the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are joined). This gets you a guided tour or the Colosseum and then free entry to the others.

The Colosseum 'skip the line' (take the reservations queue when you arrive) guided tour is 45 minutes of information you may not get alone. This takes you to the key parts of the Colosseum and then you are left to explore on your own.

Most people will visit the Colosseum and then the Forum/Palatine Hill. While it is tempting to try and enter by the entrance to the Forum directly opposite the Colosseum, this is the most popular entry point and with security/bag xray, very time consuming. As per our guide's recommendation, head left - past the Hop On Hop Off buses - and use the Palatine Hill entry on Via de San Gregorio; very short queues for pre-booked tickets!

There is a lot of walking to cover all of this area and I would say it is 2-3 hours minimum if you want to 'do it properly'. Note that the ticket allows 2 consecutive days entry so you may want to split the visit.

You cannot go to Rome and not visit these places!

Highly recommend this tour group we chose the 3hr walking tour of the Colosseum, Palatine hill and Forum.The organisation at the meet up point was really good and well planned Anna our guide was exceptional and very informative.
We only had a day in Roma as we were staying in Napoli. So we were short on time and wanted to make the most of it.
By doing this tour we saved a massive amount of time due to no queuing at any of the places.
If you are worried about the 3hr tour being a little long don't be it really doesn't seem that long and we ended up staying on for a bit at the Forum at the end.
Again We would highly recommend this tour.

Was a wonderful tour! We had Viviana who is an archaeologist and was very knowledgeable throughout the entire tour. Was perfect weather that day. We didn’t wait in any lines as we booked an early tour. We had a great experience touring colosseum and then walking over to the Roman forum for some more ancient history. It is a 3 hour tour and a bit of walking/stairs but well worth it!

We had thought we would simply purchase Skip the Line tickets and tour the Colosseum ourselves (we had a tour a few years ago). At the last minute we booked a guided tour and we are so happy that we did. Hearing the stories of the Gladiators and the History of the Colosseum again was a great refresher. Our guide, Alessandra, was amazing! She was friendly, knowledgeable, fun and passionate! There are so many tour company choices but we booked with Dark Rome because we were certain that we would have a guide that spoke English well.

Thoroughly enjoyed this tour. They take you places that most people never get to see! You can really imagine what is used to be like! It is long, but some areas you can find places to sit whilst you listen. Had wanted to do this tour for a long time as last time we were in Rome too busy and had not pre booked. Do it you will not be disappointed.

There was so much to learn on this tour I left excited to tell my friends and family what I know!! Gigi was our guid and he was so funny and answered any questions we had. The skip the line is SOOO important when going here! The line for people without any reservations was so long I can’t even estimate how many people there were. Book this trip or you’ll regret it I promise! So worth it!

A great smaller tour of the colosseum, palatine hill, and the forum. So many details and historic elements at each stop that made the sites come alive. Well organized and easy pace for a wide group of people. While small is a relative term, 25 people was easily managed and engaged the entire time.

We had a great tour guide, if only maybe a little too much information. Nevertheless, he gave us great insgight into what we were looking at and led us to spots where we could see and take pics despite the crowds.
My three yo daughter and I waited for almost two hours and the host didnt arrive. Contacted 'Get your guide' and they refunded the full amount the next day.

This wa a full three-hour tour packed with lots of walking in and out of the Colosseum and Roman Forum. Our guide is very knowledgable, passionate, and boy, she worked hard! She explained the history with detail non-stop for the full tour. Her English was very good so i was able to understand most of the content. I could not catch her name, but she has short blond hair, and is about 5'2". Highly recommend this tour.
We visited the same day as the Vatican but even though the lady had a group of 30 she made it more of a personal touch. She was eager to show us everything and was very helpful with all we saw.

Danieli Fabrizio was our fabulous guide. With a background in archaeology, he was a natural for this tour. Additionally; a Colosseum supplied guide was equally informative. I believe a must see in Rome particularly if you are interested in construction techniques and Roman machinery as well as architecture.

We wouldn't know how the tour was because they left without us. Given the traffic and lack of uber in Rome, you'd think the organizers would have a little more understanding when people arrive late (we were late by 6 min). We even went down to the line ups to see if we could find one of the groups missing two people, but the guides we spoke to said they couldn't help us. Finally, we called City Wonders (the actual tour company), but they couldn't book us on the afternoon tour, couldn't come up with vouchers for us to be able to see the sights independently, and refuse to refund our money even though we left the next day.

Our guide outstanding...beat everyone on our two week trip. His passion, knowledge,love of Rome, generosity ...even handed out candy not expecting tips. Well, we all did. Highly recommend that he teach others this tour. Roman forum and coliseum included ...go early!

Barbara blue eyes! What a wonderful tour we had. Learnt so much from you as an archeoligist and really enjoyed your passion for what you were doing. We loved her so much that we asked if she was working the next day at the Vatican and if we could book her for that too! Not to be missed, hoping you get Barbara "blue eyes"!!!! She made our day!!!!
...excellent!, very well organized and Elisabetta was knowledgable.... i highly recommend this tour (and get ready to walk)

The always fascinating tour of the Colosseum was made immensely more so by the incredible expertise of our tour guide, Fabrizio! He brought to life by his detailed stories what life would have been like in Rome during the active days of the Colosseum. Through his eyes and anecdotes, we felt a part of the history of this amazing facility. Wishing we had taken the elevator… Be aware the steps have extremely high risers and can be difficult to navigate at the swift pace demanded by the crowds! Being given ample opportunities for photos, we moved on to the Ancient Rome portion of the tour. Having toured the Roman Forum in the 80s, we realized we did not have a decent guide then and found that Fabrizio made the area come alive for us during this part of the tour! So much history!!! From the Colosseum to the Roman Forum, and up to Palatine Hill, Fabrizio kept his running commentary going, throwing out nuggets of historical treasures that made the intense heat bearable in late August. Warning – wear comfortable and sturdy walking shoes or hiking boots to take on the uneven surfaces and have a water bottle on hand. There are fountains to refill your bottle and it’s great water – it IS the Roman Aquaducts after all…. Best part of the tour? Fabrizio and his expertise and his infinite patience with all our questions!!!
Our tour guide Alba was terrific! Her knowledge, story telling & humor was a delight, totally recommended her!

Despite the rain we had an amazing tour of the Colosseum and Palatine Hill / Roman Forum. Our guide Tizina was fabulous - so knowledgeable, friendly and helpful. We learned so much about the sites including the legends and background. We could almost feel like we were there in Roman times! Thanks for a great day.

My husband and I bought the tour + the underground experience.

Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and really provided some fascinating insights. The underground part was very interesting as well. Overall, I'd recommend this tour to others!

I'm not particularly a fan of tours because I like seeing things on my own terms, but I am SO glad I took this tour. Ambra was THE best guide EVER. She was extremely knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and had this uncanny ability to make those completely uninterested in history, interested in history. I learned so much more about the Colosseum and surrounding area than I ever would have otherwise because of her. She made it come to life, and punctuated what would have otherwise been dull moments with interesting facts and stories about the area. She was warm, friendly, and did an excellent job of keeping our large group together. I plan on returning to Rome in the near future and I would like to take any other tour she offers.

I am not a big fan of group tours. I never take hours long tours as they completely beat me down. This was perfect. Skip the line. Very knowledgeable tour guide gives you a nice run down of the history and then they let you just wonder around and do your own thing. Just what I wanted. Also, quick tour of Colisseum ruins after the tour. Short and sweet and exactly what I wanted,

This tour was very well organized. We had a great tour guide that told kept us engaged as we walked through the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum. The tour was three hours, which was a perfect amount of time on a hot Roman day. Would definitely recommend.

Very enjoyable and informative tour. As they warned about there is a lot of walking.
Got to hear about the brutal history and the occuplance of the emperor.
City wonders provided another tour well worth going on.

Our tour guide was Guiseppe Beccia (of City Wonders). He was very amusing and highly knowledgeable, and we left feeling very well informed. So much of this you wouldn’t get from a book or an audio guide - he really did makes us tap into our imaginations.

Also, from a queue skipping and cost saving perspective it is well worth it. You feel rather satisfied passing all the other folk waiting in line to go through security AND then to queue of tickets.

I would also like to make a point that Giuseppe was a natural people’s person and ensured that the elder members of the group were looked after and comfortable during the tour.

Highly recommend!!

I have visited the Colosseum and Roman Forum many times but I wanted my companions to have a guided tour (and, of course, skip the lines!). The tour was given by Gigi who was both expertly informative and entertaining (a good blend of each). I was pleased that I learned things I didn't know before and, most crucially, my companions thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

I generally tend to sightsee absent of a guided tour, with the noted exceptions being sites that require some means of transportation --- e.g., visiting the Great Wall of China at Mutianyu from Beijing. That being said, I principally went into purchasing this three hour tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill from the premise of skipping the line access.

What I quickly found was that this tour, and a second one I took with City Wonders the following day at the Vatican, proved to be very informational and it's changed my view of day tours --- at least with City Wonders! The guide for this day was Maria Luisa and she's essentially a walking encyclopedia of information pertaining to the Roman period.

I couldn't have been more pleased to have been on this tour! I will add that the booking information provided by City Wonders in regards to meeting location and time was completely accurate.

It is important not to wait in line at the coliseum, especially in the heat of a summer day in Rome. You want to do the tour as early as possible, because after 4 hours it is very hot and the sun is blazing. Be prepared for that. But also just as important was our guide. She was personable, and very informative. Her background in art history and architecture helped to bring perspective to tour. The group had more than 20 people but she managed to keep everyone together and engaged. And, her spoken English was very good.

Mariella was our knowledgeable and helpful guide. A really great way of seeing the main sites and learning about the history of what you are seeing. It was very hot, but our thoughtful guide stopped regularly in the shade and pointed out the water fountains around the fora, to help keep us cool. We loved the stories and historical information she had to share with us during our three hours together. Well worth booking - the time flew by!

This was an excellent tour for first-timers. Our tour guide spoke good English and was easy to understand. She had a passion for giving the tour!! The only reason that I gave it 4 out of 5 was that sometimes it was hard to hear our tour guide. Not because she was soft-spoken but I think the listening devices they give you are just overused and therefore not efficient. I would enjoy going back and walking around on my own time to explore more or perhaps sign up for a longer tour. It felt rushed at times.

Our guide was Antonio or Tony, he spoke very good English and always made it so that he was easily understood. He is an archaeologist and an art restorer so he knows his subject and is passionate about it which helps. He added to the narrative by having pictures available of what he was talking about to bring the subject alive.
There is plenty of shade inside the Colloseum but once you are in the Forum and Palatino Hill area there is less shade. Make sure you bring a hat and a water bottle to fill up from the many water fountains in the area.
We loved the tour and after lunch we carried on walking around Rome seeing the sights of this beautiful city.
Thank you Tony, he missed my reference to Monty Python and “What have the Romans ever done for us?” from the Life of Brian.

I've just returned from a 4 day stay in Rome, and we booked onto this walking tour on our second day, and couldn't recommend this tour anymore!
We found this entire process from booking, to finding out tour guide(s) so easy and the tour itself was so informative, that we learnt so much that I doubt you'd learn/know doing it alone.

Our tour guide Elivia (I think that's how you spell it) was amazing and you could tell she has such a passion for Rome making the tour just a fantastic experience!

Despite of the afternoon heat, we thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Thanks to Elisabetta of City Wonders for a well paced, enlightening, enjoyable tour! I love her sense of humor and so much knowledge shared by her. We did not even notice the time! Highly recommended!

Our guide Manuela (sorry not sure how to spell her name) was fabulous on our colosseum and forum walking tour. She was knowledgeable, helpful and entertaining which was important in 33 degree heat after 3 hours of walking.

The tour was really interesting and pitched perfectly. Having the skip the line entry at the colosseum was a great benefit - the queues looked horrendous.

Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.

We had Kylie as our tour guide and she was fantastic! We've been travelling over Europe and have been on many tours, and Kylie was one of the best. You could tell she has a passion for it, sharing information in ways that made sense and were engaging. She was also very helpful with questions we had about Rome in general, and was very mindful and understanding that many people on the tour had a big day, with the Vatican tour taking place that morning, and high temperatures. She also paced the tour well. Overall, awesome!

A great site to visit. Very much part of Roman history. This place must have seen lots of violence in terms of fights between animals, prisoners. It has survived many uos and downs. But today it is standing tall
Unforgettable experience, where the guide makes the whole difference. Our two teenage sons loved it.

Amazing tour with the very informative Paolo Emilio U. I have been to the Colosseum before, on a previous visit to Rome and having taken the tour I can honestly say you learn so much more about the history of Rome.

Paolo was a fantastic tour guide and the tour was well organised and very enjoyable.

Highly recommend..

My wife and I took this tour during our stay in Rome. We were in a small group of 6 people which helps to follow and enjoy the tour.

The tour start point was easy to find and started on time. The guide was wise and made the whole experience very pleasant.

I would recommend this to any person planning to see the Colosseum and ancient Rome.

Very interesting and informative on all levels - our guide really new her stuff
Colosseum was packed but we moved effortlessly through the crowds from one stop point to the next always stopping and checking we needed water at the various fountains in 39'c heat
Three hours of facts/information and detail made the time fly by would have no hesitation in recomending this tour

Monica was our guide and she was amazing. We upgraded to the underground tour. So we got to see much more up close and personal with the Colloseum guide Valentina - she had photos of artist’s renditions too. Very knowledgeable. We also went to the very top of the structure - what a view!

Monica gave us just the right amount of information - always telling us interesting things to look at and she walked at a perfect pace for all.

City Wonders were very organized and very professional too - also easy to spot at the meeting point. I can’t imagine going to these sites and not getting a tour through a company. Seeing the line to get in as we were all ready inside and enjoying the site was proof that purchasing the ticket was a good investment. Monica knows everything about the sites and she passed us over to Valentino ( I believe that was her name) for very interesting details inside the Colloseum.

There is a lot of walking and a lot of stairs - it is a walking tour after all - wear comfortable shoes.

We had plenty of time for photos and never felt rushed. We were able to stop and fill our water bottles too - very important in the heat too! I highly recommend this tour and company - I have two teenage boys (14&17) they loved it too. Monica gave us lots of helpful tips at the end of the tour too. We purchased 3731Colloseum from City Wonders.

The only draw back was the taxi to get there...from our hotel it cost 5 Euros to get to Colloseum - when we left, taxis wanted 20 Euros!! So we walked - not sure how to avoid the tourist gouging taxis FROM the sites!!

Highly recommend - visited 9:00 am August 14, 2019.

Our guide really loved what she did which came across in her vast knowledge of the Colosseum and Roman forum. She was well organized and attentive to the group making sure everyone was accounted for and had time for water and bathroom stops. Having a guide allowed us to see way more than we would have otherwise. There are so many small details and historical facts that accompany each site.

If you’re like me, you’re hesitant to do a group tour. I didn’t want to wait in long entry lines and the only tickets available were with a tour so we gave it a shot. I’m so glad we did. This was a great way to see the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Forum. Our City Wonders guide, Tiziana, was fabulous! She kept my young child engaged and entertained us all. She provided us with interesting information and stories. I’m so glad we chose the tour to view these sites.

We did the Ancient Rome and Colosseum Skip the Line Walking Tour. This was a great tour - I would recommend to all.
We first went to the Colosseum, for which the entry in truly was skip the line. You enter in to the group entrance, for which after there was a slight queue (less than 5 minutes) to go through security which all entering the Colosseum must do.
Our tour guide Emily was fantastic. Every person on the tour gets a headset from which you can hear the tour guide. The Colosseum was busy but Emily knew good spots to stop where there were not so many crowds.
We then walked to the Palatine - for which there was a small queue to get in. No longer than 10 minutes, at which point there was also a bathroom break.
We then went through to the Roman Forum, which again our guide knew great spots to stop. At the end of the tour you were free to explore the Roman Forum more, as the ticket had already been paid, should you wish.
Really well organised tour and a great tour guide. Our guide had various props and pictures to help bring what we were looking at to life. Would recommend to all.

My family went on this tour and between my mom and daughter; it was well suited for both age groups. It was pretty hot and about a 3hr tour with quick entrance to the various sites. Our guide, Davidé was excellent!! He always checked in with the group (about 5 groups - mix of couples and families) and provided great explanation of the archeological sites. He was warm, knowledgeable and paced it well. My daughter was enthralled and up front soaking it all in for the full duration of the tour. I would highly recommend!!
Tour provides a lot of historical info. Fabrizio The Guide was good. Tour should end in Colosseum so you can explore it afterwards. Don’t recommend unless this change is made.

Had a fantastic tour led by the brilliant Antonio who had all the knowledge and also made the tour fun with his great sense of humour. Meeting point instructions were clear and i would highly recommend the skip the line tour as we were in the Colosseum within 5/10 minutes. Having gone in with only a small idea about the history of the Colosseum and Roman Forums i now have a good knowledge and a great memory of a superb day. Thanks Antonio!
The leader was very professional and full of information. The group wasn’t to large and we entered quickly even with a massive crowd. Must have a guide to get the most of your visit.

This was the only guided tour I booked for our 3 night stay in Rome and we wasn’t disappointed. Our tour guide, Serefina was pleasant and was provided us with some interesting facts about the Colosseum. We also visited the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill which are a must do if visiting Rome. Serefina conducted the tour with passion for Rome and in way where everybody was comfortable and well refreshed despite the hot weather. Thank you again to Serefina for the time and effort that she has put in to making this a memorable experience.

This was our first experience with City Wonders and it was wonderful! Our tour guide Gigi (spelling?) was amazing as he has a background in archeology and you could tell he was very passionate about his job! He told great stories and was very keen on engaging with our group. He remembered our names and always made sure we were able to understand him with his Italian accent. I would definitely recommend booking with this company! Meeting location was easy to spot and without a group tour, you may end up waiting hours on end just for the ticket office!

Whole family loved this trip, our guide Elizabeth was great, couldn’t ask for better. Learnt a few things too, and dispelled some myths. Colosseum and roman forum are a must, this was one of the best trips I’ve done. Well done!!

We wanted to book one more tour last minute and did this one. It was informative enough for us and could have asked questions all day long as the tour guide was very informative!

The ability to skip the line makes this worthwhile alone for the money. Only recommendation I would make is that if you can do the underground tour as well, do so! We did not sign up in time to do so.

Worth the money!

This is a great tour. We had a fab guide in Sara who not only told us so much about the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the different temples in the forum (history built on history), but she also cared about talking in the shady areas and checking everyone was well watered throughout. Stunning scenery and such great knowledge of Rome through the ages. Can't recommend enough:)

Our tour guide was very good! I think her name was mariella (not sure how to spell it). She was very funny and charming and helped find shade while she told us about the surrounding area.

Would recommend getting a tour guide so that it is more interesting and informative.

On a rare rainy day in July in Rome, we were lucky enough to get paired up with Fabrizio as our guide for the forum and colosseum tour. His English was perfect and he kept even our ‘overtoured’ teenagers interested in what they were seeing.

5 stars, recommend this company highly!!!

This was an amazing tour. I think it was the hottest day of our trip, but Sara made it worth it with her amazing knowledge. The Colesseum is absolutely stunning in person. The history behind it is so interesting. When you ard standing inside it, you can actually picture how it was back then. Highly recommend this tour. Sara was great.
Great tour guide great information. My son and I did the skip the line and got right in which was helpful on a hot day!

I had booked the Saturday tour and I was thinking of booking Vatican tour. I can to know that there is no Vatican tour. I called them on the day of the tour and they were able to switch me to Sunday and their support staff were efficient and understood English well. They even switched me to earlier slot when someone didn’t show up on time.
On the tour itself our guide is a Archeologist and answered my several curios questions. We started with Colosseum and it’s an amazing place. I was speechless imaging how well Romans have constructed it and it’s still up after almost 2000 years. The guide shared lots of information with several pictures on his iPad. The tour continued to forum and the old city. It’s a wonderland if you are history buff and want to see real artifacts. One small thing to improve - Use color printouts instead of the iPad. It will be quicker and also bigger printouts are as easier to see.

We were bought this tour for our first morning in Rome (2 adults two teenagers) and it was a great experience. I’m naturally shy of organised trips but our guide Viola was so informative and knowledgable that my initial uncertainty was wiped away by her enthusiasm. I’d highly recommend this.
This is a great small group tour, our guide was excellent & very informative. The Colosseum is incredible site. Very enjoyable day.

We did this tour today with Viola. Even though it was very hot, the tour moved at a nice relaxed pace so we didn’t overheat. Viola was very professional and shared her knowledge and passion in clear and concise English. There is quite a bit of walking but the comfortable pace worked well. The tour provides a great overview of the colosseum, the forum and Roman history. We would recommend this tour and congratulate Viola for a great job!

I would highly recommend this tour. Our guide, Viola, was very knowledgeable, polite, and respectful of the group's needs. We were lucky on our particular tour as the group size was only 12 people, which made for a more intimate manageable experience. The tour of the Collesium was our preferred highlight of the two tour activities, although both were highly educational and enjoyable. I would recommend comfortable walking shoes if you're doing both tours, as it's 3 hours on your feet. Also keep drinking plenty of water. My wife and I, and two teenage daughters were very happy that we signed up for these tours, and I would suggest it's a 'must do' activity if you're visiting Rome.

Besides the scorching heat of Rome, I highly recommend this tour. Pre-purchasing our ticket with the tour to go inside the Colosseum was a great idea as lines were very long to purchase tickets at the last minute. We were whisked through a separate entrance, went through security and was on our way. Mickey was great at going at a pace that was good for everyone and for water and bathroom breaks. The views inside the colosseum were amazing as were the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Three hours went by very quickly and we spent ample time at each location.

We were grateful not to have to queue on a scorching hot day for this tour. It was also worth paying the extra money to have access under the Colusseum as well as the very top level. Despite the size of the group the headphones made it easy to hear everything that was said.
Our guide Elisabetta, an archeologist, was excellent and full of knowledge. She also made an effort to stop in the shade as much as possible.
The only reason I'm giving this tour a 4 star review was the (lack of) communication from City Wonders. We were given less than 24 hours notice that our morning tour had been cancelled. We were given the option to do the afternoon tour instead or get a refund. With our time in Rome very organised we had no option but to do the scorching hot afternoon tour as we couldn't leave Rome without seeing the Colosseum. Getting this confirmed wasn't easy as they were struggling with the number of emails they were getting and so on so it was pretty stressful to be honest and we had pre-booked in order to avoid stress. I know it's peak season but they knew it would be busy.
Waited in line for more than an hour before entering the colosseum. Content & delivery of tour was bland & not engaging.

Our guide, Elisabeta, was the key to our visit. As a native of Rome and an archeologist by training, she was well-positioned be an excellent guide. She easily and quickly navigating getting us through the entrance to first the Colosseum and then the Roman Forum without any lines! We got an in-depth background on both sites. I recommend this tour and especially our guide.

We had a terrible experience with this company. My husband and I arrived at the meeting point 4 minutes late for our tour. Rather than trying to be helpful we were told we couldn’t try to run and meet up with our tour, couldn’t be guaranteed a spot on a later tour, and couldn’t receive a refund. The only thing they could promise was a voucher to take the tour again within 6 months (which was virtually useless given we would not be in Rome again during that 6 month time period).

I understand we did show up 4 minutes late but felt the Company was not accommodating or helpful. Our voucher from trip advisor did not explicitly state that if you are even one minute late you will be left and won’t receive a refund. I think this should be made clear. Especially when you have visitors coming in who are not familiar with the city and have to navigate through an overally crowded area to look for the tour guide.

When asked what their most favorite place was during our 17 day trip to Italy, my teens both picked the Colosseum. Our guide Claudia did an excellent job helping us to picture what the Colosseum was like in it’s glory days. While it was hot and the sun intense, she made sure that we had shade when possible and pointed out where we could refill our water bottles.
I would highly recommend this tour and any tour that City Wonders leads.

My family loved the small group tour with our guide, Francesca. Skipping that long line in the hot sun was our primary objective. I had no idea our tour guide would be so incredible. She was enthusiastic, approachable to adults and teens, and could also find the shady spots. We learned so much. I would highly recommend.

We had very little knowledge of Roman history, so with this tour we learned a lot. Our tour guide was excellent, gave a lot of interesting tidbits of history we'd never known otherwise. Worth the money to skip the line.

Booked an AM Vatican and PM Colosseum tour through Viator-TripAdvisor (Viator, a TripAdvisor company, has glowing reviews on their site, tough curiously, there is no mechanism to post a review). Was given the wrong address via email for the local tour company's office near the Vatican for the AM tour. I managed to make the AM tour which went fine. Problem is that I was also given the wrong meeting point for the PM tour (Colosseum Metro Station). Local tour company changed meeting address an did not notify me at time of check in. I phoned at the time of planned departure when I could not locate the our tour guide. The company admitted its error and gave me the correct meeting point (Constantine Arch). When I arrived, the tour had left. Local tour company refused to refund full cost of the afternoon tour. Charges disputed with AMEX.

Cannot recommend highly enough. Our tour guide was excellent. We booked the 8.30am tour and we were glad we did, as it was starting to get unbearably hot later on in the day. The guide did his best to stop in shaded spots and knew when the group needed to rest. One of the highlights of our trip!

Our guide on 6/29 at 7 pm was boring! We couldn’t wait for the tour to end & were so disappointed . A great time to visit to avoid the heat, just use another company! Also, nobody warned us that there would be a painful amount of stairs-& we are fit.

.We booked an 8.30am start due to mid 30's temperatures.Our English language tour guide was Emelia.She was excellent. You may know a fair bit about what you're looking at, but a good guide brings it to life.
The tour starts outside the Colosseum, works its way in, then upwards, then out to the arena views,then around the perimeter to exit close to The Palatine Hill and Forum.
Palatine Hill gives best views and photo ops. of ancient Rome below. The tour finishes in The Forum, amidst the ruins of Rome when at her full power.
Practicalities:-
Be there early to get organised, kitted with earpieces and group intros- about 16 in ours. Stay in touch with your group-it's easy to get detached- especially on the Hill, where there are a lot of groups crossing and mingling. Proper footwear and a modicum of fitness for the stairs and climbs in the Colosseum, plus the cobblestones of The Hill and Forum. There are some delays due to the two security check areas - same for everyone though. If your guide is good, give a gratuity at the end of your tour. They work non-stop for about three hours to inform, organise and entertain. Well worth it.

We really did skip the line (and the line looked horrible) - we didn’t have to wait to get in to the Colosseum at all. Everyone in our tour group showed up a bit early, so we started early - recommend arriving 20min before the start time. Our tour guide – Laura- was fantastic, very knowledgeable, friendly, and engaging. The led the group just at the right pace, not too fast, with just enough information & detail. The tour involves quite a bit of walking and stairs (which was tough for some in our group, because it was really hot that day), so be ready for that. Bring a refillable water bottle – there are fountains everywhere, and there weren’t many places to buy water along the way. Highly recommend this tour – definitely worth the price.

My wife and I attended tour of Colosseum and forum from 9 to 12:30, our guide Viora is very professional and provided detailed explanation of the history and architecture of the Colosseum. The Colosseum can easily reach the capacity of 2000 people, so the skip the line group helped. There is an elevator for aged and people with disabilities. The temperature reached ~90F around noon, the tour of forum was demanding especially for aged people. There are two fountains for hydration. Overall it is great experience to learn ancient Rome history and relics.

This was the first tour upon arrival in Rome and it was well worth it! Our guide Ilaria was an expert in the history of the Colosseum and worked well witin the rules and complications of many other groups. If you're doing this tour in the summer months, go early as it gets quite hot by midday!

My mother and I took this tour in June 2019. The meeting point was easy to find and the tour was well organized. Paula was our guide and she was absolutely amazing - very well informed and engaging. The spots themselves are stunning. We started with the Colosseum, went on to Palatine Hill and ended in the Roman Forum. The 'skip the line' line was quite long at the Colosseum, we ended up waiting 20-25 minutes, and it was also a very hot day. But we really enjoyed the sights and the commentary!

Everyone in my family really enjoyed this tour! The meeting point was fairly easy to find (google maps took us right to the spot) and there were many city wonders workers who helped us find the correct tour. Our guide was Seraphina, and she was amazing! She was very knowledgeable and very interesting to listen to. She was also very conscious of the heat and made every effort to find shade for us to stand in. She also gave us plenty of time to look around and take pictures and made it very clear over the headsets where she was heading to Incase we lost track of the groups. Bring a water bottle because you’ll have several chances to refill it with cold water after you leave the Colosseum. There also is a restroom break partway through the tour.
Our tour guide Alessandro was so passionate and gave us so much info about the history of Rome. he was very knowledgeable and patient. Rome is really one of the most remarkable cities to visit.

Tiziani Fiori of City wonders was our guide. She did a great job of explaining everything to us. She was very knowledgeable with 22 years of experience. She was very humorous and we enjoyed her explanations . She was sensitive to all However, It would have been great if she had paused for some questions at a few stages and given a few minutes to visualise the splendour of the Roman Empire. The visit was for 3hours but it got over in 2and half hours ( ie 8.30 am to 11am) . So the half hour could have been used to go at a slightly slower pace with Q&A. We enjoyed the visit. There was literally no waiting in the queues . Would strongly recommend it to all 👍
This tour was a great experience. There is so much history in Rome and there is no better way to see it. The tour guide was very professional and thorough. He provided a rich experience.

Laura was our tour guide. She was awesome. Our tour was supposed to be 3 hours but she went over the time. She was extremely knowledgeable and made history come alive. It was easy to find them from the Metro.

My wife and I just recently experienced, what I believe to have been, the best guided tour that I've ever experienced. A large reason of why that is, I believe, is because of how magnificent our tour guide Halina was. Aside from being extremely knowledgable about the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum. Halina was assertive in the way that she led us around the ancient ruins, she was clear and easy to understand, and she seemed to be very engaged with her tourists and excited to be our guide.

She began the tour at the Colosseum, and unlike the last tour that my wife and I did, see "skip the line Vatican museum and Sistine Chapel" review (2 out of 5 stars). This tour actually skipped the lines. We were led by Halina right past a very long line of tourists directly inside the columns of the Colosseum. Right away she began telling us the history of the Colosseum and informed us of every significant historical detail as we strolled around the ground level. After touring through the several levels of the Colosseum, she took us up to Palatine Hill and continued to feed us thorough details of the way the Ancient Roman politicians lived on this historical ancient monument. Our tour concluded at the Roman Forum and afterwards she was delighted to answer any questions that we had.

Another terrific addition to this tour, that the Vatican museum tour lacked was the really high quality audio devices. We were all able to hear Halina with perfect clarity, unlike on the other tour, whose audio devices were scratchy and had a tendency to pick up on other frequencies.

Overall a really fantastic time with a really great tour guide! Highly recommend Halina through City Wonders tours!

Touring with G G made us realize it is more about the tour guide than having a privately guided tour.
It was a hot day, June 2, mid day and probably one of the most crowded days of the year to tour the Coloseum. We thought to ourselves....do we even do this? Our tour was limited to 24 and our group was 15-20 people in size. GG was phenomenal! He brought the Coloseum to life for us! We had some time to learn about G G during a stop for water (always bring bottled water) and his background, and the background required for tour guides in Rome blew us away.
So....what we thought was going to be a big group tour with a bunch of facts and figures was not that at all....this tour was packed full of stories of the gladiators, the Romans, archeological information, architecture. If G G works for City of Wonders, there must be a reason why he chose that company.

We had Lora, or Loral, and she was fabulous. She made the information interesting and exciting. Some tours can get a little long and boring, but this tour with Lora seemed to fly by with my full attention. I would certainly recommend!
Great tour and our guide was very knowledgeable. It was great to skip the long lines to get in. The tour is rain or shine so make sure to bring umbrella/poncho if it’s planning on raining.
Definitely worth it. 3-4 hrs trip. Marco as a guide has tons of information. He keeps it interesting. Very easy to locate at the Colosseum.

We were lucky enough to have a wonderful tour guide named Laurel. She taught us so much and made this such a fun adventure. I feel like I have such a good understanding of Ancient Rome and the history of the Colosseum. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who can walk at least 3 miles (up and down hills), and bring a snack & water!

The tour was fantastic. Our guide Elisabetta was professional, knowledgeable and entertaining. She has great command of the subject matter and provided so many interesting facts about Roman history, the colosseum, and the Roman Forum. Everything was extremely well organized and perfectly timed. Elisabetta even brought us to an alternative entrance to the Forum and Paletine Hill with no line, probably saving us a good 30 minutes compared to the primary entrance. Note that there is quite a bit of walking and the 3+ hour tour is packed with information that might be too much for younger children or adults without much interest in history, but I found it to be a perfect presentation of high level historical facts without feeling at all like a history lecture. Based on this experience I wouldn't hesitate to book another City Wonders tour. They are clearly a top-notch, well run, professional tour company.

What a fantastic tour. Our guide Christina was extremely knowledgable and passionate about Romes history. She took time to explain and take questions from the group. Her English was superb. Well worth the money.

Smooth booking process and easy coordination with detailed instruction which one cant go wrong and avoids any miscommunication.
The guide Sevac was simply fantastic in the way he related that history of eternal city of Rome to modern times. Extremely knowledgeable and detailed he ensured that there was participation and the audience was involved as he narrated stories, incidents, of roman history kudos to the brilliant work and passion

I don't know that I'd ever attempt to do this outside of an organized tour - the line to get into the Colosseum stretches on forever starting early each day.
CityWonders is well-organized and makes the experience much easier. We'd completed our visit in less time than it would take the average visitor just getting in the gate.
In addition, our guide Rebecca was personable and very knowledgeable. Even after having visited before, I learned a lot from her. The only suggestion I would have is to build in one or two breaks along the way. It is tough to do this, interesting as it may be, for 3 solid hours without a break. Also, I would suggest finding better headphones or suggesting that participants bring their own - the supplied version is understandably very cheap and pretty uncomfortable.
Advise: wear comfortable shoes (you'll be standing or walking the whole time), a brimmed hat and sunglasses, and bring something to drink and/or a refillable water bottle.

Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and engaging, answered all questions and took the time to provide excellent historical perspective / stories; well-paced and time was used effectively. The Roman Forum walk through was the high-point of this tour. City Wonders tour company is very good as providing a tour which can be enjoyed without being rushed.

Our guide Amil was knowledgeable, engaging, fun and enthusiastic! She studied art history and you can easily see her passion for Rome! This tour was fabulous, I wish it could have been even longer only because it was so fascinating! HIGHLY recommend! Thank you Amil for an amazing experience!! We saw the underground of the colosseum, an upper level and then walked through the ruins of the palace on Palatine hill! The Roman Forum was incredible and the information again fantastic!! Take this tour and be sure to get Amil as a guide!!

Marco Conti has got to be the best, most knowledgable tour guide available, working at the Colosseum. If you can arrange to walk with him, you won't regret it. He is passionate, engaging, and well-spoken. He is an archeologist by training, and it shows.
Half day tour which covers the more important details of the Colosseum and surroundings. There is a fair amount of walking involved so comfortable shoes and a hat for sunny days is recommended.

I booked a Colloseum, Roman Forum, and Palentine Hill tour through City of Wonders. I had read horror stories of how complicated it was to find tour groups but the instructions emailed were perfect and I easily found the group.

There were about 100 people with a tour at my time but we were broken down into smaller groups, with only 14 in my group, led by Inga. Here English was easy to understand and she did a fabulous job of telling the group all about where we were visiting. She gave time for pictures and really cared about meeting the groups needs. I highly recommend! I enjoyed this so much, I booked an additional Ghost Tour of Rome for my last night in Rome (which is today so we will see how it goes)
I was a little hesitant when they it’s skip the line because they also said that even if its skip the line you still have line but..... indeed it was skip the line... very convenient.

As per other comments about this tour - it was really informative and we did skip all the lines! Our guide, I think she was called Rosalba was very friendly and kept the tour going with many interesting facts, she also made sure everyone in the group kept together. We upgraded to the tour of the Colosseum including the underground section, this was well worth it to see the area where the Gladiators etc waited to enter the arena. The tour lasts 3.5 hours and includes climbing some steep steps so wear decent shoes for that. The meeting point near the Metro is really easy to find and the City Wonders guides are rally helpful. This tour is worth every penny!

From the moment you arrive at the colosseum you will be hounded by tour operators wanting you to join there guided tour however we did go with one that was very good . The guide was knowledgeable, funny and spoke great English and made the experience really enjoyable. Because of the time of year it was less busy and never queued for to long we found that it was also good value for money we paid 60 euro that was for 2 of us spent a good 2 hours in the colosseum then part of the tour was the forum where we had again a guided tour,
this was very informative and we had an amazing day. Make sure you wear comfortable shoes it’s a lot of walking.

It was amazing to finally see the colosseum, went down to the arena floor and just blown away with the size of the place. I’d definitely recommend a guide you just learn a whole lot more than you would do going on your own.

After having literally hundreds of people ask if you needed tickets to the Colosseum, we finally let one guy talk to us and explain. It seems like the tour guides and the Colosseum work together. You do pay a bit more to get in, but with the lines well over 2hrs; the extra money gives you more time to explore the city.

The best way to visit The Colosseum. This tour lasts 3.5 hours. Very informative but lots and lots of walking. You see all the big named attractions from colosseum to to Palatine, Capitol Hill and Ancient Rome. It’s like taking a time machine back in history. Loved it. It is worth the price of the tour. A little expensive but very worth it. It is vacation isn’t it!!!!!

Could not imagine visiting the Colosseum and the Roman Forum without this guided experience. Nicola was an amazing guide, leading us expertly through Ancient Rome. He was engaging, kind and incredibly knowledgeable about not just the the sites that we were visiting, but also about all aspects of ancient Rome and provided wonderful lessons that helped us better understand and appreciate our visit to Rome. Would highly, highly recommend this tour. Fantastic experience.

The skip the line tours are great if you have all the time in the world to enjoy a 30-40 minute briefing before heading off the the line... tours include an overview and history before you even make a move toward the colosseum.

That after the 0-30 minute wait for the tour to begin (they kick off on the half hour).

The tour guide is actually quite interesting however we were in a rush and just wanted to get inside.

Worst case..you can be waiting an hour before you get to ‘skip the queue’ - so if you just want to go inside I would suggest looking at the queue and buying a normal ticket.

If you do choose to go for this option... they do charge different people different rates to go inside. Ours was 25 euro per person with 2 kids free. Our group was 8 in total. We heard others being charged 30-35 euro per adult.
The guide was so knowledgeable about classic European history, and he passed it on us, which enlightened our rest of Roman vacation.
Informative, fluent , fabulous. Massimo managed to convey a great deal of information in an entertaining way. The 3 hours passed very quickly
The queue was never ending. Make sure to book one before. The colosseum was straight in but don’t be put if with the pass for the forum as it moves fast.

Lets get one thing straight this tour shows off a great piece of history.

The second thing is the tour guide knew his stuff, he really did, for 2 and half hours he kept going and going and going....

... and I just had to pull my ear peace out, hand over my receiver and go explore myself. This was supposed to be enjoyable but after 2 1/2 hours I'd had, enough, no, after 1 1/2 hours I'd had enough. Yes you 'skip' the queue, yes you get a an excellent guided tour but do you ever feel like if you'd have paid for an app to explain things, pre-ordered the tickets and done things at your own leisure you'd have had a better time?

Our three-hour tour vividly brought to life the history and magnificence of the Coliseum and the Roman Forum. Booking in advance with a tour is highly recommended to avoid the long lines for tickets and access to the coliseum. Travel lightly as visitors are required to pass through metal detectors to enter both the Coliseum and Forum. Good shoes are a must to navigate stone passageways. Radio earphones worked very well, enabling us to hear our guide, Laura, throughout. Laura’s knowledge and enthusiasm made all the difference in the quality of the tour. She took the time to share with us little known facts and brief stories that enriched the experience immensely. The only disappointment of the tour was in the members of our party who chose not to tip our professional guide, or almost worse, tipped only one or two euros. A respectable gratuity is an expression of appreciation any guidebook would recommend for the quality of this tour.

My husband and I booked this tour the day before once we were already in Rome. The directions for how to find the tour were accurate. Our tour guide was great. Spoke English well and was very knowledgeable. We had an older gentleman in our group that had some difficulties walking and she made sure he made it to each stop. Well worth the money for the tour and easy entry. Glad we didn’t do this on our own!

We’re a couple in our early forties, we saw this tour on TripAdvisor and booked it. Our tour guide Emanuala, was a local guide from Rome. She gave us a an overview of the history of the Colosseum, pointed out the different construction material used, seating according to social structure. She also painted a picture of the different gladiator games that took place there.
The Ancient Rome (forum) part of the tour was more interesting to us and Emanuala was very good at explaining the different structures that were there and the various buildings surrounding it.
There were a couple of elederly people in the tour that struggled with the steep stairs in the colosseum and the Forum.

The tour of the Colosseum was excellent! Plenty of time to take photos and listen to the very knowledgeable guide. It was a very hot day so he tried to get us into the shade when touring the Forum and Palatine Hill. He must have been a history major as his knowledge of the Romans was very impressive! The tour was 3 1/2 hours and worth every penny!

This is my second time doing this tour in the past 5 years. Last time was during August and it was unbelievably crowded. This time was September and I was hoping for fewer crowds. Unfortunately, that was not to be. However, our guide, Paula was fantastic. She was a archaeologist by education was very knowledgeable and interesting to listen to. The skip the line tour is the ONLY way I would do this tour due to the huge volume of people.

I would definitely recommend getting the skip the line as the wait time to get in is hours where as for me I had my own line for getting my ticket, they give you a time and then when it is your time you walk straight through. Think the whole process took me 15 minutes and the normal line wait time was 2 and a half hours

Meeting point was not as advised .Also we were asked to wait at a certain spot and ,but then found that we were being pulled up for waiting there
Guide was good and knowledgeable . Head sets were issued and were great .The tour itself did not go to all the locations .
It rained towards the end of the tour and we had to take shelter and were told to go down on the lift and wait at the exit but no one came and found us and the tour eneded wityhout us .We had to go looking for someone to return our headsets

My wife and I did the Skip the Line tour of the Colosseum and it was worth every cent...or Euro!! The place was packed but we just strolled through with our ticket. Don't get me wrong, there were still a lot of people around but at least you didn't have to sit around and wait for hours in line to get in. The tour guide was awesome (sorry I can't remember her name) but she was extremely knowledgeable and new lots and lots of different facts about the Colosseum. Highly Recommended

Tiziana (sp?) was a great tour guide - she was really engaging and knowledgeable. Her English was great. The tour covered the Colosseum and Roman Forum and it was worth it just for the skip the line at the Colosseum! It would have been nice to end at the Colosseum however so we could spend time there by ourselves and take everything in - rather than end at the Roman Forum.

Never saw how big the lines were for the others. We met our guide, small group of 12 and we waited for around five minutes to enter the Colosseum. The delay was due to one of the X-ray machines breaking down. The entry into the forum took no time at all.

Would recommend a tour, we used Overome. The places are massive and the guides experienced and knowledgeable ensure that you see the highlights.

Don’t miss a tour of the colosseum!!!
I have been to Rome a few times and have visited the colosseum every time. This time My fiancé and I did the €60 each guided tour of the Colosseum, arena, underground and forums. This was a brilliant tour and defiantly the tour to do if your a history buff. As I said I have visited the colosseum many times and yet on this tour I learnt new things. The underground is amazing and I can’t believe I hadn’t done it before.
It is a lot of walking so I suggest you do this tour early in your trip if your not used to walking as your looking at an hour in the Colosseum and then an hour in the forums.
If your not into history that much but still want to visit the colosseum and forums I’d say the minimum you should buy is a skip the line pass and the audio guide or take a travel book at least.
The queues are long as this is as you’d expect a top attraction.

Mention Rome and of course the Colosseum and Roman Forum come to mind. Totally worth pre-booking to avoid the ticket purchase queues, but be aware that there are many touting tickets all around the Colosseum and ancient ruins who may not offer genuine tickets. Worth buying a 48 hour/2 day pass including the Palatine Hill/Roman Forum and the Mamertine Prison (where the Apostle Paul was incarcerated prior to his execution and where he wrote 2 Timothy. There are ticket offices at all 3 venues that sell the tickets. Expect long queues into the Colosseum and Forum due to security checks. Well worth the wait.

Definite recommend for a visit inside, you can see how amaze ancient human have suck great brain to build it.

Make sure book with skip the line as save you hell lots time. People queue for ticket over 1-2 hours before get in.

Highly recommend for one a life time.

We wanted an all encompassing tour of the Colosseum and surrounding area. Booking was simple. Meeting tour guide was not difficult. The tour guide's name was Guilda or Julian, not sure. Anyway, she was amazing and did a terrific job. She was so knowledgeable and engaging. She truly wanted everyone to have a great experience. The Colosseum was magnificent and presented well by the guide. She gave plenty of time to take pictures. She also walked us around and explained all the ancient Roman ruins in the area. I recommend this tour for anyone with half a day in Rome.

I have tried to contact via tour and trip advisor both about this bad experience and neither er will contact me. The only reason this trip got any stars from me wa sbecause of Carlo our guide for the first half of the morning around the colosseum. I want half of my money back as our tour guide, called Colin, on the 2 nd part of the tour, Roman forum and palatine hill, was rude, abrasive, impatient and unhelpful. His 40 min tour started from the minute he introduced himself at the meeting point at the colosseum then walked away from us and left us standing in the baking sun, another ten minutes walking to the forum, then a brief monologue of patronising rubbish about Romulus and Remus, a ten minute walk to a viewing poi=int where he vaguely pointed out some points of interest. He then asked us if we had any questions and when I asked him he told me to wait because he wasn’t finished but proceeded to try and sell a tour round the Vatican the next day.

This was a great tour for our family. Our 7-year old was able to make this without a problem. Laura was our tour guide and she was fabulous. She spoke perfect English and accentuated the history with interesting side notes. There are very few restaurants near the Coliseum. Our tour was in early July and we recommend carrying water with you. Highly recommend the Skip the Line half day tour with City Wonders. It was excellent!

You might think 3 hours is long, but you don't notice it. We were there in May and the weather was great, sunny, but not hot. Do bring sunglasses and a hat. When booking the tour they do advice you to bring your own water and something to eat. Our tour guide was very good, we were with a group of 15 I think and he remembered everybody's name. I would advise to take a tour to see these places, because it is so busy with tourist and we were glad skip the line passes were included, because the lines are really long and also if you don't really know the history of these places, you might think what's the point in looking at old buildings.

We had a wonderful tour of the Colosseum, the Forum and the Palatine Hill yesterday with the charming Alessandra. Despite large crowds, our. group was truly able to 'skip the line' and get right into the Colosseum with our City Wonders tour guide. Alessandra was genuinely interested in sharing her country's culture, history and monuments with visitors and was gracious, knowledgeable and good-humoured. The City Wonders staff were well-organized and provided very clear instructions for our meeting place and how to prepare for this tour. We are SO GLAD that we booked this tour in advance. Not only did we avoid waiting in line, we had a much richer and more informative visit than if we had just done the tour ourselves.

City Wonders did a great job getting everyone into their tour groups in the throngs outside the colosseum. Directions on meeting up with the group were perfect. We got through security quickly. Alessandro was a terrific guide, knowledgeable and charming. He kept the group moving and in the shade, being sure to get us to water fountains and bathrooms on a hot day. Tour was 4 hours, but you can step out at any time. Saw this same tour company at the Vatican on one of the busiest days of the year. A group of 10-20 was fine for the colosseum because everything is so wide open but in the small crowded rooms of the Vatican museums and the Sistine chapel those groups looked overwhelming.

Our guide, Dario, was amazing! Extremely knowledgeable and very funny. We went on a Wednesday, so we didn't have to wait in line for long. We heard that taking this same tour on a Saturday would have resulted in a very long wait, even with the skip the line tickets.

Our guide Matteo ippolti shared with us a wealth of insightful information beyond what I had expected from a tour. I struggled to ask any questions as he had it covered. But to add... those who did have questions he was well equipped to answer!

Would totally recommend it easily the highlight of my trip to Rome.

Our tour guide Maria, was fantastic! She did an outstanding job of sharing the history of the Colosseum and Ancient Rome with a lot of passion. Her personal interest and passion on Roman history added so much to the tour. We would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone. Thanks Maria for making this a fantastic tour!

We enjoyed a fabulous tour of the Colosseum, Roman forum, and Palantine hill with Domitian's palace. Our tour guide (whose name I forget, but was a young woman of Polish ancestry, I think) was very knowledgeable and I loved the tour. The only issue I would bring up is that there are several tour companies represented by the Skip the Line tours (which I loved because who wants to wait in extra lines without tour guides?), so you need to make sure you remember which company is taking you on the tour to more easily find your guide (but all of the guides were more than willing to point us in the right direction).

This was absolutely terrible. The guide did not speak passable English----it was impossible to understand what she was saying. They advertise that their guides speak English well so I booked. Based on other reviews they will probably respond that they are looking in to it, but they won't do anything. I was in touch with them and they don't seem to care, some canned response. What a waste of my time in Rome.

The tour was much more than we expected and it couldn’t have been better led. Pauolo was careful to keep us together and we’ll-informed. He is proud of his Roman heritage and passed on the history of his ancestors in a way that was relevant to even the youngest in our group. This tour is best taken first thing in the morning to beat the crowds and heat. Lots of walking on uneven surfaces. Loved every minute!

My error in making the reservation for the right time but for the following day. We showed up and were told of the error and the tours were full that day. Since we were leaving Rome the next morning I asked for a refund, but were told - no refunds. Not that it is the end of the world, but a little understanding would be nice. there are plenty of "skip the line" tour companies right at the Coliseum.

Went on the early morning tour with skip the line and it was definitely worth it!
We managed to pass lots of crowds queuing at the gates and got inside very quickly. Our guide, Selenia, was brilliant. Very informative and knowledgeable. She kept us all listening and interested! Top marks to her!
The Roman Forum was interesting too and again, we were told lots of interesting facts.
This was far the best tour we did out of the visit to Rome.

This tour was a really great experience. Despite waiting 30-40 minutes for entering Colosseum, everything was quite lovely. We had a really knowledgeable guide who explained a lot about Colosseum in the waiting time, and she opened our eyes for how great "The Old Rome" part of the exhibit really ways. Generally a very positive experience. But as you do the tour with earphones and a guide with a microphone, I recommend bringing your own headphones, if you want the best possible sound, which is needed in the most visited places in Rome, where the noise is massive.

It was our first time visiting Rome and I knew that seeing the Colosseum was a must. City Wonders was absolutely incredible! Due to travel issues, we showed up a few minutes late but they were still waiting and sending people to tour groups. The guide (I wish I remembered her name... she called herself the Tigress) was phenomenal. So knowledgeable and always made sure that we got where we needed to go in time and see the important sights. I would recommend this tour to everyone!

I have only heard and can't imagine that many people who live in wrong do not visit the Colosseum nor know what the inside of it looks like. This is a feature that is visited by tourist and appreciated by them - while many locals take it for granted. What an awe inspiring structure!

I booked my tour online and paid in advance so that I had a designated time to go in the only issue I had was that it was not well documented what I needed to do on my own. So no to self or any others, if you're going to do the self-guided tour once you have your reserved time you will be fast tracked in but you must stop at the desk to receive your radio for the audio portion of the tour.

Wow this is very quick to process through the lines it was a longer wait for the audio portion. A recommendation I would make is that they have a an audio MP3 file that is given to you with your confirmation so that you could have this on your phone and listen as you walk through without having to get a separate device. But in either case you may want your plugs as it is very difficult to hear what the audio was saying at times.

We loved this tour, Egla our guide was just wonderful. She is knowledgable, funny and really made the tour special. It is a 3 hour tour but not rushed at all and included a water/ toilet break. Egla really gave some great insight into life at the Colosseum. Would 100% recommend. Take sunscreen and a hat!

Do not book with City Wonders. The tour of the Colosseum was fascinating but when we left to see the other ruins, we spent almost an hour waiting for people to use the restrooms. Then the guide took us to the Palantine Hill and basically abandoned us before the tour was through.

We met just outside of the Colosseo metro station, the process of signing in was easy and we all received a radio and headphones to hear the guide more clearly. Our guide Katia was brilliant and answered all of our questions however the radios were temperamental and often cut off while walking.

We unfortunately had to wait 40mins in a line to enter the coliseum despite this being advertised as a ‘skip the line tour’. Apparently it was a particularly busy day and it couldn’t be avoided however Katia gave us loads of information and fact while we waited.

We had time to go to the colosseum gift shop and plenty of time to take photos before going to the Roman forum a few minutes walk away. We spent around an hour learning about the forum before walking up palatine hill and seeing the circus maximus. Overall this was a great experience and worth the price, my only suggestion for improvement would be a better radio system and actual skip the line entry, not a 40 minute wait.

Only when I entered the streets of Rome and saw the amazing intertwined history of this city, a combination of different historical periods, styles and art in one place, I only understood the true beauty of Rome. I also appreciated the respectful treatment of monuments.
I visited Rome during the Easter holidays and I have an invaluable experience from the atmosphere we felt here at every turn. The greatest experience was probably visiting the Sistine Chapel with amazing Michelangelo décor. But also the walk to the Palatine and the view of it at St. Peter's Cathedral, the Forum Romanum, the Capitol, or the Colosseum was breathtaking for me.
I will definitely come back here to enjoy some of the sights and to know Rome more deeply, perhaps in the catacombs where I have not yet arrived
We had a tour from Gigi and he was so great, very funny and I learnt loads from him! Really made the experience special. Highly highly recommend!!
Our guide Rosario was awesome and she was fun. She was very knowledgable and very happy to help us in any way she could.

Skip the line is great, you pre-book and turn up on the day. It was well organised from arrival to the end of the tour. Our tour guide brought the visit alive with so many interesting facts.

The Colosseum was spectacular but the icing on the cake for me was the Forum.

This is an absolute must when in Rome.

Our tour guide Flavia was very detailed about the art, archeology, history and relevance of the colosseum and Ancient Rome. Very enjoyable despite the rain, wind and cold. Since tour is 3.5 hours on your feet, including stairs and hills, suggest very comfortable shoes and nothing in your hands.

First I have to say that our guide, Giuseppe, was Outstanding! He really made this tour come alive. The history is amazing! Of the three cities in Italy we visited this of course has the most history! If you want to see the Roman Empire this is the tour for you you get to see all most of the ruins with this tour!

We did the upgrade package with the upper tier and the underground portion. The "skip the line" really means just that - you go right to the front and right inside. The guides were incredibly knowledgeable, and did not tell 'stories'. With so many different stories about "what really happened" at the Colosseum, the guides were very clear on what they knew to be fact, what they were fairly sure about, and what simply couldn't be proven. The view from the third tier was incredible, and being in what was the underground portion was almost eerie. Outside the Colosseum, the Roman Forum was amazing, and you will walk on the same road - Via Sacra - that Roman emperors walked and see things from more than two thousand years ago. Incredible tour that you won't regret or forget!

This tour was great! At 3 1/2 house for the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Forum, you really get you money’s worth. We were all very pleased. There is a lot of walking. And in a January a bit chilly, but clear and beautiful. It took a couple minutes to get past a accent of our guide. But he was great. A very full afternoon

My husband and I took the morning tour with our guide Jaber who had been guiding for 43 years! He was really knowledgeable and took the trouble to explain everything to us. Even showing us pictures of how things were so that we could connect the dots and get a better feel of Ancient Rome. Our group was about 12 people and the tour took about 3 hours. Worth the money as you get back stories on the various buildings and how they came to be. Highly recommended!

Viator outsourced our tour to a great company LivItaly and we absolutely LOVED our tour guide, Barbara. She was friendly, informative and fascinating. We loved being part of a group of only 6 people. We got to go deep into the Colloseum and see where they held the slaves and animals and gladiators and saw a replica of the elevator that would lift the animals or people into the arena. And what was even more special is that there were two new higher levels that had recently been opened up to the public. It was amazing to climb so high up into the colloseum to see the breathtaking view. After that we got to go to the Roman Forum and get a taste of what this bustling city was like 2000 years ago. I am endlessly fascinated by these structures that remain from so long ago and the influence that Roman Culture has had on western society. If you're going to Rome, this should be VERY high on your list.

We did the Colosseum, Roman forum and Palatine Hill with Claudia who is an archeologist and an excellent guide. She really brought the sites to life with her informative tour and photo graphics to show what the sites were like originally. We really did skip the line, using a separate entrance through the gladiators gate. I would highly recommend the tour as you learn so much. The Roman Forum is a vast area so having the guide really makes sense.
Amil was an amazing tour guide. She was informative and went out of her way to make our experience memorable. We’ve taken many tours over the years but she was our favorite!!

Bought these tickets through TripAdvisor, which apparently is a reseller for Viator. The money was pulled from our account immediately by Viator - but the tickets NEVER came through. Contacted both TripAdvisor and Viator and got no response from either. We were unable to take the tour. Very disappointed with both companies as this was our once in a lifetime trip to Rome. Lines to get a ticket and get in to the Colosseum were very long on a very hot day. We wasted half our day waiting to get in instead of being able to ‘skip the line’. Purchase through TripAdvisor at your own risk!! I don’t recommend. Still fighting to get our money back 5 days later.

Overall just a nice tour, the tour guide was nice, the colosseum was crowded (as expected) but the guide was able to navigate us pretty well past the crowd to better locations, and always good to be able to skip the line

The guide was very hard to understand because of her thick accent. We wished we had a tour of the forum and Palatine Hill as there is so much to see and all we got was a brief history of the areas at the end of the Colisseum tour

So four of us were blown away with Ambra…she could precisely make us imagine how all that antient time was flowing…it was almost like Ambra the time traveler and she took us with her for a ride…we were literally blown away with her knowledge, kindness and humour…oh yes the colosseum, palatine hill and forum were like the neighbourhood with her 😆 all in all amazing experience and keep the great work 👍🏻

The tour was cancelled.
I want my money back.
What is needed to do ???

The tour was canceled 10 Minutes before start !!!
