fabulous tour and we rated it our top favourite in Rome. Book this and you will not be disappointed! Tip go early at 9 am when much less crowded!
Great tour with Simone. Great pace and lots of good info . No waiting in line (almost) recommend! Great tour
The information the guide was able to was amazing Not a rushed tour relaxing. Great history lesson super time

Silvia was a fun, amazing and informative tour guide, she really made history fun and easy to imagine what these places use to look like! 6 stars for her! Highly recommend booking with city wonders.. we did 3 tours with them in our trip to rome, and absolutely loved them all!

All the tour guides are educated archeologists who clearly just take the tours for their passion!! Thanks for a great time! 🏛✈️
We took this tour with our three children aged 16, 12 and 8. Our guide was Sylvia who was excellent, so kind and engaging and extremely well informed about all aspects of the history of rome.

Nick was an amazing tour guide and we had a total blast seeing the colosseum, Roman forum, and Paletine hill.

He was very knowledgeable and fun!

Totally would recommend this tour
Factual, fun, very enjoyable would highly recommend to anyone in the future. Nic was very good at providing lots of information
Silvia Rana was amazing. Made everything question feel important and you can tell she loves what she’s talking about.
The tour was great. Super easy to get in (no lines!!) and a very fun and informative guide (Amil). Highly recommended!!!
The tour guide was knowledgeable but could have given lots more details during a 3-hour tour. Did the tour before and this one fell short with the rich historical information.
Awful. Taxi strike so we were late. Would not let us in. Terrible experience and trip advisor did not reply to me either. Waste of time and money. Don't risk it.
The tour average at best. Seeing all the monuments was a fantastic experience however the tour guide was not very knowledgeable and unsure on basic questions.
Niko was very good in explaining the historical aspects in a chronological and fun way. Very patient, good English and caring for the whole group.

Our guide, Maria, was wonderful… she brought the knowledge and passion of someone who understands the sweep of history.
One caveat… the meeting place… in small park outside the Metro stop, was disgusting… litter… broken and discarded bottles…has apparently not been cleaned since the Colosseum was built…
We were given a punctual, easy to find meeting point. Our guide was knowledgeable, friendly and guided us at a leisurely pace.
Knowledgable tour guide who was passionate about the Roma history made this a great tour. The email announcing the location to meet could include a picture.
No guide . Apparently was sick . Tour company didn’t give a dam City tours .. People from all over the globe had booked with this company who lost there visit to Colosseum.

We booked this tour weeks in advance but a day before the tour date we received a message stating the tour was cancelled.

'We have just been informed that the Colosseum will be closed tomorrow due to an Easter celebration. At this stage you can contact Viator to have this booking cancelled and be fully refunded as this tour won't be provided and we don't have availability on different days'

We didnt understand why the colosseum was closed short notice however when we went walking around the colosseum on the day we were suppose to have our tour...it was 100% OPEN TO TOURISTS AND TOURS.
We didnt understand why city wonders had given us incorrect information.
As it was easter weekend it was really hard to rebook the tour with another tour company without having to pay inflated price but we luckily managed to do so.

I felt deceived and still to this day it doesnt make sense. If you want reliability i would think twice booking with city wonders.

The guide cancelled the small group tour minutes before it was to start! There was no way to rebook as all the other tours were sold out. The other tour groups were also sold out because it was a busy weekend. So, we did not receive a tour. Thanks Tripadvisor for your recommendation. Will definitely try other travel sites before TA.

We had the tour yesterday and enjoyed it. There can be some interference with the ear pieces at times. Was approx 3 hours but there were more than 20 in this group. Our son struggled with the amount of people
Great tour and our guide was very interesting and informative and a great sense of humor, even the bit if rain didn't dampen our experience. Very enjoyable indeed.
This was an excellent tour. Lasts 3 hours and includes the Colloseum, Forum & Palatine Hill. Our tour guide was fantastic and was passionate about her work. Highly Recommended.
Wow, what a tour! When in Rome, you should definitely book this tour. The guide made the tour very exciting with all his little stories and enthusiasm 😄 I loved every minute! 10/10
The experience was brilliant. The lady that took us round was brilliant, a mix of humour and knowledge. It was very enjoyable and an unforgettable experience.

One of those tours where my friend and I looked at each other halfway through it and said, "Wow, we did the right thing going this route for our Colosseum visit."

This is THE way to visit, from the skip-the-line entry to getting a crash course on all the essential highlights on both the Colosseum and the Roman Forum area. Saves a ton of time and hassle but you're also getting a great lesson while you're at it...in a perfect block of 3 hours (not too short, not too long).

The meeting point was a bit intimidating at first, with the crowd of people, but we soon split up into manageable groups (of about 20ish maybe)? This was the first tour I've been on with listening devices which was brilliant when you think about it. Didn't miss a word from Sara R., (nor her tour guide pole with the purple piece of fabric!)

The experience itself was quite incredible, to be in such a well-known landmark, front-and-center, and inside. Sara did an excellent job keeping a good pace and navigating through the crowds (it was quite crowded inside, so be prepared for some maneuvering).

Half the time is spent in the Colosseum, half on Palatine Hill where the views were quite majestic, and a great place to end the tour. Bathroom breaks are offered during the tour which I thought considerate, and the energy was just overall super positive, with both the guide and our group. Sara was knowledgeable of all the prime photo opp spots and also offered to take as many pics as everyone wanted. Loved her, and loved this tour. Worth every penny.
The tour was full of interesting and historical facts and Giuseppe was an excellent guide who is clearly an expert on all things Rome!

I wanted to visit the palatine This morning, but When I arrived I was informed that there are only online tickets, I press their site but thus site appear bought the ticket for 30 euro, tried to enter and they said that is not good…
Ok ,disappointed I went back but a nice lady at the ticket office told me that this agency is at piazza Venezia…ok went there and they printed a ticket fit 16.80 euro, the difference being a video….
DO NOT EVER USE THIS COMPANY..

I went back and forth for an hour and they cheat..

Gigi was super engaging!
Although the group was larger than I expected-he made everyone feel as if he was talking to them directly. He answered all of our questions, shared great stories and walked us through history…he is very knowledgeable and love his fun personality!

LC

Stefano was knowledgable and funny. He was also very considerate and tried to find shade to stop us to give information. The tour was very organized and headsets were provided at the start of the tour. Would totally recommend it
The tour was amazing! Amil is the best tour guide and knows everything about this Rome tour! Gained so much knowledge and thankful for the experience!!

This is for the English-speaking tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman forum. Our tour guide, Tiziana, was very lovely and knowledgeable about the history of each place. She made the tour fun by being interactive with fun random facts and questions. She also shared pictures of what the ruins supposed to be which I found very helpful. There were a lot to cover in 3 hours, thus a lot of walking. Tiziana gave a good pace for explanation and photos. There was no waiting in line at all!

The guided tour is the way to going most of the popular stops. Colosseum is a must, and money you paid to skip the waiting line is just a bonus. The wealth knowledge of the tour guides not only in-depth of what happened but also some of the fun facts and internet rumors about some ancient story. Again we took the recommended from Tripadvisor, and they are using city wonder company. Great experience.
A few recommendations
1. Wear walkable shoes or running shoes. The tour is three hours long and a lot of walking and stairs.
2. If you are not on a tight schedule, don't book Colosseum and Vatican City tours on the same day. It is because of a. Information overload. B. Transportation issue (although you can make it from point A to B, remember you are on vacation, so take your time.)
3. In the City of Rome, the taxi service has its APP called (iOS ”Free Now”), an Uber-like app that allows you to enter your destination, tell you how long is the waiting time, and Use apple pay. This app makes very clear of where you go and clear rout guidance. I have twice the divers did not follow the map but ended; they know a better and faster way to go. So trust them and be nice to them. You will get a good result.

Total waste of money
No help from agents or help desk
Spoilt my trip to Roma
Wont go with City Wonder again

Doing the tour without Renate (our guide) would have been such a missed opportunity. She was a wealth of information who guided us through time with her insights while never making it feel like we were being corralled through a money making machine.
BTW, the queues for this place are ridiculous so a skip the line tour is a must and to have an insightful guide like we had made the experience so much better

Part of our euro trip in Sep/Oct took in Rome before our departure back to Australia. On the 2nd last day we took the Colosseum Tour and it did not disappoint we enjoyed the experience and fortunate for us it was not overcrowded which meant we were able to enjoy taking in the history of the Colosseum. We recommend the Colosseum tour as it is an integral part of the Roman landscape. As with most of Rome history abounds at every turn.

Sara was our tour guide and she was AMAZING! She knows so much (as she is an archeologist!!), answered all our questions and gave us a great balance of information with picture taking time! Definitely would recommend this tour and Sara!!

I signed up for wrong day but the staffs have helped me with re-booking. They were very sweet and helpful.
Daniel was our tour guide and he was incredible. He had so much knowledge about the sites. Daniel had pretty much all the answers for any questions our group had. Also, he was very kind and sweet.
I think the price was reasonable and the tour was really great. I highly recommend this to anyone who plans to visit Colosseum.

Perhaps nowhere is pleasant on a cold wet day in December. Our guide did her best and many of the facts were interesting, but standing still in the open (Colosseum) in these conditions produces hypothermia after 1-2 hours. We felt we had to leave the tour at that stage. Perhaps walking around the forum and the Palatine Hill would have seen an improvement but my wife and daughter had turned blue by then.
We took a tour with Damiano in August 2019. Damiano was great, and very knowledgeable. He provided great insight balanced well with a bit of humour which made the tour and experience very enjoyable.

Alexandra, the guide should not be giving excursions in English language. Her English was terrible, barely was able to understand her. She had a very strong accent making very hard to understand what she was saying.
I was not the only one on the group having the same issue.
After about 1 hour and 45 minutes more or less I had to leave the tour. I was just wasting my time when was impossible to understand her English.
Very disappointed.

What made this tour awesome was the tour guide. She was not only knowledgeable, but entertaining, speaks English well and gave us many tips outside of the “tour” like best places to eat, where to take public transportation, best views of the Roman Forum. She is plainly awesome. I highly recommend to take the tour with City Wonders Group!!!
The tour was amazing and informative. Giuseppe was a very interesting tour guide with good pacing and it’s amazing to skip the line everywhere. Highly recommended!!

Engaging, humorous, adaptable guide to the situation with funny commentary about the current Roman government, navigating a running race, dealing with the rain - very knowledgeable and great anecdotes to give a sense of ancient Roman life. Loved it!

Wonderful way to see the site. We had two guides, one for the lower part and once for the rest. Marco was perfect. The other guide was ok. We got to see parts that others can not. Guided tour is the only way to go!!! Worth the added costs.

Tour guide Tiziana.
More information and less jokes and drivel would have helped. Went on an excellent tour of the Vatican with the same company where the tour guide was very informative.
Our guide knew what he was talking about, had perfect English and an entertaining sense of humour. He made the history of Rome interesting and relevant.

The tour guide gives us enough information and is very friendly and can speak English, Italian and Spanish fluently. It saves you a lot of time if you buy skip the line because the queue in Rome is terrible. 💯 Recommended
A excellent tour around the inside of the Colosseum, with some interesting commentary from the extremely knowledgeable guide. Well worth the time and money.

Met the guide outside Colosseum in a small group. The main problem was that the guide (who said he was a guide but not a professional guide and worked for City Tours) informed us about the Colosseum and took us to the entrance. He dd not enter with us and met us outside just over an hour later when he explained about the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Again he did not come with us but showed us which way to go. Although we skipped the queue myself and my husband did expect to be shown around the Colosseum.

I was travelling solo in rome.. so booked ahead for the tour full tour including underground and very top of colosseum, palentine hill and the forum.
Always pre book, you skip the hours long ques!
Our tour guide (forgive me for forgetting the name, began with A and 5 letters) he was amazing, such a kind,helpful,passionate and Informative guy! Even when I asked questions not related about the tour but about things I could see in the distance, he knew so much. Also made sure I was always ok, I think with being on my own.
City wonders I would 100% use again, very organised, meeting points are very well instructed and guides easy to find.
If you do the full tour you need to be fairly fit and able bodied, as there is lots of very steep steps and hills and this particular tour is 3.5hours long.
I learnt so much about the history it was truly amazing. Without a guide I would have wondered round aimlessly just taking pretty pictures rather than taking the history in.

The Colosseum is an impressive building, but without a tour guide to bring it to life with stories and explanations, it'd be difficult to really appreciate it. The same goes for the Roman forum, there are ruins and you can wonder round, but having someone guide you through what you're looking it is a must! Well organised and professional tour.

100% worth the extra money not only to skip the line and get hours back in your day, but to also go below the main stage of the Colosseum and above everyone else. There is a top floor that is gated off specifically for your group, and they ensure it’s only your group on top. In addition, the history “in the basement” of the Colosseum is well worth it as well. They only allow 25 people at a time and although there’s not a lot to see, you get goosebumps knowing what happened down there.

Palatine hill was worth having a guide and a guided tour. There is so much to see, it is very helpful to have someone explaining and pointing things out. I would 100% do this tour again tomorrow.
We skipped the long line and we're glad we bought this no-guide tour. The company is organized and put guide took us to the entrance door without much fuss..I recommended this tour company.

I booked this tour as part of a present for my daughters 18th birthday. The tour was fantastic and our guide Carolina was brilliant!
Easy to book and reasonably priced.
The tour was 3 hours long and did not disappoint.
Worth the visit.

The tour was inexpensive. We meet at the designated spot and then a tour guide takes us into the entrance. He spoke a bit about the history and then once we were inside we had almost two hours to walk around on our own. I think 2hrs was too long especially since I was on my own. I think I would prefer to pay abit more and have a guided tour next time.

The main perk is skipping the line.

The tour guide was below average and a tad annoying in the way of speaking.

Did not spend nearly enough time at the Colosseum itself. Felt rushed to exit, was very angry when I saw we were heading for the exit without the possibility of getting back in.

Our guide Sabrina was wonderful. Her knowledge of the history of the Colosseum and of Rome made for a great visit. Having our own guide allowed my friends and I to ask questions to help us better understand what we were seeing.

The pace of the tour was relaxed, but thorough allowing us to explore the Colosseum comfortably while still seeing everything.

Great experience and worth the price of the tour. I highly recommend taking this tour...
Bring your walking shoes...the Colosseum was fantastic....had no idea the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill would be that cool. We had a great tour guide...right amount of information...right pace.
This tour was great, visited both the Colosseum and the Roman Forum, our guide Mariela was great, very knowledgeable. She used visual aides which help visualize what the structures used to be :).
Small group of 15 was a great size. Nicholas gave the tour and had a lot of information and was very good telling the history. Kept us all engaged. Completely recommend the small group tour.

We had Alba as our guide and she was absolutely great! From the start she informed us what was going to happen, and while walking and waiting for our timed entry’s she was talking, we got so much history & she made it very interesting. And she spoke perfect English. We had a group of 17, so it was easy to stick together. We did the 8:20 tour, we were in the underground and on the stage area when no one else was there. Highly recommend city tours and Alba!!🙂

Wonderful small group tour (we had 14)-guide Ingratta Elida was very knowledgeable! Tour is not for anyone who can’t comfortably walk several miles on uneven terrain or handle many flights of stairs-but we absolutely loved every minute of this tour-the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, The Pantheon all were incredible! I would definitely recommend the small-group (or private) tours whenever possible-its worth it!

Our guide, Elizabeth, was very thorough & knowledgeable. We would definitely recommend using this tour company for any of your excursions. Booking thru trip advisor was a really good experience for us!

We are not tour sort of people but we are very glad we booked one through Skip the Line. The tour was excellent as was our guide. She kept all 20 of us organized, informed and fascinated as we plunged into and then through the unbelievably crowded experience of the Vatican Museums. Keep in mind that “skip the line” does NOT mean you will “avoid the crowds.” Actually there is no way to avoid the crowds, but skipping the line makes them much more endurable. We were so glad we invested in this way of visiting the Vatican Museums. I recommend these folks highly.

Bought this guided tour with City Wonders, but once inside Colosseum, we were left on our own, told to meet guide at exit in an hour! Told headsets extra through colosseum. Then led up to Forum entrance. Once inside, guide said goodbye and left! As a special birthday holiday, very disappointed and so different from the Vatican tour the following day with Grey Line I Love Rome, which was great with headsets and amazing guide.

need a guide for this tour.
She is very knowledgable and kept the group moving at a brisk pace. Well worth it

Our guide was Sergio through Avventure Bellissime and he was fabulous. His tour started at 8.45 am to beat the crowds and it certainly did. When we’d finished the crowd to enter was huge.
His knowledge of the Colosseum and the Roman Forum was impressive and he provided lots of visual displays to assist us understand.
He took photos for us throughout the tour and finished the tour within the Roman Forum so we could spend more time there by ourselves. He even assisted us with local eating locations around the area for lunch suggestions.
Well worth booking a skip the line tour and a guide. I would highly recommend it.

The guide was too fast, too off late and then disappeared down some stairs where we lost track of the group...others were behind us as well. Entrance was backed up, we were 45 minutes to one hour behind schedule and had t o rush to meet guide at the arch

The only way to see these sites. The line is too long to wait. Our guide was knowledgeable and very good. She focuses on the highlights only, sometime you feel rushed, but there is so much to see, that at the end I’m glad we did all three sites in the three hours.

Great knowledge of the colosseum and it's background. Our guide was awesome and taught us all sorts of new things about Rome.

Totally recommend!

The whole tour was fascinating and very informative about all sites visited! Sara, our guide, had a fantastic knowledge and good sense of humor. She rarely stopped talking and answered all our questions. Would I recommend this tour? ABSOLUTELY! If you get Sara, you’ll be delighted!!
Walking was strenuous and guide was very detailed which sometimes was overwhelming. The accent of the guide was difficult to comprehend at times.

This was the third tour we have done with City Wonder. The first two were wonderful! Unfortunately today we had a tour guide who claimed to be in no hurry, but when it came to stairs, she was off and running. When another visitor went ahead to tell her I was slow on the stairs, she returned and gave me a tongue lashing on how this was a walking tour. She was completely condescending. She reminded me that she had 18 visitors to tend to (although she didn't know I was missing).
Her narrative was very bland - at most she had the attention of 4 out of 18.
Prior to my "slowness" she had been asked to slow down and she told that visitor that she could find him another tour guide!
I've never been treated in this fashion by a paid guide! I was totally appalled that a tour company of this reputation would employ such an unempathetic and rude guide.
I departed the tour early. (Maybe I should have opted for that other tour guide!!)

This was a great tour to learn so much about the colosseum and the history. We were disappointed that a lot of it is not the original but rebuilt over the years but our guide was able to show us some pictures online to show what things really looked like. Beware that there are a lot of in your face guys trying to sell you water, umbrellas and hats before the tour and No is not in there vocabulary. They were relentless. The 3:00pm tour on a 80+ degree day was tough due to no shade but our guide tried to find shade when she could. If we did this on our own, we would have missed so much.

Ridiculously expensive tour. Better to buy the tickets yourself for just 6 euros than the 55 something euro I paid per person. Unfortunately I missed this tour bu just fee minutes and they were not accommodating at all

Our guide was very knowledgeable, made sure everyone had time to stop for photo opportunities, and kept us moving. It's definitely worth it just to be able to skip the lines, though you do still have to go through security. Bring a water bottle as there are several places to refill it

Contact information and directions were sent timely and seemingly with specific directions. Unfortunately, we discovered at the Arch outside of the Colosseum that we did not have to redeem our voucher for tickets. Once we discovered that we began looking for our connection. There were many connections and tours at the Arch and it took awhile to find our connection. Very frustrating. Not sure any of the arrangements helped with speeding up our entrance to the Colosseum. Finally, the arrangement is a “ skip the line” process, not a tour.

This was a very good and informative tour. Our tour guide Laura was very informative and knowledgeable and was able to show bring to life what this place must of been like back in it's hay day. It's important to have a good guide so you know what you are looking at and it's history. Everything was explained in detail. This is a three our tour for the Colosseum and the surrounding ruins and there's a lot of walking so you need comfortable shoes. This tour not recommended for much older folks or people with small children in stroller as you have to go up steep steps, hills and uneven brick pavement.
Very nice way to experience the colosseum, the forum and the palatine hill. Keep in mind that this tour covers different attractions, I recommend you allocate 2-3 hours for it!

It was exciting to see the Colosseum, but this tour was a poor experience. Our tour guide was kind and knowledgeable, but she spoke English with such a thick Italian accent that you could not understand what she was saying. I left feeling uninformed and tired.

Overall, our tour was just average. Our guide Mariela was a little difficult to understand and the tour was packed with over 25 people. I would have liked a little more history on the tour as her explanations were pretty basic, and solely focused on the architecture. After the tour ended, we walked around for another half hour and listened to a Rick Steves free audio tour about Ancient Rome and it was far better than the one we received from Mariela. The only benefit to the tour was the ability to skip the long entrance lines to the colosseum and the ruins. If there’s a way to do that without paying for this, I would do that instead. Otherwise, some people in our group came in with the group and then left to explore on their own in the colosseum since the tour of colosseum was pretty limited.

We really enjoyed our tour to see the « basics » or ancien Rome. Our wonderful tour guide Laura (Laurel) made it all come to life with interesting anecdotal stories and historical references. Would highly recommend.

The meetup point was easy to find, and the staff began by arming us with our personal headsets to ensure we could hear our tour guide amongst the horde of other visitors. We were fortunate enough to have Gigi as our guide, who was extremely knowledgeable and energetic. His narratives kept our 11 year old son completely engaged for the duration of the tour. I could not have imagined this tour with anyone other than Gigi. It was an unforgettable highlight to our vacation.

Our guide Igor was fantastic, very knowledgeable and made sure our pace was comfortable for everyone in our group.
It was a great tour.

Thanks for a fabulous experience. Valerio, our guide was so knowledgeable and brought his extensive experience to the tour. He provided detailed information on all aspects of the Colosseum and Ancient Rome - couldn’t have asked for a better tour. Rome is amazing.
Everything was great but remember to meet up with the person for them to get you in. Without them you’re not getting in, so get there early and look for a blue polo shirt near the pizzeria.

Francesca was an informative engaging tour guide. The group was a little larger than we had hoped (about 18?) but she interacted with everyone in the group.
The skip the line entrances are so worth it! We were able to spend a satisfactory amount of time at each location because we weren’t standing in line.
Would definitely recommend this tour and Francesca!

The tour was well organized and our guide, Fabrizio, was engaging and knowledgeable. It is, however, very hot in August but that isn't the company's fault!

After my credit card was rejected over night for mysterious reasons, the company sorted it out in 10 mins on the phone.
Tour guide was very knowledgeable and funny. He took the time to entertain everybody including the few children that were in the tour. Highly recommended tour.
Convenient with skip the line, informative guide who made the day interesting. Would recommend to anyone wanting to visit
This tour was so cool we loved it we got to hear all about how the colosseum was built and what it was used for our guide was amazing he was funny and interesting loved him his was matej

Certainly, the sights were amazing to see! Our guide did not read his audience well as he went way too deep into topics and was boring almost the entire group. Rather than taking time to read the group, he continued on and on, rarely allowing time for questions or noticing that the group had lost interest.
Skip the Line is the only way to go. Lots of walking as expected. We thought it was well worth the money!

3h with a guide not engaging
we wait a lot everywhere and the guide was not using that time to share anything
does not worth that such expensive price !!!

Our tour was absolutely amazing! Our guide, Davide, was so informed and just gave us information about everything and left nothing out! He was considerate as well, he gave us chances to refill our water and rest since it was 98° that day. He was very kind, helpful, and attentive! I would do this again 100%.

Our tour guide Elizabeth was full of knowledge and made this tour a memorable one. My kids enjoyed her humor and knowledge. We took an early morning tour and it helped a lot with crowd. We just walked right into colosseum and enjoyed it. She was so thoughtful of the sun and made us stand in shade while she explained all the things. Roman forum was also included in this and we enjoyed it a lot.

Given the alternative of doing the Colosseum without a guide and without a specific time, this tour made sense and cut down on wasting time. However, no matter how you cut it the tour is a huge mass of humanity trying to stick together with the guide so you can hear what he/she has to say and the guides are very knowledgeable. If not for the huge crowd this would be 5 stars. It is a place not to miss and this tour probably makes it easy as possible.

You really get so much more from your visit if you have a guide that can tell you the history and significance of the sites. Our guide Alessandra was very knowledgeable, personable and expert keeping the group together with clear instructions. We enjoyed our tour very much.

This was money well spent. It was worth it alone to skip the line. It was a very hot day, but our guide was great and did a nice job of finding shade. I liked how you were given a little free time to explore the Colosseum and take pictures on your own. Also being able to see Palatine hill and the Forum too was great. My two teenage daughters found it worthwhile as well. I definitely recommend this tour.

Mickey T fabulous informative guide. The tour was at a great pace both walking and factually. Pleasant demeanour with the knowledge to bypass hold ups without missing anything.
Highly recommend
Thanks for pleasant and informative tour. Special thanks to our guide Antonio for good knowledge, good English and good humor.
The tour is absolutely wonderful and Emiliano is the best tour guy we could have had. He is full of knowledge and truly enjoys his job! Great views!

The meeting point was easy to find and the headsets worked well, we had Fabrizio as our guide. The group wasn’t too big so it was easy to keep up with everyone.

The tour guide appointed to us through the colosseum was fantastic and seeing the underground area made the tour even more amazing.

We did a 12pm tour and it was extremely hot, so by the time we got to the Roman forum there were a few people opting out early. I would suggest doing an earlier time if possible to beat the heat as there is not much shade.

Overall a great tour and seeing the colosseum was a highlight of our trip.

Niccola was an excellent guide. Our tour lasted three hours and he spoke the entire time. He knew all the ins and outs of the forum and colosseum. He was very thorough and was able to answer all questions. He dispelled common myths.

Time is precious especially when you are in Rome/Vatican so instead of waiting in line for hours, the best way to do it is getting a tour that has "skip the line". We did the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill with Urza (Sp?!?). He got us in pretty quick since they have a special entrance for group tours. The tour was very informative and he was very knowledgeable.
Two days after, we did another tour with City Wonders (Skip the line Vatican Museum etc.) and our tour guide was PG, we enjoyed our tour with him as well and he gave us a lot of information!

We had late tour at 15:00. I was skeptical about meeting spot but there were many staff with blue polo shirts so it was easy to find. We were assigned and divided into groups. Franci, our guide, was excellent. My teenage son would have got bored without the guide. The tour lasted about 3 hours but with many shades, stops and water break it didnt feel that long. It was kinda hard to climb palestine hill toward the end but the view was magnificent from there. Well worth it. Several dropped out of tour when they wanted to. But we were glad we stick to the end. THIS is one of MUST!

You could spend days wondering the ancient grounds but this tour and the guide were very informative and knowledgeable. Would highly recommend. The easy entry is worth the price With the addition of a great guide it was an excellent experience

Yes it’s busy and crowded but the Colosseum is one of those places you shouldn’t miss. Our guide was terrific and skirted the crowds as much as possible while bringing Ancient Rome to life, even for my teens, who said it was their favorite part of our time in Rome.

Our guide, Eleanora, was great. She is from Rome and the love the feels for her city really was apparent in how she spoke about the ancient Romans. It was fascinating to walk in the Colosseum and to walk through the ruins of the forum.

Claudia was our tour guide and was so knowledgeable and fantastic! I would highly recommend going to a tour with Claudia
She has a wealth of history and clearly is passionate about the Rome, where she is from.

Claudia also gave us some great restaurant options and by far was our best meal in Rome!
Great tour with Antonio, having an archaeologist do the tour was amazing. Easily found our tour group. Well worth the expense.

Afternoon tour in sweltering heat but Matej, our guide, was really aware of this and took every opportunity to find shade and plenty of water stops. Really informative and interesting tour, well worth putting up with the heat! Thanks Matej.

Again there where many tours to choose from for this special sight. After some research, we decided this one would meet our criteria both time wise, content and detail. If your looking for a good coverage without the saturation of some tours, these guys have it covered.

Our guide Viola was great. Despite being pregnant in the over 30 degree heat, she didn’t show any signs of discomfort and remained cheerful during our one hour wait to get into the Colosseum. We had expected that we would be skipping the line but we seemed to be in the normal group line, which was very long, even at 3pm. People were wilting and overheating as most of the time there was no shade and nowhere to sit down. Quite a few people left the tour early as they were too hot and tired. The content was extremely interesting though and Viola was very knowledgeable and personable. Be prepared for a lot of walking and standing, with not many places to rest. Possibly a morning tour might be a good idea, as you’re more likely to be fresher at the beginning of the day.
Our tour guide Ilaria was excellent, very well prepared and happy to answer all our questions. Very complete. I recommend it.

Interesting & informative tour & our guide Alexandra was fantastic. She was extremely knowledgeable and really tried to make our experience great. However, we spent many hours in the extremely hot sun (very little shade) and the tour was too long in these conditions. This was not the fault of our guide as she really did try to make us more comfortable in the heat, but you can’t control weather in Rome. If you have children like us I would recommend a shorter tour. In saying this, I am still really glad that I did it and will have some wonderful memories and great photos. The only disappointing moment was before our tour began we had an extremely rude check in person, she told us the 3pm tour would leave without us while my son was using the restroom if he didn’t finish in 1 minute, I couldn’t believe this attitude from her & thankfully once checked in we managed to get a lovely guide who was so much more caring & understanding & who happily waited if any of us needed the restroom.

So a few days prior to the visit they have made the tour 2 hours earlier (8:30 instead of 10:30) which was a brilliant decision as the lines were not as full as when we came out.

The tour was fascinating and the guide spoke very good english (something which was not the case on our tour to Vatican with a different company)

Great and to the point tour- very much recommended

Loved our City Wonders tour of the Colosseum, Forum, and Palatine Hill. It was well worth the price. Our tour guide Sylvie was outstanding--very knowledgeable, interesting, and easy to understand. We felt like we were touring with a personable friend, albeit a very experienced and educated one!

I was concerned about finding the meeting location, but it was much easier than I thought. The staff of City Wonders all wear blue shirts and many are waving flags, so finding them was no problem. I'd suggest arriving 20-30 minutes before your tour start time.

The headsets for the audio worked well and the group size was such that you could take pictures and ask questions. At the end of the tour, you can remain in the Forum area and see the Palatine Hill. Your guide can help you make "after-tour" plans and suggest which exit to use based on where you want to go next.

I'm so glad we took this tour and avoided the long lines and the confusion associated with getting a ticket and entering the Colosseum.

We did this tour and loved it. It was hot our day, but the guide did a great job of getting the group into the shade. Bring a water bottle with, as there are places all over Italy to refill the bottle. Wear comfortable shoes!
Amazing tour by our highly knowledgeable and personable guide, Emanuela. Despite it being scorching hot, but she was full of energy, enthusiasm, and patience.

This experience was definitely worth it. Meeting up with our guide was very easy. It was also clear that she had done this tour many times as she knew lots of information and history about the sites.
Just because the title says 'skip the line' doesn't mean that you won't have to go through security. With this tour group, you will go through the 'tour' security line. It is still totally worth it. We only stood in line for maybe 5 minutes. Which is amazingly short for any of the big Italian sites you will see. Our guide was also talking about history and other information while we waited so it made the wait seem even shorter.

Loved this tour. Amil our guide was brilliant. Despite being Spanish! she spoke excellent English & she knew so much about the history it was very interesting. We skipped so many queues it was excellent. We were on the 09:30 am tour on a Saturday and this was a good time. The queues outside were huge & we bypassed them all. By 11am there were loudspeaker announcements saying the general entry was closed. (Too busy) ! It is essential to pre-book this and despite being a big group 20+ City Wonders were fantastic. 100% recommended. Well done Amil.

Visiting The Colosseum was top of our 'to do list' in Rome and I was very confused by the sheer number of tour options available but very pleased that I found this one as it provided everything we were looking for.

We took the 3pm English tour; we had deliberately planned a quiet morning in prep knowing that there would be a lot of walking. A couple on our tour had also done a Vatican walking tour that morning. It is physically demanding so I recommend doing as we did and having a lazier rest of day before or after.

The instructions provided about where to meet were very helpful and we were greeted by a whole host of City Wonders staff who registered us. Our tour guide was Laura (or Laurel as she explained her nickname was); she was excellent and
provided a very engaging tour.

Although this tour allows you to 'skip the line' you still do have to queue (with the group) tp get through the various security checks; however, by being on the tour allowed Laura to tell us some key information so didn't really feel as if we were waiting.

Through no fault of Laura or City Wonders we had to wait 30 minutes to get into the Roman Forum due to the queues through security checks which felt a little excessive and meant we didn't have time to do Palatine Hill too.

Overall this was a really good tour though and I'd definitely recommend.

Fabrizio led us on a great tour through the colosseum and the surrounding areas, providing us with a tremendous amount of information and insight on the history. Although it was crowded and raining, he managed the group well keeping us together and relatively dry.

Visiting the sites was fun, but overall the tour itself was hectic. As you can imagine, there are a lot of stairs in the colosseum. My family included an older adult with knee issues and a toddler. Though the tour sounds accommodating to various physical abilities in the description, it really didn't work out that way. The group was also quite large and the audio headsets provided to hear your guide barely worked. I wouldn't recommend this tour. Just go to the sites early enough to avoid the long lines. You'll likely have a better time on your own.

Great tour but be prepared to get your exercise for the day. ! I learned a lot. It was great to walk off all that Pasta I ate in Rome. The tour was guide was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate. I would highly recommend it. The Guide takes their time and you won't be rushed. Anybody can do it. Just remember, it is a 1/2 day walking tour!

Really enjoyed the tour, was a bit concerned when I saw how many were there but shouln't have worried, with the use of headphones it was very easy to hear the guide. The guide was very good, informative, knowledgable and happy to answer all questions, even some tips on restaraunts for the evening.

We enjoyed our tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Forum. Our tour guide was great - we had 15 people but we could always hear him and he remembered everyone's names somehow! He was really informative. We did indeed have a shorter line at the Colosseum, and the entry for that is included with this tour. I wish we could have spent more time touring the Forum, but it was a 3 hour tour as is that covered so much interesting material, and you end the tour at the Forum so we could explore it a little ourselves.

This tour was absolutley great once we got the Colosseum part overwith. Seeing the Colosseum is just something you HAVE to do. That being said, you MUST buy a skip the line tour in advance to avoid being herded in line for hours. Our tour guide for the Colosseum was nice and informative but was often difficult to understand. We waited in line for 25 minutes after getting settled in which was far better than all the peasants who chose to take their chances in the regular line. The Colosseum itself was great but my girlfriend and I felt underwhlemed by the tour itself. We were given an hour on our own after a very brief "tour." We both felt that the hour was FAR too much time as we alogn with others in our group, decided to exit the coloseum well in advance. The 2nd part of the tour stole the show. Mostly because of our excellent tour guide, David. He has a way of explaining the history in an informative and hilarious way. The tour with him through ancient Rome was about 45 minuets or so but we loved every second of it. After the tour was over David gave us all tips on what to do and not to do for the rest of our trip in Rome. He even gave us restaurant recommendations and invited us to join his Pantheon tour for $20 which you HAVE to do. The second half of this tour saved the experience for us. Advice: Do this tour to skip the line at Colosseum and hope that Davis is your guide for the 2nd part.

Ella was our tour guide for this "must see" tour. She had outstanding command of the history, architecture and politics of the time. She provided outstanding, courteous and enthusiastic tour leadership throughout the nearly 3 hours of walking the Colosseum and Palatine Hill complex. It might be possible to semi-recreate this experience on your own, but I think you would have a much more fulfilling experience and strikingly more efficient use of your time by spending your vacation dollars with this professional company.
Some tips: 1. Recommend a morning tour 9 or 10-ish. It's cooler and you can spend more time on the Palatine Hill/Forum after the tour if you wish. 2. Easy METRO B Line egress to the meeting point: as you exit the turn stiles, take the passageway to the right, up to Largo Gaetana Agnesi. If you go straight out on the Piazza del Colosseo, you are out in the tourist horde and will have to walk to the left and up the path. 3. Take a bottle of water and a snack/protein bar. As always, take a water bottle and there is a fountain in the Forum to refill your bottle if desired.
As with all tours, read the details carefully. Most answers are there. Again, this is definitely a "must see".

Amil was absolutely fantastic! Great tour guide! Told us great areas to stop and take pictures. She was very informative and made every fact very interesting! Her excitement about the history really made the tour! She was funny, friendly and helpful! Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone! If you get Amil as a tour guide, you are very lucky!!! Would definitely do it again! Amazing experience and memories we will remember for our lifetime!!! 😊😊😊❤️❤️❤️

Such an amazing tour. We got inside the Colosseum pretty quickly and, once inside, our tour guide Valério explained with rich details the history of Ancient Rome and the place. For sure it was a differential to have an archeologist as a guide. The second part of the tour is also incredible, a travel in time. Highly recommended.

We went on this tour with just me, my husband, and 1.5 year old toddler strapped onto us. They are extremely well organized and it was not difficult to locate the tour group at all. Glad we did not have to take out our hidden passports to show ID and just checked in easily with our name.

Though it was strange to have rain at the end of May, our guide Hamid still made the 3 hours fun with great facts and learnings about the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Roman Forum. The pace was steady with plenty of time and good spots pointed out for photos. Super pleased with our skip the line and that we packed light to speed through security. Would highly recommend!!

Fabio was fabulous. It was a very wet day but we had an amazing trip around the Colosseum and Ancient Roman town and he made it fun in difficult circumstances. Really interesting and would definitely recommend.

What an awesome way to experience Ancient Rome and the magnificence of the Colosseum! Our guide Patrick is very passionate and extremely knowledgeable about Rome and all of its history. He was very receptive to all questions.Recommend this tour to anyone seeking to learn about Ancient Rome.

This was the first tour of our four-day trip to Rome. Luckily, our place of stay was 10 minutes walk to this place, and we reached there ahead of time. It wasn't difficult to locate the CityWonder co-ordinators in their blue shirts. We got connected to our guide for the day - Rosalba - and in the next few hours, she took us through the most amazing tour of Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum, talking through the distant era of the city of seven hills, the Flavian kings, emperor Nero, the gladiators, the pagans gods and their temples (whatever remains), the senate, advent of Christianity, the Vestal virgins, the new Basilica, so on and so forth. Even though we had done enough study and research on Roman history and the monuments, the way she stitched the facts (and debunked a lot of common myths) was quite entertaining. We were a fairly large group of people across the globe, somehow our guide managed to keep the flock together (well, most of the time :-). She gave us enough tips for our other planned and not-yet-planned tours of Rome. We spent some more time within Roman Forum after she left. Overall, it was a great start to our Rome trip.

We've just got back from the Colleseum and Ancient Rome walking tour with Sev from City Wonders as our guide. Sev was ridiculously good as a guide, his knowledge of history was incredible ms he made the entire tour thoroughly enjoyable, accomodating (with our 2 year old daughter), entertaining and memorable. Having just learnt he is a professor of Archiology in Rome which explains a lot makes us even more grateful he was our guide. We would thoroughly recommend Sev and City Wonders. The best tour we've ever been on, it's made our trip!

Can't say enough good things about this tour! We booked because we heard that it was very difficult to get in to the colosseum, but were so happy we did. ALESSANDRA was an amazing guide. Very knowlegeable and encouraging, kept the perfect pace, and a fun, as well. The tour was three hours and we stayed at Palantine Hill for at least another hour. Perfect trip!

Our tour guide Sara was a real life archeologist that had worked at the Colosseum excavating in the arena! What better tour guide can you have? She was very informative and fun, easily kept our attention all day and taught us a lot of new information about the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and Palentine hill! I would highly suggest this tour an recommend to anyone looking for a good Colosseum tour!

This tour is really good, I mean the Colosseum is chaos if you don't book ahead but being my second time there this time I decided to book a tour..and it was definitely the best decision ever, because you get to skip the line with the group and you get really knowledgeable guides telling all these interesting stories. Amed (apologies if not spelled correctly) was the type of guide I really like, funny but not trying too hard, super knowledgeable but also not talking super fast and lots, it seemed everything was at the right pace and the right amount of information. He also gave great tips for food and drinks and more importantly how to avoid being scammed! thanks a lot of being so dedicated to your job!
Skip the line was worth every cent. Our guide, Rosy, was very well informed and very passionate on the topic. Fantastic tour of Colosseum & Roman Forum.

Took this Tour in April 2019, and I couldn’t have made a better choice. Not only did we get to skip the insane lines (and all entry fees are included with this tour), our tour guide was spectacular. She was so knowledgeable and had such a friendly and upbeat energy. I learned so much about the sites that surprised and intrigued me. Our guide told us she is actually an anthropologist and does excavations in Rome on the side— based on her tremendous knowledge (which I googled later and everything was legit), I totally believe her. Best money I ever spent for an experience, hands down. Oh and finding the guides were SO easy, and they give you handheld listening devices so you can always hear the guide. Be warned though, there are a lot of stairs in this tour so make sure you can climb them. It’s totally worth it though when you get to the top. Enjoy!

Very enjoyable experience and worth the long lines to buy tickets. We didn’t buy ahead on line which I recommend people do! They do a nice job of managing the amount of people inside so it’s not packed and uncomfortable so this is why the wait to get in is longer. Wish they had more information available throughout the coliseum so people good really get a good understanding of what happened there. There are a few areas that have some artefacts and info but not extensive. All in all a must see attraction which takes your breath away at times!

My wife and I just came back from a group tour with Gigi. A fountain of knowledge, Gigi was informative, funny, engaging, and highly entertaining. He has a real knack for bringing history to life.

This was easily one of the best tours we have experienced. If you have even one iota of interest in Roman history, book this tour immediately!
The tour was really interesting and it took so much less time to get in. Yes it was more expensive than a plain ticket but the saving on the queue alone made it worth it

This was my first time booking anything like this. I organised this trip as part of a surprise weekend away for my husbands 40th birthday. We have never been to Rome so I booked this tour to make sure we saw one of the must see’s. We were not disappointed! Instructions on the confirmation were really clear. The meeting point was easy to find and our tour guide Sara was bloody brilliant! So knowledgeable and informative. We learnt so many interesting facts. Skipping the enormous que was a bonus too. The tour lasts 3 hours with plenty of stops for photos etc we will definitely be booking some more city wonders tours when we return.

The Colosseum, Forum and Palatine Hill are well worth visiting, but these tours bring them to life. Our tour guide was excellent, informative and humorous, bringing the history to life. Also skipping the queues is a must!

We were with Nicola & he was very knowledgeable and managed not to lose any of us in the tour! We started in the Colosseum & ended up on the Palatine Hill 3 hours later. Loads of facts & info about things you might have missed without a guide. There were 24 Brits & Americans in our group, all the headsets worked well so even if you weren’t close to the guide you could still clearly hear what he was saying. Great value although headed back to our hotel for a snooze after 3 hours of walking!

We recently did a tour of Ancient Rome as Colosseum with Emily and it was fantastic. She was very knowledgeable, and answered any questions we had with detail. The tour was perfect and I highly recommend!

We purchased this as a gift for my son and his girlfriend when they were visiting Rome, they commented that it was the best thing they did. Interesting and entertaining guide. Not rushed so gave them time to take everything in and take photos.
They would recommend to other to take this trip when visiting Rome.
Guide was very informative and great at navigating through the crowds. I wish we had more time at the Colosseum. We didn't have very much time for pictures.
We had a great tour guide who was very knowledgeable about the history. Our tour was perfect timing and we feel we got the most for our money.

We had Amber (or Ambra -sorry not sure which!) She was very knowledgeable, engaging and enthusiastic. Having a tour and a guide really brings it all to life and makes it a lot more interesting and enjoyable. Highly recommended.

Paid for skip the line and guide who took us into parts of the arena not open to other public such as the floor of the arena.and the tunnels beneath.Guide gave us interesting facts such as it was not only lions and tigers used but elephants and other exotic animals.
Very Knowledgable guide and very personable. Learned much from him through his presentation and answer to our questions.

To much to see in Rome....
To me the Colosseum was the best part of the Rome visit(s). It is like the magnet for me, I just want to back there for more!!! After Pompeii, this site for me is the close second best experience in Italy. I like architecture and history, and the Colosseum is right up there at the top. If you are not know the facts and history of the place, take any of the authorized tour guide, not just skip the lane, but get the story of this amazing place..... another must see experience in Italy!!!

Great informative tour with fun facts about the Colosseum and Ancient Rome. There was minimal waiting and everything seemed really well organised (from meeting point to rest of the tour)

Our guide was Barbara who was informative, fun and did actually make the experience better (it started to rain at the start of the tour of Roman Forum). She did actually set the standard high as the other guided tours we had in Rome were nowhere near as good as this tour.

Highly recommend the guide (Barbara) and the company.

This was an amazing part of our trip to Rome. Our tour guide “Barbara “ was extremely knowledgeable and very enthusiastic. She clearly explained the history of the colosseum, giving great detail and showing us past images throughout history.

Marco was our tour guide and was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic and passionate. The headsets to hear the guide had good range and could hear him very clear. I would definitely highly recommend this company. Great job Marco!
Great information on the tour, very busy. Go first thing in the morning and you wont be disappointed.
I booked a walking tour from tripadvisor. I got wonderful tour in Rome. The tour lady explained the history and architecture very detailed. I would highly recommend to go with this tour

The Skip the Line tours are the best way to go. Our family took these tours to visit the Vatican, the Colosseum, and the Accademy Galleria in Florence that houses the famous statue of David. You get in right away and spend the time enjoying the event you want to see. The half-day Colosseum tour was idea for my family. It provided us with a 3-hour structured tour that gave us a sense of the history of the place. We spent another 2 hours on our own exploring the Roman forum and the surrounding area. And, we got lucky with weather. A real treat.

this tour gave us skip-the-line entry which is really worth it, even in this low session the line was really long for the normal entry. What is more impressive is our guide, Damiano, who is an archaeologist and really really kownlegable, this tour is definitely the highlight of our trip in Rome.

This is a must-see when visiting Rome and this tour gave us skip-the-line privileges which saved a lot of time. The guides were very knowledgeable and engaging and we learned so much about the history and the incredible engineering. After the Colosseum, we toured the nearby ruins and despite enduring some serious rain, our guide kept us together and soldiered on. I highly recommend this tour!

This Tour was the highlight of our visit to Rome. Easy to find the meeting point above the metro station. Josie was very passionate and knowledgeable. Plenty of walking required and steps to climb. The Coleseum was out of this world and surpassed expectations. However some parts of the Forum were dissappointing.

Wonderful tour, our guide was so knowledgeable, she made sure we saw all the highlights and we learned so much. Plenty of time for photos. Much more interesting then doing the headset tour. Loved the walk through the palatine so much to see. Wear comfortable shoes, and though there is a lot of walking my 70 year old mother managed well, lifts are available in the colosseum. Only take a small bag as there are two security screenings. Meeting point is directly across from the Colosseum.

Paulo's English was excellent, he was clearly knowledgeable, and he was very considerate of two guests with mobility issues.
Note that this tour is fairly strenuous. If stairs, hills, and rough surfaces are a significant issue for you, you should probably pass this one up. My wife's FitBit indicated 2-3 miles of walking for the entire tour, which covers the Colosseum, Forum, and Palatine Hill.
"Skip the Line" does not mean you immediately enter the Colosseum at the start time of your tour. It means your group has a scheduled entry time about 10 minutes after the nominal start of your tour, after which you have to pass through airport-type security, which can take a while. We were off-season (Nov) and it took about 10 min.
The radios and headsets provided are great. You don't have to struggle to hear the guide or stand right on top of him all the time.
This tour packs a lot into 3 hr; there isn't a lot of time to explore something that takes your interest. The venues are amazing. You are literally walking in the footsteps of ancient Romans in some places.

This is a little delayed but wanted to rate our Colosseum tour on October 4, 2018. Our tour was scheduled for 10am and our tour guide was so delightful and extremely knowledgeable. Her name was Tetsiana which may not be spelled correctly but she made our visit to the Colosseum so much more interesting. Her incredible knowledge was amazing and her delivery of the information was outstanding! It was like listening to a wonderful storyteller and thoroughly enjoyed our time with her. Thank You Tetsiana and keep up the good work. You are a true professional and a wonderful tour guide!

Our guide was great lady from S.America. She knows a lot of interesting facts about Colosseum itself and Italian history in general. Even our 11 years old daughter enjoy half day tour. Highly recommend

It rained the whole day. We were in a group of 24 which was larger than I expected but despite the crowds we did not have to queue and Achmed (a Libyan national with post graduate studies in Roman history) was a brilliant and engaging guide. Even our kids (12 and 10) who had lost the will to live during the Vatican tour the previous day had to admit that they enjoyed the half day tour.
Really enjoyed our tour with City of Wonders of the Colosseum, Palantine Hills and the Roman Forum. Our tour guide was knowledgeable, personable and thorough.

We had a fantastic guide to help us through a crazy busy and wet morning! We were so relieved to pass up the throng of people who waited to get into the coliseum. Our guide Alexendaro was very knowledgeable, even an archeologist! Who better to walk us through the tour than someone who has actually worked to dig up the ruins!
The tour through the forum was even better. We stopped when appropriate and skipped to other spots, passing up unneeded wiring to see something that was somewhere else without a crowd. People were listening in to try and learn what he was saying sometimes, it was that good!

The ONLY thing I could think to offer as positive criticism would be to bring your own ear buds, as theirs are chincy and barely fit, falling out more than staying in.

Pre-books this through our hotel concierge. They used Gray Line I Love Rome tours. This was a half-day tour and our guide Marcello V made it memorable. We were a fairly large group, but in these large open areas it worked well with the remote microphone and headsets. Marcello made ancient Roman history come alive!

Helena was our guide, she was very knowledgeable and upbeat, as well as thoughtful to accommodate the different types of people on the tour. Luckily we had excellent weather, which was a bonus due to the tour being outside. The morning tour provides a great summary and fits a lot of pieces of history together, without getting boring. Helena was open to questions, but also supplemented the tour with photographs and amusing stories, which even the non historical folk amongst us could appreciate. Lifts are available at the colosseum, but as it’s busy, be prepared to queue. Also be aware that the toilets get really busy. Without this tour there is no way our trip would have been so worthwhile, as no amount of pre-reading will ever encompass the amount of information and detail that she could. This trip is definitely worth the money and I would thoroughly recommend to anyone.

I had a horrible experience of the City Wonders Tour I booked for my wife and I at the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Infact, we had to pay twice for another tour company to eventually get on this tour. With City Wonders, we arrived for a 10:00am tour, at 09:45am. There was a huge line to register with the tour guides (which was embarrassing as it was a ’skip the lines’ tour!). We finally got into a tour group and went down to the Colosseum gate with the guide - this was at 10:20am (for a tour that was supposed to start at 10:00am). The entire group were disallowed entry, and the Guide explained it was because he had been given a ticket for a different gate. He rang the tour organisers at the meeting point, and asked that they bring the correct ticket/pass. In the meanwhile he gave us some more information on the Colosseum, which was interesting. No-one from the meeting point came and after 10-15mins, we all walked back to the meeting point with the guide. Here, none of the organisers came down to explain or resolve the issue for a further 10mins. They then said that the tour would need to be cancelled and we could either get a full refund or continue with the second and third parts of the tour with a partial refund. A third option was that we would need to contact City Wonders directly and book for a tour the next day, as there was no further availability today.

I felt this was extremely poor customer service. We had rushed to attend this morning tour, and now had at least a 3hour hole in our itinerary. We had not got to do what we wanted to do. The inconvenience should really have been resolved by a full refund, and a rebooking which the the organising team should have handled on our behalf. We were left to sort the mess out.

Met our guide with no problems but sadly there were issues with being able to hear him through the headset. This actually took up quite a bit of time for this to be resolved but after the third attempt of his microphone the tour continued with no problems. the Colosseum was amazing and our guide gave us all the interesting facts of its history.
We went on to Palatine Hill in time for the setting sun and the views were well worth it.
Unfortunately we appeared to have run out of time as we only saw the Forum from above and did not have time after the tour to explore it as security were asking people to leave.
Massively disappointing as it was our last night there.

How can you not be impressed by the Colosseum with 2,000 years of history? The guide (an archeologist by trade) - Barbara, was extremely knowledgeable and made the three hour tour interesting and fun.

There was minimal waiting so the “skip the line” element worked well and the Forum and Palatine Hill were both really interesting and impressive.

We absolutely loved the tour. Not only we got to see the main landmarks, we got to learn a LOT about it. Our guide was incredibly informative, friendly, and charming.
I would recommend the tour to anyone who's in Rome!

My husband and I booked the 8:30am English speaking tour. We were a small group and the tour started on time. Our guide was very knowledgable and made our tour very interesting. The tour was not rushed and there was plenty of time to take lots of photos.
After the tour, our guide took the time to suggest other popular areas in the local area for us to visit. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Our tour guide was excellent. She was so informative and organized. We were fortunate to have her as a guide. She is an archaeologist who worked in the Colosseum and was supplementing her income as a tour guide. Even though there were a lot of people, lines moved fairly quickly. It was an amazing trip back to this ancient time period. I wish I could give more stars. Incredible! Highly recommend this tour, just come prepared to walk and with a refillable water container..

Our guide Claudia was very educated, engaged and kind throughout our tour. Just the right mix of background and stops to view. My family of three enjoyed this tour immensely, especially as we were guided through the Colosseum. A guide on another City Wonders tour filled the group in on the quality the company requires of their guides, and it shows. Would gladly tour with them again.
Our tour guide was entertaining, knowledgeable and could answer any questions. We enjoyed our tour very much!
Our guide, Susannah, was phenomenal and greatly enhanced the experience for both myself and my daughter!

This was our very first walking tour of our europe trip. The pace is nice, it is a fantastic way to meet people from other countries. Skip the line helps as you are fast tracked through the access gates as well as the security checks. Our guide were passionate about her city of Rome which were so evident and which made you pay close attention to what she said. City Wonders are organised and their guides great. It was just a little difficult to find them on day one when you don't know what when where, maybe better signage?

Great to skip big lines and get into the Coloseum quickly. Our tour guide, Maria, was friendly, well informed and took us through the Coloseum, the Forum and other nearby sites. Well worthwhile, lots of fun facts and information we would never have known otherwise. And City Wonders was great, very organized and helpful.

Great tour, thanks to our fabulous guide, Nicholas. A man with knowledge and an ability to impart it with passion and genuine interest. The Colosseum is a must, of course, and he did a great job of bringing it all to life. Don't go and see it, or any of the sites, without someone guiding you who knows it so well - and of course, who wants to queue for ages when you can skip the lines? The Forum, Palatine Hill, Constantine Arch, everything was brought to life, with information about what we saw, and what else we should see. Great! Thanks Nicholas.

Markedly excellent cultural and historical tour 0f ancient Rome. This is a highly recommended tour for those who love ancient and imperial Rome. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and communicates to us clearly and considers the pace for those who are slightly challenged with fast walking on the cobblestones.
Amelia was incredible!! She even made the wait to enter the Colosseum informative. Once we entered the Colosseum, she kept us riveted to the history and legends of Ancient Rome.

This tour was a great way to see the highlights of the colosseum and the forum! The skip the line is worth the extra money! We didn't travel all the way to Italy to wait in line all day and then not know what we were really looking at once we got inside. Our guide was great and so knowledgeable. We loved hearing all the gladiator stories and our guide really took us through the story of how everything came to be.
We had really crazy rain about 30 minutes after the tour started. We ended up losing 3/4 of the group due to the weathere.For us, we threw panchos on and the guide kept on going with us. We ended up having an almost private tour of the Forum and our guide Biliana was a trooper and was super professional despite the rainy circumstances we were in. Would defintely reccommend this tour for anyone who wants to learn a lot of amazing history and doens't want to wait in line! It was a perfect first day of Rome!
The colosseum was spectacular and Sophia shared interesting information. Make sure you have a hat and water if going in hot weather.
Loved this tour, our guide I forget his name but was originally a history teacher, he was so kind, knew where all the water fountains were, we were having a good time. Loved this tour.

Met up with the very knowledgable Marco outside the Colosseum where he walked us through the ancient amphitheatre and then onto the ruins of the Roman Forum etc. Bring lots of water on a hot day you have very little protection from the sun! The views were amazing and Marco made it very fun, interesting, and educational from a very passionate and educated perspective. Would highly recommend Marco and this tour.

You have to spend time at the Colosseum and Ancient Rome if you go to Rome. We did this tour on a very hot day in July and our kids (13, 11, 9) were melting from the heat and lost interest about half way through - mainly from the heat exhaustion. Just set your expectations if doing this with kids. It is long and (if summer) hot with very little shade.

If you like to know the history, this tour is for you. If you like to take photo, this tour is not for you. The tour guide was knowledgeable. Gave you all the history... non-stop. Simply like a lecture! We were only given 4 mins maximum to take photo in the Colosseum. And then leave and no re-entry. I asked for the option to stay behind in the Colosseum. But I was told I would loose my ticket to enter the Palatine Hill, which I had already paid for! If putting the photo op aside, this tour gave us exclusive access to the ground level platform and the underground access. The ground level platform access was good. The underground access was not too much special. As person who likes to take photo, this tour didn't worth the cost in my view. I would not join the tour if I can choose again

Ok first of all, wow is it hot (in august) bring water with you or at least a bottle as there are places to fill up along the route! We were greeted by a lovely old Italian gent who took the tour, his grasp on the English language wasn't the best but his knowledge of ancient rome was second to none! I would defiantly recommend for an immersive roman experience, it will give you an insight into the history if roman that walking around on your own just doesn't offer!

We thoroughly enjoyed our tour. Our guide, Alice, was knowledgeable and friendly, providing us with just the right amount of information and setting a relaxed pace. We would absolutely recommend this tour.

This was a great tour, with a fab guide - it was baking hot and skipping the huge line was well worth the extra cost. Our guide was very clear, clearly passionate about her city, which we appreciated. The tour was as long as it should be but felt like a whirl wind, lots to fit in and I feel we had a bit missed off, 'going into the bits below the colosseum, which is what attracted us to the tour (not realising how good skipping the line would feel). We were very happy to be in such a small group, the others with the same company seemed bigger - it meant we had a much more involved experience.
Its not 5/5 just because I think we ran out of time...

A great tour of the Colosseum and Ancient Rome. Our tour guide Jaber, was amazing. His knowledge about the Colosseum and its history is unsurpassed!! Try to ask for him to guide you through this amazing piece of history.

Just the fact that you could skip the lines made this tour worth it. Coupled with the fact that Flavia, our guide, was full of interesting knowledge it made for a nice experience. It's hot, it's long, but it's a great way to see an overview of the entire area with someone who can give you a little more information than what you would get without a guide.

Met our guide at the metro station which was stated upon the booking, the company operating the tour were on hand to introduce us to the guide and provide us with headsets for us to hear our guide amongst the busy sites. Using the skip the line pass we did jump to the front of the queue but had to wait around 10 minutes understandably for the security checks. We spent approx. 1.5 hours in the Colosseum, (or as we now know is actually called the Flavian Amphitheatre) our tour guide Jaber was clearly very passionate about the city and its History, not just the sites but also Rome, this shone through the whole tour. He had a good sense of humour and gave detailed answers to any details we had. It was a hot 35degree day, and because of such he adapted the tour to not have us burning in the blazing sun (something I was genuinely worried about being very pale!!) We got amazing photos, information and had such a great day! The roman forum was very interesting but is more of an add on, we didn't spend extra time there after tour. If you are interested in visiting, do it, you wont regret it! Amazing day.

We had a really nice time visiting the coliseum and Roman forum with Norman. He was really cool and taught us so much. Such a smart guy and really interesting to listen to. I would highly recommend this tour.

The Trip Advisor tours are very well organized and the communication before hand is excellent. Our guide stopped often to point out different features and tell stories about the ruins that helped to contextualize what we were seeing. It was a very hot day and this tour covered the Colosseum, the Forum and Palentine Hill so she allowed for a needed break half way through. Wear good walking shoes and bring a large water bottle!

The benefit of starting early (8:30) was hearing the colosseum was full at 10am and we could still see people queuing for ages around the front of it.

We had Guilia and she was great and informative. Three hours is not nearly enough - but then again, another three days probably wouldn’t be enough either. Well worth doing.
I'm from Italy but I went with my friends here and our guide was great. He taught us about history of Colosseum and whole evening was great.
You are well advised to pre pay for YOur tickets to bypass the huge queues to get into these places. Well worth it. Don’t miss out on going amazing !!

There are tour companies all around the place. It is hard to find the regular ticket center. Although the tours are nice I find the ability to not get a ticket without getting harassed annoying. Our guides were great. I got a good history. Just didn’t like the approach.

My husband and I just returned from Italy and had a fantastic time. Skipping the lines was key and the insights and history we got from Fabrizio, a trained archaeologist, made the experience so much more valuable. Thank you Fabrizio!

We had a wonderful half day tour today of the Colosseum, Forum & Pantheon. Our guide was very knowledgeable and shared interesting facts about each site. I’m glad we only did the half day tour because it was hot and nice to end at lunch time. We casually explore the sites around The a Pantheon ourselves. I would recommend this tour for those with teenagers and families capable of lots of walking a lot in the sun. Make sure to bring a large bottle of water with you!

This was possibly the worst group tour I have ever taken. The tour guide spoke with a very thick accent and was extremely difficult to understand. She did not organize the group well and did not keep track of everyone in the group. She often walked quickly ahead and did not indicate where she was going. When she was too far out of range you couldn't hear her, so it didn't matter that we had headsets. She also never asked the group if we had questions.
