While she spoke non stop for 3 hours, I learned almost nothing. The next day when I did a 2nd citywonders tour, the tour guide said - oh you did the Colosseum yesterday, so you must know about Constantine. I had to say, no our guide never mentioned him. She did not contextualize Rome or it's history. It was so sad, we thought about leaving the tour, but decided since we paid for it, we would stick it out. It was horrible. Waste of time and money. Would be better off just buying an audio tour. At least then I might have understood something, and learned about the history of Rome. Plus I would have saved money and not have been stressed about constantly losing my group.

We did this tour today with Cecilia and she was brilliant. She had so much knowledge to share and was open to questions from our group of 17 tourists.
During the tour she made sure we could stand in the shade if we wanted, allowed for time to refill our water bottles at the fountains and gave us small pockets of free time to take photos, explore and use the restroom. Nothing was a problem for her.
Thank you Cecilia you made our tour at the colosseum very enjoyable, even with our 1 year old baby in the backpack!

We had an excellent morning on this walking tour, and it was just long enough. Giulia was an engaging, humorous and entertaining host, who kept us entertained and informed throughout the tour and even in queues. The tour takes in a lot so be prepared!

The advantage of this tour was quick access into the Colloseum. However we found our tour guide lacklustre (although she was very nice!). The information shared was scattered, provided minimal context and was uninteresting. Reading the plaques around was more useful. I also found her very hard to hear on the earphones (I have good hearing) but my husband found it fine. After the first 90 minutes when we moved onto the Roman Forum more than half of our group left the tour so I do not think it was just us. We wondered if we would have been better going without a guide and getting the audioguide. It can't have been less interesting. Very disappointed as it's hard to make a place where so much has happened be so blah.

Our guide was very knowledgeable in Roman history and live in Rome. I've been to Rome 4 times with this visit, May 18, 2018. It was a walking tour which I really like and a long one, but we made a lot of stops for lunch, gelato, and some shopping.

If you never been to Roma Colosseum a must see. I recommend tour that takes you inside and underground colosseum which I took in the past visits not this time around. Unfortunately, Roma is very crowded and dirty but I never had picked pocked experience. Lucky I suppose!! (Note: 2nd Port of Call, MSC Fantasia)

Biggest waste of money, paid for skip the line was told we would walk right up and the wait time was 2 hours. When we went to talk to someone about it they offered us another ticket for more euro. We bought this and still waited over an hour. Not happy found it was such a waste of money!

We had our tour with Matteo Ippolti, he was brilliant! So knowledgeable, helpful and friendly. He wasn’t just reading from a script, he really knew what he was talking about and was able to answer everyone’s questions. He added an element of comedy but was still factual. The tour was incredible. We weren’t going to bother with a tour but we’re so glad that we did. It’s very reasonably price as well given that it includes all the entry fees and skip the line passes. Incredible, would absolutely recommend and Matteo was fantastic!!

First off, this isn't a bad review of our tour guide. Valentina was very knowledgeable. The experience as a whole, however, as organized and carried out by City Wonders was extremely disappointing. I have been studying ancient Roman, especially Republican, history for the better part of my adult life, so I was looking forward to seeing the Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum more than anything in Rome. We booked the package deal with the Colosseum, which we also wanted to see, but it wasn't our main wish-list item. The guided tour was an added benefit. We really just wanted to access and see the sites.

The tour of the Colosseum was nice. We enjoyed our visit. Then, we walked to the entrance of the Roman Forum, where we proceeded to wait for about an hour in full sun. By the end, our twenty-some-odd person group, including a family with a small child in a stroller, was cut down to around six; the ones that left were the smart ones. Apparently, the ticket reservation number for our group had been duplicated for another group -- however that manages to happen -- so we couldn't get into the place after paying for our entrance fees well in advance. Our guide attempted everything she could to get us in, from arguing with the staff on site to trying to get in touch with the home office in Dublin. To no avail, with sunburn was our only memory of the forum. Granted, I'm not sure exactly how these reservations work, but it seems to me that there would be some mechanism in place for getting replacement tickets when the correct set has already been used somehow. We specifically reserved our entrance before the trip so that we wouldn't have to wait in massive lines. In this case, it turns out that you don't need the lines to wait, only in the end we didn't even get what we had already paid for; it would have been better to wait in the line.

I have never written a bad review on a site like this. I probably still wouldn't have done so if City Wonders had done the right thing. A full refund would have set us at ease that this was not something that commonly happens for them, and we would have chalked up our experience as a fluke. Even a 50% refund would have been enough for me not to give a review. They offered 20%, which may not even have covered the cost of our theoretical entrance into the Forum. The mistake was in no way our fault. They screwed up, inconvenienced all of us in the group, and, personally, deprived me of seeing the thing I most wanted to see in Rome. We will never us this company again.

We booked this City Wonders Tour a few days before we came to Rome. OMG we are so glad we did! The queues are horrendous it really is worth paying to skip the line.

Our guide was Elisabetta, a native of Rome and an archaelogist! She was passionate, enthusiastic, knowledgable and so friendly! She gave just the right amount of informed detail and we learned so much! She always tried to find a shady spot with a cool breeze for our comfort and asked if anyone had any questions before moving on. A really great guide😊

The Colosseum was simply awesome, it’s majesty will take your breath away. Words are simply not enough, you have to visit it!

I highly recommend this tour company, we had a great experience.

Our guide, Sabrina, was great: very knowledgeable, personable, and funny. I was very skeptical of a large group tour (20+) with headsets. However, I was very pleasantly surprised. I could clearly hear Sabrina. All questions were answered by her and I really did not notice the size of the group because of the clarity of the headsets. We had a wonderful tour and without her pointing out what was important, history, and such, the day would have been a bust. I would do other tours with this group for sure.
We had Thomas Robinson as our guide. Not only as he extremely informative and well versed, he was absolutley entertaining. Best tour ever! Highly recommend.
Directions and communication was great. Our guide was an architect so she was really good! My husband and I enjoyed had a great time.

I didnt actually do the tour, owing to a physicsl limitation with my legs, but walked and drove past several times. There is so much to see, and the tour guides have an immense knowledge of the nistory of the place (i enjoyed tagging along with some......)

This is a 3 hour tour of the colosseum and Roman forum. We didn’t spend too much time in any one place as there is a lot to see. Our guide (Claudia) had a PhD in Archeology and did her studies in Rome. She was fantastic, personable and very knowledgeable. A great way to get a sense of the living history of Rome.

If you go to Rome and haven pre-booked a tour, you're mad! The queues to get in are o loooooong so I would really recommend this City Wonders tour.
You won't avoid the crowds altogether but you will get in much quicker. What takes the longest is the scanning process as there are many tours booked in at the one time.
Our guide, Eleanora, was brilliant! She gave us heaps of info but didn't bog us down with boring detail. She contextualized everything. We were able to ask questions as well. This is the only way to do it!

Paula was a great tour guide, she was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the topic and was very fun through the whole tour. You’re in a relatively big group (15-20), but the headsets mean you can always hear the guide. You see a lot on three hours and being able to skip the long lines is worth it enough. Definitely recommend this tour!

We booked this online through Trip Advisor and were so pleased we did. We booked an early tour at 9 am and by 10 am the staff at the Colosseum announced the venue was at capacity so those waiting in line would have to wait until others left...so pleased we skipped the line! The audio commentary and guide by radio link was great and very informative. The trip included the Roman Forum and Pallatine Hill which we’re also worth the effort of seeing. Overall highly recommended!

This tour although booked through TripAdvisor was actually with City Wonders Ltd +39 06 8336 0561. This is a three hours tour and not for the faint hearted with many steps to climb. There were about 30 of us in the party and all had individual audio units which were linked, excellent reception, to our english speaking Guide Jessica of “come my peoples” fame. We would recommend asking for Jessica as your tour guide should the opportunity present itself. We were guided through the various levels of security at each site quickly and efficiently being updated on what to expect at each stage. The level of detail and knowledge of the guide about the history of all three locations was excellent and delivered in a thorough but light-hearted way. There were many opportunities to take photos.

Just been on this tour this morning and we had a thoroughly enjoyable experience. I was a bit apprehensive before hand (worried in case I was wasting my money) but when the tour started my mind was quickly put at ease. Our tour guide, an Italian lady, escorted us with the upmost professionalism. The tour was full of information and we had lots of chances to ask questions. We saw the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum all of which were amazing! Would highly recommend this City Wonders tour. Its really worth every penny. A great day had by all!

(This is a bit late: the tour was 25 March).

My wife and I had just a few days in Rome and we wanted to cover a lot of sights so we booked 'Skip the line' walking tours wherever we could. This was the first and it was fabulous.

Our guide for this tour was Gigi, an archeologist by profession. Gigi is very well-informed, his English is pretty good, he was happy to take questions and he has a very good sense of humour to boot.

The tour was a leisurely walk of about three hours: Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill.

We highly recommend this tour. At the very least, buy a 'skip the line' ticket: the crowds were horrendous and this was just the start of Spring!

City Wonders was wonderful to deal with booking our Colosseum and Forum tour. It was a lot of walking but our guide was very knowledgable. With purchase of the tour you basically skip the line at the Colosseum. You also get to walk on the Gladiator floor which was really cool. Seeing the Forum and get the history lesson was well worth the trip. I highly recommend using City Wonders.
The tour is worthed due to the knowledge of our guide Cristina, who holds a PhD in archeology, and provided the most fascinating tour

We had a wonderful tour from PG. Even thought the line took us an hour to get in with the crowds, PG entertained us with the history of Roman and the empire. He even extended the tour by 30 minutes because of the delay. The tour was everything I could have expected.

A great morning. Cecilia (Sp?) was informative, helpful and keen to answer every question. We were in a group of 21 although that seemed to halve by the end of the morning on Palatane Hill.

Not unsurprisingly there were large crowds even at this time of year and although initially skeptical, the earpiece and radios made hearing and shepherding us around much easier. Really did enjoy the morning. We complemented it with an afternoon stroll on our own up to the Pantheon and Spanish steps which was a lovely, lazy, contrast.

Be prepared to walk as Roman cobbles aren't smooth!

The line of skip the line is actually a bigger line than the line without tickets.
Very crowded.
I don't recomend taking online tickets.
It is a waste of money.

This guided tour was one of the highlights of my holiday to Rome. The tour guide was a local and had a wealth of knowledge. It was excellently organised. We were there during Holy Week and the crowds were larger than usual,so the skip the line ticket I had booked in advance was necessary. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Wow. I assume that every single person coming to Rome comes to the Colosseum. I specifically got a skip the line and small tour. Well worth the money. Had a very nice tour guide - very good and understandable English. Rome local as well, at least by her stories.

Toured the colosseum all the way from the bottom to the very top. Very interesting and historical tour; fascinating to just imagine the history you're walking past. All the thousands upon thousands of spectators witnessing the games so long past.

Afterwards, walked through the Roman Forum which was fantastic. Lots of walking, but that's what you signed up for, right? Stood in the spot where Julius Caesar's body was burned after his assassination. Incredible. Saw arches. So many arches! Just so much history that it's hard to take in all at once.

All in all, an awesome trip.

This is a comprehensive and informative tour that brings Ancient Rome to life! Our tour guide Frederica, has an art history degree from a major university in Rome. That background provides unique understanding of life, politics, and architecture of the ancient Roman civilization. This is not a tour of memorized facts and trivia. Frederica clearly loves Rome and is proud to share her knowledge and insights. She provides a balanced view of the positive and negative aspects of the Roman Empire. 3.5 hours seems like a long tour but it went by quickly and we were sad to see it end. This was the highlight of our week in Rome

After 3 hours, you come out of this tour a smarter person. As a first timer in Rome, I learned so much about ancient Rome. It was amazing to see and hear, our guide was excellent though I don’t remember her name. Skip the line alone makes this tour worth it. Taking this tour, rather than going about it on your own, is highly recommended.
This is a good tour and worth the money as you learn so much about the colosseum and Ancient Rome. Take a drink and snack with you as there isn’t anywhere to buy this on tour.

The weather held off after threatening rain and this was a relief as I really can’t imagine getting the same enjoyment in the rain. Our guide was a lovely, charming, very knowledgeable Italian called Ursus. He was clearly very passionate about his city and was a fantastic storyteller who brought Ancient Rome to life for us. I can’t recommend him and City Wonders enough. You get so much more from a visit by understanding what you are seeing from people who know so much and have a gift for sharing their knowledge and passion. My feet were sore after three hours but it was well worth it.

We took this tour in the pouring rain on Saturday 3rd March The rain did not matter as Irena our tour guide was brilliant. She was so knowledgeable and made the whole tour well worth doing also great to skip the queues too. Great way to start my husbands 60th birthday !

The tour guide was really knowledgeable about ancient Rome and the tour was really good and informative!

The headphones and radio was a nice touch so we could heat everything without effort, and even being away from the group while the guide was speaking.

100% recommended!

Though our guide did give us insightful anecdotes about the history of the Colosseum this is a very vanilla tour. Not to say this tour was bad in anyway just lackluster for the grandiose that is the colosseum. This however is coming from the perspective of someone who is used to private tours, who is a lover of history, and who wants a further explantation beyond what the normal tourist would expect. I really appreciate what was done but in a nutshell you are mainly paying for the skip the line. This cuts out what could be hours of waiting and makes this tour well worth it.

Just make sure you go to the website for your official ticket! I used the confirmation email which did not work. But the staff was awesome and allowed me to get my tickets. Overall the Colosseum is a must see in Rome!
This was a great excursion. Our guide Assunta (sorry about spelling ??) was excellent and gave so much information in an easy and relaxed way. This was one of the high spots of our trip to Rome

The amount of knowledge the guides bring with them is incredible. What really seals the deal is not standing in line!

We were able to hear the guide on the radio handsets and it was very informative and interesting. This tour has lots of walking and there are big crowds to navigate through.

This was our first visit to the colosseum and we really enjoyed the tour! My husband and I are not history buffs and our tour guide, Livia, did a wonderful job telling the story of Rome! She was very knowledgeable and always willing to answer questions. She really engaged our imaginations and when it was too far of a stretch to see what it once was, she had many pictures and drawings of what it may have looked like. You really get everything that the description of the tour says.

The colloseum was incredible and the tour guide's knowledge of the history of the colloseum enhanced the experience. However, we felt we needed more time than the half-day to do both the colloseum and the surrounding attractions and if going again would do these on seperate days. Facts between the tour guides were conflicting at times but they were friendly and the general knowledge of the sites was impressive.
tons of old history . what a experience . a great place to see . parking was a little tough . bring your walking shoes
This was a great tour! Christina was our guide and she was incredibly knowledgeable. A very nice way to see the Colosseum, Forum and Palatine Hill in a half day. Lots of walking, but very well paced.

We paid for the upgrade to see the underground and third tier. We had an archeologist, Kiara, as our tour guide. She answered all of our questions and gave some tips on best books to get to learn more. We'd pay twice as much for this. Our guide for the forum and Palatine Hill was great too. She had so much knowledge and answered all of our questions.

Fernando was an outstanding guide on are tour. His English and knowledge of the area was also outstanding. He also had great tips for us on restaurants and other sites to see. You will not be disappointed using Fernando. Thanks Rich & Tamara
Nicolò was a wonderful guide who took time to make sure we all got our questions answered and rests.

Good tour and nicely paced. Our guide was enthusiastic and good humourred. Probably would have got most of the information from a guide book or two but the tour had some nice personal touches and favourites included. Note - the tour does not include the Palatine hill or forum. You get brought in through security and then left to explore these on your own. This suited us better as a family..

Lucia was our guide for the tour. I can not say enough good things about her. She was so knowledgeable about everything in the tour. She answered all our questions.. I swear she could be a University professor!! Well worth the money!!!
Sylvia, our tour guide, was fantastic. She had a genuine passion for sharing history, which made the tour more engaging.

Our tour guide Simon was not only informative but witty and warm. We were taken through these lovely locales with efficency and care in equal measure. Would definalty attend again based on this experience.
Amazing tour, Simon was great, very informative and friendly, really enjoyed it and found it very interesting.
Simone was a great guide. Very informative, also cracking great jokes, he also greatly handled and aggressive visitor
Guide was knowledgeable and provided realistic information on restoration vs actual surviving structure. Good description on daily entertainment at the colosseum.

Simon was super informative.
Plenty of photo breaks.
Good humor to keep it interesting
Bring comfortable shoes......
The colosseum was amazing, Nicola knew every question we asked and gave us more knowledge than we expected. Very thorough!!
Great tour and very informative.. in total the tour lasted about 3 hours with loads of time to stop and take photos threw out

Our tour guide was Phillipo. He was amazing!!!
He provided a lot of information but made it very interesting for us. I would recommend this tour snd Phillipo 100%
Review: Nick was an amazing guide, he led us in places that are without words and the view of the arena made me atonished. Thank you . Citywonders was well organized
Great guide who was lovely and very knowledgeable. Colosseum part was amazing . Second part around the hill was a bit too long for me and could of happily had that condensed by at least 30 minutes.

Always wanted to see the colosseum. Travelled with a group with Trafalgar. Amazing history and construction. Such a barbaric place. Best to travel with a group so no standing in line. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable which made this tour extremely interesting. A must see in Rome
We had a great time on this tour! Our guide, PG, was very knowledgeable. Would recommend this experience!
Simone was a fantastic tour guide, can’t recommend him enough!! We learned so much and really enjoyed this tour, the colosseum was amazing and Simone was incredibly knowledgeable.

Strengths: Our guide (Maria?) was very knowledgeable and really gave us a great rundown of all elements of the Colosseum and the Forum.

Weaknesses: I had to mention that Palatine Hill was on the promised itinerary; our guide initially said that we would not go to the top of the hill. Likewise, the view of the Forum that we got from the tour was from a poor angle and not especially view-friendly. (The view from Palatine Hill was much better, of course, so it's doubly good that our guide took the reminder!). If you take this tour, be prepared to ensure you get to see everything the description promises.

Vasco is the best tour guide!!! Very professional, lots of humor, patient. He gave us a tour I will never forget
The best tour we had in Rome!!! Thanks Vasco!!!

Elizabeth was a delightful tour guide and full of a wealth of knowledge about this piece of ancient history and the immediate surroundings. I was so engrossed I would have welcomed more information about the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill rather than the brief introduction.
Loved the energy that Sylvia brought to our tour. She is an archeologist who brought her knowledge to our group and made the Colesseum come alive for us.
Nick was very helpful and gave a lot of insights. Very friendly as well and went the extra mile with all the questions we had.

Denis gave us a really spectacular tour of one of the most incredible historical sites in the world! He knew a lot of trivia and history and shared it like an epic story. We were shown all the notable structures and locations and given time to take photos!

Fabio was an amazing guide who was very personable and amazingly remembered everyone’s name.
He was very informative.

Pros:
- Access to quieter areas as you're on a group tour, plus you get to join the shorter queue
- Enthusiastic, knowledgeable guide (Eddy)
- Stunning place with a very interesting history

Cons:
- Some steepish steps and uneven ground, and a lot of time in the sun (although there is a lift option and the guide takes their time/waits for everyone)
- Our guide had very good English but with a strong Italian accent, which made it difficult to follow along at times

Tips:
- Take plastic water bottles, no glass ones are allowed through security. You can refill your water bottles at various points with fresh, drinkable, and fancy water fountains dotted around.
- We stuffed everything into small bags as we read backpacks aren't allowed. However, some people in our group had normal sized backpacks and got through absolutely fine.
- Aerosol cans of any kind won't get through security.

Skip line was good experience. I recommend to book skip the line tickets only without guide. Which could save some amount.

Highly recommend this tour! Our guide was so knowledgeable and amazing! Her mother was a Greek geologist and she herself was a history major in college so she knew EVERYTHING about Roman history and the colosseum. A great tour and one we will treasure!

Valerio was an amazing tour guide! He was very informative and answered many of our questions throughout the tour. You can definitely see that he is very passionate about his work, and he is able to transmit his passion to the tour group. Highly recommended.
This was so good. It lasted 3h - and it wasn’t boring for a second. Loved all the fun facts. Highly recommend!
This tour was absolutely amazing. Both of our guides were very knowledgeable and interesting to listen to. Learned a lot? Definitely recommend this tour.

The tour was excellent not many people. We saw everything on the guide was very informative. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to see the entire Colosseum the forum how do you say the Palatine hill With all the rich history and explanation. We did not have to wait in any line!

Be sure and meet your guide/group up on top of the hill by street in front of Colosseum at time posted on your ticket. Ask any tour guide up there and they will direct you to the correct person. We were there in November so lines were not anything like what you would find in summer months. Very satisfied how this all worked out.
Very knowledgeable guide who was an art historian kept the tour interesting and entertaining enough for my 11 year olds walking for 3 hours.

My daughter and I joined a tour with Fabiana. There were much more people in the group than I would have liked, but Fabiana’s explanation made the tour very enjoyable. She was very knowledgeable and we learned many facts vs. myths.

The tour guide, Giuseppe, was incredibly knowledgeable, helpful and engaging. The time spent in the Colosseum was managed really well, he knew how to get us the best views with the smallest crowds. There are a lot of stairs and ramps on this tour and he made sure everyone was able to keep up. The views from the Palatine Hill are amazing. He also gave us several ideas for what to go see after the tour within the Roman Forum. Take the time to go see the views overlooking Circus Maximus from the West side of Palatine Hill.
He is an historian’s historian as well. He just didn’t tell the story, he also told you what historians know versus what they think and what they are trying to piece together, so you know fact from conjecture. Very enjoyable half day activity.

Our tour of the Colosseum, the Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill with our tour guide Giuseppe was wonderful! He worked hard to bring to life the life and times of Ancient Rome. He did a great job and we all had a wonderful time! We highly recommend this guided tour.
There’s so much to see in Rome but this was definitely a highlight. The guides, including the archeologists at the Colosseum, did a great job. Bring your walking shoes!
Sara was an amazing tour guide! Great energy level for 3 hours straight and very knowledgeable. Thoroughly enjoyed our tour thanks to her!

Skipping the line was huge, the lines to the colosseum was insanely long when we were there, and we just walked up to an empty entrance and went straight in. The roman forum also had a decent line, and we skipped that one as well. The guide (I believe his name was PJ? It was definitely 2 letters..) was extremely knowledgeable (seriously, ask him anything about ancient Rome!). Being in the colosseum was unreal, it was so cool to learn all about how it worked, and what went on there. Rome really feels like your in another world. I will say, the tour felt very long, it was about 3 hours of non-stop history and walking. It's a little hard to absorb that amount of information, but it was a really great way to spend the day. We got to see and learn a lot more than we would have on our own. I would not recommend this tour for anyone who tires easily though, and young kids would probably be bored pretty quickly. But for our purposes, I loved it! I only wish I had gotten a chance to go on the colosseum floor or down in the underground mazes. Maybe next trip!

I cant recommend this tour more ,it was absolutely fantastic ,our tour guide was so knowledgeable his name i think was valerio, he kept us out of the sun as much as possible showed us best spots for photos and drinking fountains ect and also had a great sense of humor, love love lovedit!

Sara was our tour guide for this tour, she was amazing, very helpful and informative! Visiting the Colosseum is a must-see when in Rome. Tours rather than self-guided tours are advised as you wouldn't know what you are looking at and have the background and stories from this period. Sara brought postcards and pictures of the current day and past of the different areas we visited and had lots of facts regarding these. We were able to stop and take as many pictures as we wanted.
Alessandra was our guide. She was terrific. The lines were super long so "skipping the line" helped a lot. Highly recommend this guided tour!

This was probably the best thing we did when we were in Rome.

Luciana was an amazing guide who was very informative and able to answer any questions asked of her. She also spoke to everyone in the group and remembered their name. I would highly recommend doing this tour as you will learn so much.

Our tour guide P.G. was superb. He was enthusiastic, knowledgeable and very entertaining. This was a well organised tour of the Colesseum, Paladaide and Forum. The trip included access to areas of the Colesseum normal visitors are not allowed. The 3 and a half hours flew by and no time was wasted queuing. This was well worth the money

Great knowledgeable guide with excellent English. Tour provided by City Wonders.
Definitely recommend

Just seeing the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and Roman Forum on their own is simply not enough. To really get the full experience you need to get one of these amazing guides that can walk you through the breadth of history in this area. I have sadly spaced the name of our guide, but he was very knowledgeable about the archaeological aspects of the tour. Highly recommend for anyone that wants to go beyond the usual sightseeing.

This tour was so worth it. Our guide was so funny and knowledgeable about the history of the colosseum & Roman Forum. She really made it an enjoyable experience. The tour itself was not too long, about 2 1/2 hours, which was nice because it was a lot of walking. Highly recommend!

Wow! This tour and our guide Emanuela were amazing. Seeing the Colosseum from the outside is impressive, but going inside and hearing the history gives you a great perspective on the people, culture and the incredible history of Rome and the world. The tour and process we're both well coordinated. Highly recommend!

Was a really good trip to Rome and enjoyed the tour with city tours, very informational and got to see lots. Only thing was guide was a bit hard to understand on Mic when she wasnt looking at us but was very helpful and friendly. Would recommend this trip.
Totally loved seeing the colosseum like this. No queues straight got straight through Would highly recommend to do

The day that we booked was raining, the tour guide we had (Amil) did not skip a beat, she was very informative, pointing out interesting aspects of colosseum, palatine hill and the forum. The tour company City Wonders were organised and we had no dramas. Would recommend them, hopefully you get the awesome Amil.
I really enjoyed this visit to the Coliseum very good tour with a lot information and no lines to make.

Excellent experience! Our guide Valero was very very informative. Knows his audience and presents the facts very well. He was happy to answer questions and really describes well what the different areas probably looked like all those centuries ago. A guided tour for these three areas is a must. Even my teenage sons were impressed with what they learned from the experience and the guide. If you have teenagers you know that is saying a lot!!
We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and now have a much better historical understanding of the area. Our guide was great and we would highly recommend this tour.

Wow! Wouldn’t do any tours in Rome without the skip the line tour tickets. It was a small group so we got a lot of attention and learned so much! So totally amazing!!!!!! I would do it again in an instant!

Colosseum Small Group Tour with Roman Forum & Palatine Hill with Kylie was phenomenal. She's a brilliant guide. She was sensitive to her audience and phenomenally informed. She was clear, informative, energetic and an excellent communicator.
It was a great tour. Very entertaining and thorough. Would highly recommend. Very organized for so many different groups. Nice to have the speakers to always be able to hear.

Francesca Oddi was a phenomenal tour guide. I took this tour for our honeymoon and had a blast. She was super funny and informative the entire time. I would highly recommend for anyone wishing to explore Rome.

We paid a premium to book a small group tour with Underground access to the Colosseum. We arrived on time and were assigned our tour guide. The tour started and we walked a bit to the entrance of the Colosseum.
at that moment, another tour employee told us that they had overbooked the tour and had to give preference to a party of 5 instead of us (party of 3). We were reassigned to another tour (not small group we paid for) and had to walk the length of the Roman Forum because that tour started there instead of at the Colosseum. We were winded by the time we had to starry the 3 hour waking tour. The tour was interesting, but not same experience (13 people) as we booked (small group). We then got to the Colosseum to be informed that the Underground was closed.

Fabrizio is a wealth of knowledge and readily took all the questions our group had. We had a very engaging group with lots of interest in the history and details and Fabrizio was more than happy to explain and answer them all. He is also an archeologist and so has very deep knowledge of the subjects we discussed.... thank you

Thank you
Great Tour-- Highly recommend-- our guide was excellent and knew answers to all questions. One of the Best!
This company delivered, It was professional, informative and fun. The price was well worth it. I would use them again an again. Hope to visit Rome again.

Really enjoyed the tour with our guide. He was knowledgeable and shared lots of interesting things. He was an archeologist between projects sharing his joy of the roman ruins in his home town. The ruins were so much bigger area-wise than I expected. Having this guide packed alot into a 3 hour timespan.
This was a very worthwhile tour. Knowledgeable guide, who took immense trouble. Detailed & fascinating for an adult but involving even for a 12 year old. Book it!

As crowded as Rome is it is highly recommended to get a tour for the Colosseum. and be sure to do a skip the line tour - it's worth it! the lines are huge otherwise.
Our guide was very good and informative. We learned a lot and she gave us a tip on good trattoria's for lunch :)

Yesterday we did this tour and it was great!! My husband and I are on our honeymoon in Italy and when we got to Rome we only had a few days to check a lot of the places we wanted to visit. This was a great tour - we have about 15-20 people in our group and our guide was knowledge and made sure no one got lost. It was a lot of walking in about 3 hours and we enjoyed the whole experience. The colosseum, palatine and Roman forum were all places we wanted to go and this was the best way to visit them. We were able to get into everything quickly and saw how long the lines were - so glad we booked! Thank you, Alessandra!
Francesca was our guide and she was very helpful in providing all of the history facts and made time for us to take pictures.

We learned alot and the transition to the Colosseum guide and back to our City Wonder guide was very smooth. The Colosseum tour was very good - getting to see the lower level was best part. Lots of people around amde me glad we had a tour guide! The Roman Forum and Palatine Hill were just as expected - our guide was very good about andswering questions and keeping the group together. It was a good day!

This was a great tour with a very informative and interactive tour guide. However the only reason I have given it four stars is due to the fact that he did not guide us through Palatine Hill but infact left us to explore it ourselves with no information about it. I found this rather odd and was expecting to be guided around the Hill, especially because it is included within the tour and is what my partner and I paid for. Good tour nonetheless and would recommend but be sure to not be guided on Palatine Hill.

The tour was very informative! Our tour guide Eleanora tried to accommodate difficult guests, and was polite, and eager to please. This tour felt brief with the lines, but they did the best they could. It’s a little disorganized with placement of booths but Eleanora knew what she was doing and didn’t lose a single person! I wish we could have seen some of the museum exhibits (gladiator Armour) but we understood why we had to pass thru.

A 3 hour tour. The Coliseum section was busy, long wait for toilets, dont bother with the gift shops. The Palantine Hill is beautiful, more peaceful. Lots of history. A long tour which involves steep steps, steep hills, notbsuitable for the infirm. Very good guide.

We had the great Nicola for our tour and he was fantastic. His knowledge was excellent and he made the tour engaging for all. He dispelled some myths about the colosseum and also provided us with ample opportunities to take photos without us feeling rushed or under pressure! Skip the line is a must as it meant we just walked straight in and could enjoy the monuments straight away. It is a lot of walking yet Nicola walked at a speed which allowed people to take photos and also enable everyone to keep up and enjoy the surroundings!!! Another well worth it tour by city wonders!!! Really impressed and highly recommend them!!!
Excellent tour guide and good audio system to help hear commentary. Good to help understanding of Roman areas.

Our group only had four people, so we were able to really engage with our guide, Davide. He was extremely knowledgeable and engaging and really brought Ancient Rome to life. It was definitely worth the extra money to see the arena floor and the underground. Exceeded my expectations!
Absolutely brilliant, the tour guide (Anna Butterworth) was lovely. She explained everything and we were not rushed. Thoroughly enjoyed the whole excursion.

Was a little apprehendive about this when approached, however, it was perfect. The regular line was over 2 hours and cost more. It was a tour with a very informative guides. One was with us at the Colosseum who connected us with another guide for the forum and Palatine hill. Don't hesitate.
Alba was great, very knowledgeable and fun. I recommend this tour for anyone who wants to know more about Roman history
For first timers in Roma do this trip just be prepared for 3 hrs of walk with a story teller guide. Its Awesome who enjoys historical places.
Finally got to see the Coliseum and Roman forum. Our guide Fabio was very excited and loved sharing his knowledge. He kept it fun and interesting.

Marzia was a very enjoyable tour guide: informed, funny and personable. She managed to keep tabs on us on a busy tour day. She had laminated photos for demonstration purposes. I enjoyed this quite a bit.

This was a fantastic tour of incredible historic sites! Connecting with the tour start was easy & no hitches. We were provided good quality earphones, that are a must have for such a tour. A skip the line guided tour is a must, to really appreciate these sites. Our guide Francesca, was fantastic......charming, extremely informative & good fun. The crowds were big but with the tour we were able to get into the Colesseum with no real delay. It is solid work for 3 hours, particularly when crowded but no time is wasted. Despite the crowds, Francesca kept us moving & was always able to find a good spot to gather the group together, with a "come closer, we are family". She helped make it a great & memorable experience!

No trip to Rome is complete without a visit to the colosseum. If it’s your first time you need to have a guide. You not only skip the line but also know exactly where to go. Amil, our guide took us through a treasure trove of information and snippets about the colosseum. She was also quirky that ensured it didn’t feel like an information overload. Go for it. There’s a lot of walking - ~6 kms within the three hours!

The group location outside of the Colosseum was easy to find. They provided easy to use head phones so we could hear our tour guide. The tour guide was knowledgeable, friendly throughout the tour. Her verbal descriptions was accurately to imagine what the Colosseum was like in the past and it was a beautiful tour
The guide Amil Bello was enthusiastic and very informed about all the sites in our tour. You will see alot so be ready to walk and learn.

Did this your with excellent guide joseppe. Very informative and witty. 3hours and the time flew. Well with the money. At one area there was a long queue to get us into the Forum so he took us around another way and no queue.

We were able to easily find our group in the designated location outside of the colosseum. We were a part of a friendly and engaging group. We were provided easy to use head phones so we could hear our tour guide at all times. Our tour guide was knowledgable, friendly, and open to questions throughout the tour. She shared pictures as well as verbal descriptions so you could more accurately imagine what the colosseum was like in the past. There are a decent amount of stairs and the Roman Forum has very uneven surfaces making the tour a bit difficult if you have mobility issues. Would highly recommend this tour!

My husband and I took the tour during our honeymoon. Directions for meeting point were very clear. Tour was organized and on time. We got right into the Colosseum at which time our guide gave us some information followed by 1 hour to explore on our own. This was then repeated at the Forum. We had Jocelyne, who was great! Would recommend if you want most of the time spent independently to explore.

Booked way in advance to avoid the long lines to enter the Colosseum. Process to meet up with our guide was straightforward, thanks to very clear instructions provided with the purchase confirmation. Our guide "TT," was young enthusiastic and very interesting. You could tell she had a passion for the history of the site and was very eager to share it with the group. Her pacing was just right, given the mix of young and old people in the group.

Would recommend this tour for both its "line-skipping" as well as the information and context it provides to the historical sites.

So worth while - matched straight in past really a long que
Did not realise the ticket had a time on it but we were let in anyway - definitely recommend this

For those that want to skip the super long line to get into the Colosseum but also don't need a full tour and want the freedom to walk around as you please, this is perfect for you. At 17,50 euros per person you can't get any cheaper. I thought by reading reviews there was going to be an added fee when getting inside but there wasn't. That was the final price! When inside you have 2 options. You can just spend all your time inside the Colosseum or you can meet the tour guide after going through the Colosseum (there will be a designated time/place to meet) and then they can take you to the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. I recommend trying to do both. Everyone in our group did both.

Fabulous tour exactly as described. No problems finding start, headphones and audio equipment worked well. Francesca our guide was knowledgeable and passionate throughout our tour around the Colosseum and Roman Forum. Skip the line was well worth the extra money given the queues and we were whisked straight through into the security checks area.

It’s three hours and not a lot of rest time on a whistle stop tour of all the notable sights. Wear comfy shoes and take drinks with you. I wouldn’t have found or noticed half the stuff without a guide, who also gives a running commentary and background information.

You finish in the forum so can spend further time exploring if you have energy left.

Thanks City Tours.

Our City Wonders guide Laura did an amazing job guiding us through the crowds and sights of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. She pointing out sights we would never of noticed on our own and gave history and background information to bring things to life for us. City Wonders is a very well organized tour company and I highly recommend them.

We did the CityWonders Colosseum Express tour with Mariella, who was absolutely perfect. It is a great tour, despite being shorter than the others. And definitely more suited to teenagers. We did not fee like we missed out on anything.
We highly recommend taking this tour with CityWonder. We enjoyed having Agata again as our very informative guide! She was full of the most detailed information! Beautiful weather to see everything
Great tour, Alba was a great guide. Lots of interesting detail, which added to the enjoyment of the tour.

The guide was the key. He was very informative and entertaining. Mario did a wonderful job of making the tour an experience like no other. The way he pulled the history together with the drama and excitement of the area made the experience very imaginable. we were not just looking at old stuff.

Guided by Christina, it was a 3.5 hour tour to some of the amazing sites. All with history of the structures provided by an incredibly knowledgeable guide. She was a great speaker and very easy to listen to. I really like the way she could tie in the sites we were actively seeing to places we had visited in the Italy and around the world. It made the tour meaningful in addition to being incredibly educational. Since it was small group, it was faster paced - you weren't waiting for a long group of people to assemble in one location. I attended this tour with someone who had been to the Colosseum before but found this experience far exceeded the prior. I would highly recommend this tour with City Wonders. It was well worth the price and time!

we had a fantastic experience thank to our lovely guide Cristina, very well educated, knovegeble, great sense of humor and excellent english. Really happy about having a tour with a local that it s even an art historian and a teologist, was giving us something more.

Our tour guide Valerio was absolutely awesome! He was very easy to understand and also very funny! We learned an amazing amount on the trip. He also did a great job at keeping us all together and making sure we were all able to take pictures and see the sights. I highly recommend this tour company and try to get Valerio if you can!!!

My daughter and I upgraded our tour so we could see it all. It was really worth seeing the underground and the viewing area from the top. Our guide was an archeologist and shared her vast knowledge with us. Another guide took over at the Forum tour. He was very interested in the Forum and it showed. It is a tour that is not as popular as some but he didn't know why. We just loved it. Small groups are the way to go. Well worth any extra cost.
Our guide was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the colosseum and Rome. The tour was well organized.

Great tour for the amount paid. Tour guide was very enthusiastic and detailed. Also answered any questions. Only downside was people from the group kept getting lost or wandering off which cause the tour to run an extra 45 minutes. Personally would have been better if groups were split up by age. Lots of senior citizens in our group and the tour was quite lengthy for them.

We had Valerio as our tour guide and he made the tour fun and very interesting. He was most helpful and even took photos for everyone during the tour so each family/couples etc could have photos to enjoy of themselves on the tour. Valerio made the tour extremely interesting and made it fun as well as learning about all the interesting facts.
Only thing to recommend on this tour is maybe take your own comfortable headphones as the ones provided are rather uncomfortable to wear for 3 hours long.
Would 10/10 recommend.

We did the colosseum walking tour with Francesca, and she was amazing! We usually like doing things on our own because other tours we have been on were so boring with the tour guiding being so monotone, but Francesca was SO WONDERFUL. She was so entertaining and happy and enthusiastic! She knew SO much and so many interesting and lovely details. Her knowledge and passion for the history, architecture and everything, it was marvelous. She really kept us awake, she kept us interested, and she taught us a lot. She was the best tour guide I’ve ever had. She’s wonderful! Thank you so much Francesca, I hope to have a tour with you again in the future!
Oh and the tour itself was great and the price was great too. We went on a very busy day, we didn’t have to wait in lines because we were with the guide, but even when we were waiting to get through security, Francesca was still entertaining us and giving us info so we were learning while waiting to get through and therefore it didn’t feel like we were waiting. She was overall so wonderful. You can do any tour you want but you just have to make sure your GUIDE is good. Thank you a million times to Francesca!!
We were able to squeeze in a lot of great sites with this half day tour. We also got to skip the line which was great because there were tons of people there.

Nic our tour guide did a wonderful job guiding us through the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. He was very professional, approachable and knowledgeable about the Roman History. Would highly recommend this tour!

This tour was way better than expected! Our tour guide, Gigi, was extremely knowledgeable and took the time to learn everyone's names. He was able to answer all questions and kept everyone engaged. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone that is even remotely interested.

We booked both our tours in Rome through City Wonders thanks to good reviews from friends. David was a great tour guide, I was bummed when the last 15 minutes was rained out, I was looking forward to hearing more about the Roman Forum. The Colosseum takes up most of the tour but provides some very interesting history and architecture. Be prepared to encounter large crowds and walk a lot.

I had a wonderful time exploring the Colosseum, Palatine hill and the Roman forum with city wonders and had a wonderful tour guide in Azzuro, as she was knowledgeable and was helpful in answering any questions we had about the city and all the sites in Rome.
I highly recommend

Thoroughly enjoyed this tour, we paid extra to go underneath the colosseum and to the top where the standard ticket didn’t take you and it was well worth the money. Our tour guide was also lovely and very funny and friendly.
Tour guide was wonderful. She communicated very well with good knowledge and genuine interest. Very happy to have seen the inside of the Colosseum. Lots of photos were taken.

Just want to start off by saying if you have Tiziana as your guide - you’re in luck!! She made the entire tour so much better! I wish I could go above the 5 star rating! There is a lot of walking involved (on uneven surfaces too) so definitely bring a good pair of walking or trail shoes. There is so much to see and so much history behind it all, Tiziana does a great job at explaining everything in the 3 hour tour!

Once again City Wonders came through with an excellent tour. Guide was marvelous and kept the history going as the group was inevitably paused in lines or around other groups. The history our guide offered and insight to ancient Roman life was fascinating and brought everything we saw to life.

My first trip to Rome and I have been blown away by the beauty of the city and it’s history. The overall experience was without question made much better by the guided tour of the Roman forum and the Colosseum. Our guide Ava was excellent her knowledge of the sites is exceptional and she has a very likeable personality, I should also add that her stamina to keep us entertained for the whole three and a half hours of the tour was remarkable.

Silvia was a fantastic guide. Not only was she extremely knowledgable but the fact she grew up in Rome adds to the authenticity. She was very engaging with every member of the group (there was roughly 25 of us) and her English is of a very high standard. There were a couple of young children on the tour and she very good at communicating at their level as well and cleverly improvised ensuring they were not getting bored etc. I can’t vouch for the other guides but from our experience young children will be fine on this tour. From seeing the lengths of the queues I would strongly advise booking a skip-the-line package like this one as it will save you a lot of time and they provide you with all the important information you’ll want to take away from it.

my husband & I did this tour on our second day in Rome and were so thankful for it! Vincenzo is a local and has a deep understanding of the culture and history of the area. He kept the tour interesting and helped us beat the crowds. You HAVE to book with this company, they go above and beyond for others and make you feel at home. We will only use this company when we return.
We wanted a tour without guide but altoghter we still spend two and a half hour. You should not miss this experiance.
What a please it was to get a history lesson with our guide while walking around the collesum well worth booking

My family did this tour and thoroughly enjoyed every minute of it. Our tour guide was fantastic offering the Authentic "Italian" experience with his knowledge and accent. I will say- bring a water bottle or something to fill up at the various fountains. We did not bring one and I would not use my hands after touching many many public surfaces. Therefore, I stuck my face in the fountain out of desperate thirst, and got water up my nose.
The City Wonders Tour with Paula was excellent. We had to fight severe crowds but Paula got us through as wells possible. Paula was very knowledgeable and we had a great tour despite the crowds.
Fantastic experience. Our guide was knowledgeable and very good with the group. He answered every question, never hurried us along and was patient and friendly with everyone.

We would highly recommend the skip the line tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palantine Hill with City Wonders. Claudia was a wonderful guide, full of knowledge, interesting and very friendly.
We learnt so much in 3 hours and were pleased we had not just visited on our own. Thank you Claudia

A great tour given by Ahmed. He wound his way through the crowds to give us a good experience of the Colosseum and the Palatine Hill. His knowledge was obviously broad and being able to explore the Hill after the tour was a bonus.
One regret was that a member of our tour had bought a souvenir bottle of wine that morning. She was not allowed onto the P Hill and her friend stayed behind with her. That could easily have been me also. Perhaps warnings beforehand about our bag contents??

We had a good size group of 12. The tour guide Alba was really informative and kept everyone engaged with her enthusiasm. The time flew by; could have listened all day. The Colosseum definitely has the wow factor, but it was really interesting to see the size and hear the history around the forum and Palatine Hill

One thing that was mentioned as an improvement for City Wonders was to find a way to make the headphones recyclable
Excellent tour. Our super guide was very knowledgable and made the tour fun and interesting. The time flew by quickly.
Louise did a fantastic tour. She was informable, friendly & kept the tour on schedule. Receptive to any questions & always had a response. Would highly recommend the tour and Louise as a guide.

The guide we had was excellent. She has an archeology degree and was full of detail. She spoke almost the full 3 hours. We toured through the Colosseum and the ruins beside.
There are alot of stairs to climb but there was also an elevator for those who could not climb. A pair of comfortable shoes is best as the road/walkway is cobblestone and not flat.
From the meeting point to getting inside the Colosseum was about 40 minutes, not bad!This is not the only tour that runs but if you were to go in without a tour the line was hours long.
In my opinion money well best for time saved and knowledge gained!

Everything about this well-organised 3 hour walking tour of The Colosseum, The Forum & Palantine Hill was amazing. We had an incredible guide Eduardo (Eddy!) who was so well-informed due to his background in archeology & his obvious passion for what he knows & what he does. He also has a great sense of humour & really brought the whole experience of Ancient Rome ‘alive’ so you really felt you could imagine life in those times.
I would really recommend this tour for anyone wishing to experience Ancient Rome- nothing in a guide book can compare with the history & stories you get from Eduardo. It truly was amazing!

We met at the assigned location to meet up with the guide and group (about 16 total) and off we went. There were no delays at the entry point, the entire tour was about 3 hours, the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Forum. Our guide was not only very knowledgeable but very skillful at moving our group through typical bottle necks (security, massive tour groups) and he appeared to have a good relationships with the site staff that manage the flow of the crowd.

Tour was amazing!! It was a fairly large group, but we were all provided with head sets which helped with hearing the guide. The guide showed us the best areas to take photos and was so knowledgable about everything. She was so willing to answer our questions and didn’t rush us in any way. It even started raining and she proceeded with the tour. Definitely a must-do in Rome!

Barbara lead the group on the most amazing tour I have ever been on. She is an archaeologist so her knowledge is very deep of the city and she has a passion for Rome! I know it was well worth the money because there were countless things that she pointed out that I would have missed otherwise. Well worth the money and well worth asking for Barbara!
Excellent guides and a way to see these great sites away from the heavy crowds, some waiting around but a good 3 hours of tour.

My mom and I went on this tour together, and Selenia, our tour guide was amazing. She kept us engaged and listening throughout the entire (almost) 3 hour tour that included the colosseum, roman forum and palatine hill. She led us through everything with ease, and even when places got busy, she made sure we all kept up. Loved it and would definitely recommend to anyone who has not visited before.
